data.name: From Florence: Pisa, San Gimignano, Siena and Chianti Day Trip (with Lunch)
data.description: Would you like to see the most beautiful places in Tuscany in a memorable day? Join this tour and enjoy a magical experience, made even more enjoyable by a typical lunch in the heart of Siena and a tasting of local wines in the Chianti area.Depart from Florence and enjoy the ride on scenic roads to Pisa and the beautiful Piazza dei Miracoli. Here, you'll have the chance to admire the Baptistery, the Cathedral and, of course, the iconic Leaning Tower. Spend your free time in Pisa as you prefer before setting off to your next destination.Your journey continues to San Gimignano, the delightful medieval town declared a UNESCO World Heritage Site, and Siena, the city of the Palio. Take your time to visit Siena's most important monuments, palaces and squares, including Piazza del Campo (where the Palio horse race is held) and Piazza del Duomo, where you can admire the magnificent Cathedral.After a typical Tuscan lunch in Piazza del Campo, you'll reach a winery in the Chianti area, where you'll taste some renowned local wines. Here you'll also have the chance to buy typical Tuscan wine and products.

data.name: The Pitti Palace private tour: Splendours of the Royal Residence
data.description: Have an incredible experience visiting the Royal Palace of Florence with its luxurious rooms, paintings and admire masterpieces by Titian, Raphael, Caravaggio, part of the amazing collections of the Medici family, learning the stories and the secrets of their Court's life.

data.name: Florence: "Wanna be Italiano" Cooking Class and Market Tour
data.description: Meet an experienced chef and learn how to cook a delicious Tuscan meal in the heart of Florence! First step: a little walk to the central market! You will go shopping at the central market with the chef, picking up the ingredients for your lunch.You will meet the butchers, the bakers and the farmers selling vegetables from their gardens. You will learn how to distinguish the highest quality ingredients. After this experience, you will reach a fascinating home-like professional location, just a few steps from the central market, where you'll enjoy a delicious tasting of typical products and you will start putting your hands on the ingredients to create your own meal, guided by the expertise of the chef.The menu may slightly vary depending on the season and the fresh ingredients available, but will usually be made of bruschetta, different kinds of fresh homemade pasta from scratch (i.e. tagliatelle and ravioli), sauces for the pasta, and a dessert. And then you will obviously eat the meal you prepared yourself, accompanied by two glasses from a selection of Chianti wine.A booklet with recipes will let you cook for your friends once you get back home. And finally, get your certificate of participation!A full refund will apply if you cancel 24 hours or more before the activity start time.No refund is possible if you cancel within 24 hours of the activity start time.

data.name: Panoramic Rooftop Tour Discover Florence Like Never Before
data.description: Embark on an exclusive exploration of Florence's rooftops, a unique journey offering a new perspective of the Renaissance city. The tour starts in the bustling Piazza della Repubblica, where a local expert guide welcomes you to this urban adventure.

data.name: Secrets of Florence
data.description: Explore some of the most famous sites of Florence’s ancient culture while learning about the mysteries of its past. We’ll take a look at the ancient center of the city, where some of the most interesting secrets are kept. Around the Baptistery, Duomo, and Cathedral, all of which are decorated with elaborate facades and marble panels, you’ll learn about the “Miracle of the Flowering Tree” and the “Bull and the Baker.” Afterwards we will walk near Dante’s home and discuss the infamous Church of Dante and Beatrice. We will then stop and see Palazzo Vecchio, famous for its civil architecture, the location of the guilds, and the Medici family political court. While in Piazza della Signoria, you will see an open-air museum consisting of many statues including the copy of Michelangelo’s David, as well as many other noteworthy works, including the often unseen Profile carved by Michelangelo. You will then walk through the wings of the Uffizi Gallery. Following the Arno River, you will walk towards Ponte Vecchio, famous for its gold jewelry shops. The tour ends in front of Palazzo Pitti. It is the best way to experience the famous sites of Florence while also hearing about their mysterious pasts.

data.name: Florence: Accademia Gallery Entry Ticket & Multilingual Audio App
data.description: If you want to see Michelangelo’s David you can do it in Piazza della Signoria in front of Palazzo Vecchio or at Piazzale Michelangelo. If you want to admire the original, however, you can only do it at the Galleria dell'Accademia. This is the ideal place in the city to discover not only the most famous work of art by Michelangelo, the David, but also other masterpieces of this great Florentine artist: The Four Prisoners, San Matteo, and Palestrina’s Pietà. This exceptional concentration of Michelangelo’s works has contributed significantly to the fame of the Accademia Gallery, making it the second most visited museum in Florence after the Uffizi. Given the relative narrowness of the museum’s spaces and the large turnout, long lines of tourists waiting to enter, outside, are very common. Even if you manage to get an access ticket with a reservation it is sometimes extremely difficult to enter; that’s why we have activated the Fast-Track-Ticket service with Host for the Academy, to ensure a safe and immediate entrance to the museum. At the chosen date and time, our assistant will be at the meeting point to give you your entrance ticket for quick access, to make your visit as simple and uncomplicated as possible.We include our Audio Guide Mobile Application, in 15 different languages,  to discover the most famous paintings of the museum.  It's simply unmissable!It's made to be easy to use: after your booking reservation, you'll get the link and the small instructions to install it on your mobile deviceOur art historian has dedicated a long time to crafting it for the best visit experience, her work never stops improving and updating it; for us, it's not a simple app but it's the best tool to visit the museum, it adds all the information you may need without been stack with a group tour.

data.name: Florence: The Duomo Complex Private Tour
data.description: Piazza del Duomo offre una vista mozzafiato, soprattutto al tramonto, quando i raggi del sole illuminano i marmi policromi degli edifici che compongono il complesso religioso della città. L’omogeneità cromatica (verde, bianco e rosso) armonizza magnificamente una varietà stilistica evidente.Le differenze di stile si spiegano con il fatto che i lavori di costruzione si sono protratti per circa quattro secoli: il Battistero iniziò ad essere edificato a metà dell’XI secolo, mentre la Cupola fu completata da Filippo Brunelleschi a metà del XV secolo. Con le sue dimensioni imponenti, la Cupola domina l’intera piazza.Seguendo un ordine cronologico, la visita al centro religioso di Firenze inizia con il Battistero. Con la nostra guida certificata, avrai l’opportunità di ammirare i meravigliosi mosaici bizantini della volta e, all’esterno, il capolavoro di Lorenzo Ghiberti: la Porta Est del Battistero, comunemente chiamata “Porta del Paradiso”.Il tour prosegue poi verso il Museo dell’Opera del Duomo, dove potrai osservare da vicino opere di altissimo valore appartenenti al patrimonio artistico del complesso religioso.Infine, visiterai l’iconica Cattedrale, conosciuta in tutto il mondo per la sua bellezza e unicità.Goditi una visita privata con una guida autorizzata ai luoghi più importanti nel cuore del centro storico di Firenze: il Battistero, il Museo dell’Opera del Duomo e il Duomo.

data.name: Half Day Private Tour of Florence with Academy Gallery
data.description:
Florence is a Renaissance city of orange and gold, blossoming above the golden landscape of Tuscany. Join this Florence private tour and discover its dramatic history, alongside all its beauty. Get skip-the-line access to Michelangelo’s David and enjoy a walking tour of historic Florence with your expert guide’s undivided attention.

Meet your guide at your hotel before you embark on a walking tour of Florence’s pedestrianized historic center. Discover the icons of its architecture, including Florence’s Cathedral; designed by goldsmith Brunelleschi after a design competition. Go on to the Loggia dei Lanzi – one of the world’s first open air galleries.

Enter the Accademia to see Michelangelo’s David – all 17ft of him – in the flesh. Then, head to the Ponte Vecchio; the most stunning bridge, which perfectly frames the Tuscan countryside beyond. Before you leave, make sure to rub the nose of the boar, Il Porcelino – legend has it that, if you do, you’ll return to Florence!

data.name: Florence Day Trip to Tuscany: Siena, San Gimignano & Winery Lunch
data.description: Planning a day in Tuscany’s countryside can be tricky, with winding roads, remote villages, and countless wineries to choose from. With a 3-course lunch and 6 wine tastings, allow us to take the guesswork out of your Tuscan experience. Start in Florence, drive through Siena’s rolling hills, walk the medieval streets of San Gimignano, and tour a family-run Chianti winery. Along the way, learn the stories behind Chianti’s renowned wines and soak in the charm of Tuscany’s most stunning landscapes.Tour OverviewMeet your tour leader in Florence at Piazza del Duomo 10, and hop aboard your luxury, climate-controlled vehicle. You'll enjoy an entertaining ride from Florence through the most famous food and wine region in Italy, accompanied by a passionate local tour leader and private driver. Tuscany awaits to share its bounty of gorgeous foods and wines, and you'll meet the local people who can show you wine-making techniques passed down through 13 generations. You'll also get to explore the insanely beautiful old towns of San Gimignano and Siena, and enjoy a hearty, delicious lunch in Chianti. Your tour will conclude at Fortezza Piazzale Montelungo, near the Santa Maria Novella train station.Tuscany Wine and Food Tour DescriptionYour 9-hour day trip from Florence includes:Round-trip transportation from Florence in a climate-controlled vehicleVisit beautiful Siena with free time to visit the cathedral (on your own)Wine tour and tasting at a traditional, family-run winery in ChiantiTaste 6 different winesTraditional 3-course Tuscan lunchVisit the picturesque medieval town of San GimignanoAn English-speaking tour leader for the dayMaximum group size of 29Historic SienaYour first stop on this Tuscany day trip is the famous city of Siena. Twice a year, the city holds the famous Palio horse race that has been run since the Middle Ages in Siena's central square, Piazza del Campo. Along with your knowledgeable tour leader, you'll see this famous square and the oldest bank in the world. After getting oriented in Siena, you'll have some free time to explore, and we recommend purchasing a ticket to visit the Siena Cathedral on your own.Chianti Winery for Lunch and Wine TastingAt a family-run winery that has been perfecting Tuscan wine for 13 generations, enjoy a private tour of their vineyards, wine cellar, and fermentation cellar before indulging in a curated tasting of their finest products. Sip on a selection that includes Vernaccia di San Gimignano DOCG, Rosé, Chianti, Super Tuscan Riserva, and Morellino di Scansano, paired with artisanal olive oils like extra virgin, truffle, and spicy pepper, as well as their Gold Reserve balsamic vinegar.The lunch is a true Tuscan feast. Start with appetizers of Tuscan cheeses, cured meats, bruschetta, and salad. Savor the first course of Lasagne al Tartufo and hearty Tuscan ribollita, followed by dessert: cantucci paired with Vin Santo. This exceptional dining experience highlights the rich flavors and heritage of Tuscany, making your visit unforgettable.Medieval San GimignanoThe next stop on your Tuscan journey is an incredible little town, sometimes nicknamed “Medieval Manhattan.” As a UNESCO World Heritage site that feels straight out of a fairy tale, San Gimignano is known for the towers that create its iconic skyline, bringing to mind modern day skyscrapers. Once inside the city walls, enjoy some free time to explore this remarkable and historic town.Return to FlorenceAfter an idyllic day visiting historic Tuscany cities and enjoying the food and wine of Chianti, it's time to head back to Florence. Simply sit back and relax as your professional driver takes you safely back to the city.

data.name: Florence and Chianti Wine Tasting from Pisa with Transfer
data.description:
Begin your day trip with pickup from your Pisa hotel. Hop aboard your coach and take off on an hour’s ride to Florence. As you go, learn the history behind the Renaissance city as well as the surrounding region.

Upon arriving, marvel at the city's architectural gems and bustling squares. See Brunelleschi’s famous Duomo, the towering Palazzo Vecchio in Piazza della Signoria, the 14th-century Ponte Vecchio and more.

From there, walk up the hill to Piazzale Michelangelo, offering panoramic views of the city below. Snap some photos and gaze out at the Arno Valley before hopping back in your coach. Continue toward the Uffizi Gallery where you can admire the unique paintings of Michelangelo, Botticelli, Raffaello and Leonardo da Vinci.

Afterward, travel into the Tuscan hills for a stop at a winery. Swirl and sip four local blends, before returning to Pisa.

data.name: Palazzo Pitti & Palatine Gallery: Entry Ticket + Guided Tour
data.shortDescription: Take a tour of the Pitti Palace and discover Medici family secrets
data.description:
Pitti Palace has been home to the Medici family since the 16th century and features some amazing art and architecture you have to see to believe. With these tickets, you'll learn even more thanks to a knowledgeable guide who will tell you stories as you walk. 

See the famous private collection of the Medici family, including masterpieces from Botticelli, Titian, Rubens, Caravaggio, and many other Italian and European painters from the 15th to the 17th century. 

Take in the ornate, frescoed rooms of the Palatine Gallery, and see the lavish royal apartments the Medici family once used to impress their guests. 

This tour is a unique chance to admire more than just the surface layer of Renaissance beauty – you'll discover the history of the Palace and its inhabitants, and some of their secrets, too.

data.name: Chianti Half day Wine tour from Florence
data.description: The Chianti tour will allow you to explore the authenticity of the flavors of the Tuscan countryside and discover natural winemaking, to grasp the taste that a good glass of wine can convey.Our local guides will be able to lead you on a path in which history, art, and peasant culture know how to merge to best evoke the roots that have animated this land for millennia. Enjoying the view of the vineyards is just one of the ways to get to know this area.Tuscany is the home of fine oils: a blend of ancient olive varieties, the extra virgin olive oil from the Chianti area comes from the skillful combination of over 120 native qualities of olive trees. From a difficult land, peasant art has been able to draw from the finest oil fruit that knows how to transmit olfactory sensations and an incomparable taste. Touch to understand, savor to discover. This is the impulse that animates the precious moments of the Chianti tour.Visit the cellars of the most renowned wines, taste the top products of local farms, and be overwhelmed by the unique atmosphere that this corner of Tuscany offers. In the first cellar, you will try 4 different types of wine, so that you will understand in detail the differences in taste and texture between different bottles. Enjoy also a selection of salami and tasting of 3 extra-virgin olive oils and 2 balsamic vinegars, paired with bread. In the second cellar, you will try 3 different types of wine, their home-produced olive oil and Tuscan bread. There is time to end the day with a walk to the Castellina in Chianti to breathe the air of the village and explore its typical shops.

data.name: Private Walking food tour of Florence
data.description: This walking food tour is designed to discover and taste the gastronomic side of Florence, among the most appreciated by Italians. The city will surprise you for the variety and richness of its flavors, recipes and wines. Our gastronomic tour around Sant’Ambrogio neighborhood – away from the big crowds yet in the city center, where you’ll find mostly locals – is designated to make you enjoy the authentic flavors of this city in every bite, enriching it with stories and anecdotes and taking you only in the best places where locals usually go. The journey includes ancient specialties (do truffle and lampredotto sound familiar?), excellent wines and new flavors in wineries and small restaurants. The secret of our tastiest and most authentic perspective of Tuscan cuisine is a very simple recipe: knowing where to go and the city culinary heritage; employing only passionate food-lovers, licensed tour guides; respecting the local producers, as well as the food richness of this unique city.

data.name: Accademia Gallery tour in the footsteps of the David
data.description: Immerse yourself completely in Michelangelo's art at the Accademia Gallery with the help of a certified guide. See the most famous work of the great Florentine master, the statue of David, and the other important masterpieces of the collection.The Accademia Gallery was officially founded in 1784 in the halls of the old San Matteo hospital in Florence, and it soon became a place where important artistic institutions and artwork could be brought together under one roof.The museum now houses the largest Michelangelo sculpture collection in the world, which also includes the Prisoners, the Palestrina Pietà and San Matteo. Here you will also find the single largest collection of paintings on gold background as well as the Museum of Musical Instruments.Admire the statue of David, which the young Michelangelo sculpted in three years starting from a huge block of rough marble. The absolutely magnificent and imposing sculpture, the real icon of the Renaissance ideal, became the symbol of the power and invincibility of the Republic of Florence: a young powerful man nude, in his full physical vigor, with an intense expression of force and courage as a plastic consequence of his absolute faith in God.

data.name: Florence Medici Quest: Self-Guided Conspiracy Adventure
data.description: Step back into Renaissance Florence and uncover a dangerous conspiracy threatening the powerful Medici family. Solve puzzles and reveal secrets hidden behind the city’s most iconic landmarks. Using your smartphone, you'll follow 11 interactive clues that guide you to the Medici Palace, Piazza della Signoria, Ponte Vecchio, and other famous sites. Each puzzle you solve unlocks pieces of a thrilling historical story, transporting you into the political intrigue that once ruled Florence. Play at your own pace, stopping whenever you wish to admire the architecture, take photos, or enjoy a gelato along the way. What makes this tour unique? It’s a captivating mix of real-world exploration and historical storytelling, allowing you to experience Florence not just as a visitor, but as an active part of its dramatic past. Perfect for history lovers, couples, families, and curious travelers seeking a deeper, more playful way to experience Florence’s wonders.

data.name: Palazzo Vecchio & Museum: Entry Ticket + Optional Video or Audio Guide
data.description:
Skip the line and explore Palazzo Vecchio, the symbol of civic power in Florence for centuries! This multimedia-guided tour gives you the lowdown on what you're looking at as you climb the Tower of Palazzo Vecchio for fantastic views over Florence, and visit the museum that's still the seat of the local city government.

Learn the rich history of what was once the residence of the Medici family, and gaze in awe at the incredible sculptures, paintings and also the magnificent views of Piazza della Signoria, one of the most famous symbols of Florence.

Thanks to your 55-minute high-resolution video guide on a tablet, you can walk and be talked through the Michelozzo courtyard, the Chapel of Eleonora, the Salone dei Cinquecento (Hall of the Five Hundred) and the Map Room, and more.

data.name: Private Michelangelo Sculpture Tour in Florence
data.description:
Who was Michelangelo Buonarroti, the well-known poet, painter, sculptor, and architect? Take this Michelangelo tour to discover the city where the artist was raised and created many of his masterpieces, following his footsteps.

Join our experienced guide as you meander around the charming cobblestone alleys of this magnificent Renaissance city to learn about Michelangelo's birthplace, family history, childhood home, what and where he studied and his many artworks. Funny stories, anecdotes, and tales can help you understand him better as you become acquainted with his rivals and personality.

With the assistance of our guide, you will tour the Accademia Gallery, the Medici Chapels, the Bargello Museum and the Museo dell'Opera del Duomo. Between the visits of these museums, you will also come across fascinating locations associated with this famous artist.

The tour will conclude inside the Accademia Gallery, allowing anyone who want to spend more time in this exquisite museum to do so.

Then, see the city's most famous sites, including the cathedral, which has the largest stone dome in the world, the Ponte Vecchio, and Medici Palace—all with the fascinating insights of your private guide to add context.

data.name: Florence Guided Private Tour with Michelangelo's David
data.description: A three-hour tour of Florence that's perfect for first-timers to the city. Be led by an expert tour guide with over 20 years of experience into the gems of the city. Meet centrally and explore Florence's beautiful buildings, such as Ponte Vecchio, Piazza della Signoria (the main square) and the Duomo. Skip the lines at Galleria dell'Accademia with priority access so you have more time to savor the artistic masterpieces of Michelangelo and others, including the famous David.

data.name: Private Walking Tour - Made In Florence Experience
data.description: The first stop of our Made in Florence Tour will be at the Salvatore Ferragamo Museum, which displays photos, sketches, and a collection of shoes designed by Salvatore and his daughter Fiamma for many VIPs over the years: the Museum's exhibitions change regularly, offering a diverse selection of pieces.Our tour will continue with a visit to the historical Officina Profumo-Farmaceutica di Santa Maria Novella, which opened to the public in 1612 and still preserves 14th-century frescoes. It sells original Dominican monks’ products like perfumes, soaps, and cosmetics in the splendid halls of the ancient monastery.Our last stop will be to the nearby Church of Santa Maria Novella. Many masterpieces are displayed here, such as the Trinity by Masaccio, the crucifixes by Giotto and Brunelleschi, and, in the transept, the lively Renaissance frescoes by Ghirlandaio and Filippino Lippi.

data.name: Florence Uffizi Gallery private tour
data.description:
Enjoy a private guided tour of the Uffizi Gallery in Florence and take advantage of your skip-the-line ticket which saves you precious time by avoiding the long lines at the museum entrance.

You will be accompanied by a local guide who will make you explore in the best possible way the homeland of the most extraordinary works of art created by Michelangelo, Botticelli, Caravaggio, Leonardo, Raphael, Donatello and many other artists.

Discover the most famous masterpieces of the Italian Renaissance such as The Birth of Venus and Spring by Sandro Botticelli, Tondo Doni, the only painting on wood by Michelangelo Buonarroti, the head of Medusa on a wooden shield by Caravaggio and The Annunciation by Leonardo Da Vinci.

data.name: Pisa: Day Trip from Florence by Train
data.description:
Prepare for a day-long adventure from Florence to the charming city of Pisa, kicking off the journey at the Santa Maria Novella train station. A mere hour-long train ride whisks you to Pisa, where the tour begins with a bang.

Immerse yourself in UNESCO square, where marvels like the Baptistery, the Monumental Cemetery, the Leaning Tower, and the majestic Cathedral stand proud. The guide brings these architectural wonders to life, telling tales that transport you back through the intricate tapestry of Italian history.

data.name: Women of Florence Walking Tour with City Highlights and Medici Chapel
data.description:
The history we hear of is often dominated by men, and this can also be said for the history of Florence and the influential Medici family. This private walking tour will take you to see some of the most famous monuments in the city, but through the eyes of the inspirational and influential women often overlooked.

As you make your way through these winding renaissance streets, you'll learn about the strategic marriages the Medici made with the royal families of Europe to secure their power. Hear of the women who came to Florence as brides, and see Palazzo Vecchio - where they lived. Learn how the decline of the Duchy of Tuscany is often blamed on the regency of two Medici women, and other untold stories.

Listen to the forgotten stories of women, both real and fictional, who played a part in influencing some of the most famous artists of all time. These sculptures and works of art capture different aspects of femininity your expert guide will help you understand.

data.name: Chocolate Tasting Experience in Florence
data.description: Immerse yourself in the world of Venchi, the renowned Italian chocolatier, with this exclusive luxury experience. Every step is a celebration of luxury, flavor and the art of chocolate-making. Step into the world of Venchi in the charming historic center of Florence with a captivating storytelling session, unraveling the brand's rich history and commitment to crafting exceptional chocolates. The second step invites you to immerse yourself in the enchanting story of the featured product, promising a unique and delectable journey. As you progress to the third step, savor a curated selection of 6 exquisite chocolates during a guided tasting session, allowing you to explore the nuanced flavors and craftsmanship behind each creation. To sweeten the experience even more, you will receive a 10% offer on additional purchases, allowing you to take home gift boxes of beautifully crafted chocolates to share or savor at your leisure. Don't forget to take home a delicious cadeau of chocolates for your sweet snacks.

data.name: Uffizi Gallery skip the line monolingual Guided Visit
data.description: You can't leave Florence without visiting one of the most famous art galleries in the world. Here you can admire numerous works of art by Botticelli, Michelangelo, Leonardo da Vinci, Raffaello, Giotto, Cimabue, Masaccio and many others. Among the precious exhibition halls of the Gallery, the most renowned one contains the refined works by Botticelli, amongst which the absolute masterpieces: "Primavera" and "Birth of Venus". The latter painting, the icon of the museum, represents the allegory of the birth of the goddess emerging from the sea foam and symbolizes the ideal of beauty as an expression of purity and spiritual quality, typical of the Renaissance Neoplatonic aesthetics. The guided Tour ends at the Uffizi Terrace where you can enjoy an amazing and exclusive view of the city’s most important monuments. Once the guided tour is over, it is possible to stay in the museum.

data.name: Florence: Sunset Wine Tasting + Guided Walking Tour
data.description:
As the day-tripping tourist start to disappear at sunset, that's when this **guided walking tour of Florence** turns on the charm.

See this beautiful Renaissance city at its best – during the **golden hours of sunset**. Together with your **professional guide**, you'll tour the **Oltrarno distict** and see its antique and artisan shops.

Watch the patios and terraces fill up with resident Florentines and **enjoy an apertif (or two) and antipasti** with a local vitner.

Then, stroll to the other side of the **Arno River** to see **Ponte Vecchio, Piazza della Signoria**, and conclude your tour under Bruneschelli's golden **Duomo** as the sun sets over Florence.

data.name: Tart and cookies cooking class, for children from 6 to 11 year
data.description:
SiChef offers a new space framed by the typical Chianti landscape.

Our kitchen is professional and well-equipped, ideal for cooking classes with our professional chefs and with all the space needed for tasting preparations.

data.name: Florence 3-Day Tuscany Tour
data.description: Explore the sights, tastes, and history of Tuscany with like-minded travelers on this 3-day, guided. Begin your journey in romantic Florence and travel through Pisa, Cinque Terre, San Gimignano, and the Chianti region led by a guide. Look out at the scenery between wine tastings and vineyard tours and discover the cities and coastal villages that make this area memorable.

data.name: Florence: Classic Electric Car Eco-Tour
data.shortDescription: Reduce your carbon footprint in an electric car on a city tour of Florence
data.description:
Ride around Florence in style while reducing your carbon footprint at the same time with tickets for the classic eco-friendly tour of Florence. 

Discover the capital of Tuscany in an electric buggy as you stop at all the best Florentine hot spots with the help of a driver guide – Ponte Vecchio, Medici Riccardi Palace, Santa Maria Novella church, San Lorenzeo Basilica and Piazza della Signoria. 

On your 1-hour eco-tour of Florence, you'll have a handy audio guide so you can learn fascinating facts about the important people and places of Florence.

data.name: Palazzo Vecchio: Entry Ticket + Guided Tour
data.shortDescription: Explore a town hall that shaped the heart and soul of Florence
data.description:
Join a guided tour of Palazzo Vecchio in Florence that unveils its rich history. Feel the aura of a place that has shaped the heart and soul of the city from yesteryears to today.

Explore hidden gems with the secret passages tour, like the concealed stairway and the opulent Studiolo of Francesco I de Medici, a collection of rare and precious artifacts. Admire Cosimo I's Scrittoio and the grand Salone del Cinquecento ceiling structure.

Due to an extraordinary maintenance of the elevator, which will last until October 2025, the Gran Salone ceiling structure will not be visitable and will be replaced by a visit to the Bagno di Cosimo.

The special palace tour adds to this adventure with its wealth, decorations, and masterpieces. You even get to sneak through the secret passage in the Camerino of Bianca Cappello, second wife of the Grand Duke Francesco I de Medici.

data.name: From Florence: Self-Drive Vintage Fiat 500 Tour
data.shortDescription: See Italy from behind the wheel of a retro Fiat 500 on this 6-hour tour
data.description: Tour the Tuscan hills in a vintage Fiat 500 with tickets for this day tour from Florence.

data.name: Wanna Be Italiano - The Original Cooking Class & Market Food Tour in Florence
data.shortDescription: Join a cooking masterclass led by a famous local chef in a stunning kitchen
data.description:
If you're looking for an authentic Tuscan experience, this cooking class is a perfect fit! Led by an expert chef, you'll take a stroll through the Central Market, gathering fresh ingredients for your meal. The chef will teach you how to recognize high-quality foods and help you pick out the perfect ingredients for your dish. 

Once you've collected all the ingredients you need, head back to a professional kitchen just a few steps away from the market. Here, you'll learn how to prepare fresh homemade pasta from scratch, create sauces to accompany your pasta, and even whip up a dessert.
 
Vegetarians are more than welcome, and any dietary restrictions or allergies with advanced notice can be accommodated. After you've finished cooking, you'll enjoy a delicious meal accompanied by two glasses of Chianti wine. 

You'll also receive a booklet of recipes to recreate the dishes at home. With our cooking class, you'll get a taste of authentic Tuscan cuisine.

data.name: Chianti: Day Trip from Florence + Wine Tour & Tasting
data.shortDescription: Prepare to taste a variety of the finest Chianti wine amidst lush vineyards
data.description:
Explore the serene vineyards and rolling hills of the Chianti wine region. Take a break from city life and appreciate a relaxing gastronomic experience surrounded by nature. Tuscany is famous not only for its art cities but also for its beautiful landscapes, villages, and vineyards.

The tour includes tastings at two wineries in Chianti, where you can feast on delicious regional produce with the finest Chianti wine. Learn about the wine production process during visits to the wineries.

You'll sample 3-4 different types of wine at each winery, for a total of 7, offering a genuine taste of Tuscany.

data.name: Medici Chapels: Skip The Line Ticket + Guided Tour
data.shortDescription: Visit the Medici Chapels and see Michelangelo’s work in the New Sacristy
data.description:
Join a small-group tour to see the Medici family's impact on Florence. Use skip-the-line access to visit the Medici Chapels at San Lorenzo, including the Chapel of the Princes, decorated with marble and semi-precious stones. See Michelangelo’s work in the New Sacristy, where key family members are buried. Hear about Michelangelo’s Secret Room and learn about a hidden crypt found in 2004 (visit not included).   

Learn about figures like Lorenzo the Magnificent and Cosimo the Elder, and the Medici's rivalries with families like the Pazzis. Visit filming locations from Medici: Masters of Florence and see the exterior of Palazzo Medici Riccardi. Walk through the San Lorenzo neighborhood, past the Duomo, and into Piazza della Signoria. Discover how the Medici changed Florence’s political scene and finish your tour near the Uffizi with tips from your guide.

data.name: Boboli Gardens: Reserved Entrance
data.description:
A wonderfully landscaped sculpture park behind the Pitti Palace, Boboli Gardens is an extravagant mix of nature, architecture, and sculpture – as well as various museums; it's many attractions rolled into one.

These Boboli Gardens tickets allow you to skip the line, and also give access to the Porcelain Museum and the nearby Bardini Gardens. A trip here is a journey deep into the heart of Renaissance perfection.

data.name: Dining experience at a local's home in Pontassieve with cooking demo
data.description: There's no better way to discover Italy's culture from the inside. Our national network of expert Italian home cooks offers the finest Italian food experiences. Immerse yourself in a private dining experience with an Italian family with a 4-course menu (starter, pasta, main course and dessert with drinks included: water, selection of local wines and coffee) showcasing authentic Italian recipes passed down by real Italian Mammas in family cookbooks. Enjoy a cooking demonstration, where your host will show you their cooking skills as they finish the dishes in front of you. Feel the warmth of Italian hospitality by connecting with local people. You'll come away with happy memories, new friends, and a deeper understanding of your destination, as you taste the typical dishes that real Italians cook every day. This experience is held by Cesarine, the oldest Italy’s network of home cooks available all over the country. The word "Cesarine" means "home cook". Our network of passionate and welcoming local hosts open the doors of their own homes to curious travellers for immersive culinary experiences. The Cesarine serve only local specialties from their family cookbooks to tell the great story of their traditional regional cuisine.

data.name: Uffizi Gallery Visit with Audio Guide at 12:00am
data.description: For all those customers who wish to visit the museum in total freedom and at their own pace, guided by an audio commentary of expert art historians recorded in their own language. You can't leave Florence without visiting one of the most famous art galleries in the world. Here you can admire numerous works of art by Botticelli, Michelangelo, Leonardo da Vinci, Raffaello, Giotto, Cimabue, Masaccio and many others. Among the precious exhibition halls of the Gallery, the most renowned one contains the refined works by Botticelli, amongst which the absolute masterpieces: "Primavera" and "Birth of Venus". The latter painting, the icon of the museum, represents the allegory of the birth of the goddess emerging from the sea foam and symbolizes the ideal of beauty as an expression of purity and spiritual quality, typical of the Renaissance Neoplatonic aesthetics.

data.name: Heart of Florence Guided Walking Tour plus mobile App
data.description: Your guide will take you on an exciting journey through time, revealing the history, anecdotes and secrets kept in this wonderful city. From the still visible traces of the Roman foundation of the city (in 59 BC), in the Middle Ages, up to the glorious Renaissance, a period in which Florence was ruled by the powerful Medici family. You will admire the most iconic squares and monuments of Florence among noble palaces and artisan shops. You will discover the spectacular Piazza della Signoria dominated by the majestic Palazzo Vecchio, the Renaissance Palazzo Strozzi, the iconic and picturesque Ponte Vecchio, the district of the Medici family with the ancient Basilica of San Lorenzo, the Medici Chapels and Palazzo Medici-Riccardi, the their first residence. You will be breathless in front of the beauty of the monumental complex of the Duomo, with the Cathedral of Santa Maria del Fiore, the famous Brunelleschi's Dome, the elegant Giotto's Bell Tower and the beautiful Romanesque Baptistery of San Giovanni. PLUS: in addition to the guided tour, you can also enjoy an audio guide provided by the APP included in the tour price. In this way you can explore other aspects of the city on your own and in total freedom by following the thematic itineraries available on the app, including "Florence as seen by Dante" dedicated to the great poet who was born in this city and lived until his exile.

data.name: Small Group Skip the Line Uffizi Guided Tour
data.description: Make the most of your Uffizi Gallery visit with a 2-hour tour that showcases the museum’s iconic masterpieces and hidden gems. The tour saves time and energy with a skip-the-line admission ticket, allowing you breeze past notoriously long entrance queues. No need to wonder what exactly it is you’re looking at: Your guide offers little-known facts and anecdotes about the gallery’s most compelling pieces.

data.name: Walking Private Tour of Accademia Gallery in Florence
data.description:
After meeting up with your guide and entering the gallery, you’ll start your visit with a tour of the Medici family’s collection. This powerful dynasty became a household name in Florence back in the 15th century, where they were originally a banking family before moving into politics. They amassed some incredible collectibles, including the most expensive violin in the world and the oldest piano around – you’ll see both during your tour.

From here, you’ll head into the Tribuna di De Fabris, a portion of the gallery that’s all about Michelangelo. You’ll know him best from his masterpiece in the Vatican, the frescoes in the Sistine Chapel. But he wasn’t a one-trick pony. He originally trained a sculptor, and the Accademia Gallery is home to his most famous marble creation, the statue of David. Your guide, who’s an expert in Renaissance art, will tell you all about the life of Michelangelo and the intricacies of working with Carrara marble, which was used to craft this iconic artwork.

data.name: Private Guided Visit to the Accademia and the Uffizi Gallery
data.description: Don't miss the chance to have a private visit of the most important Florentine museums, led by a professional local guide. At the Accademia Gallery, thanks to your private and professional guide, you can admire the wonderful statue of David, result of the genius of Michelangelo, together with other important works by the great artist, while at the Uffizi Gallery you will discover countless works of art among which the most loved painting in the world: the beautiful “Birth of Venus” by Botticelli. At the end of the tour, you can remain in the museum to explore further at your leisure. The guided visit can be booked in the following options: Accademia at 8:30am and Uffizi at 03:30pm

data.name: Florence Small-Group Duomo Tour with Cupola
data.description: To fully experience the majesty of Brunelleschi's famous dome, climb to the very top of the cupola that adorns Florence’s architectural gem. After touring the grand cathedral on a guided tour, climb the nearly 500 steps to the top, where you can enjoy panoramic city views as a reward. As you climb, learn about the Duomo’s remarkable engineering and admire Renaissance frescoes by Giorgio Vasari.

data.name: Private tour to Siena, San Gimignano & Chianti Landscapes
data.description: Meet your private driver at your hotel for a beautiful excursion through the delightful hills of the Chianti countryside,with an ever-changing scenery of vineyards and olive trees. Upon arrival in Siena, your guide will bring you on a private tour of the old city centre: walking along the small medieval streets, admiring the splendid palaces and Piazza del Campo, one of the most beautiful in the world, where you will find the Palazzo del Comune(exterior). Free time for lunch (not included). From Siena your private driver will bring you through a panoramic road where to admire the vineyards and olive groves in the heart of the Chianti territory. Along the way you could also admire the ancient fortified hamlet of Monteriggioni, a small jewel built during the thirteenth century and embraced by its still intact walls. You reach thenSanGimignano, another beautiful town, UNESCO world heritage, where you‘ll be given free time to visit the medieval town planning with the numerous and beautiful towers hence the name "Manhattan of the Middle Ages". Please note that the order of the visits may change

data.name: Tuscany wine tour
data.description: It’s a special tour for wine lovers Rates Adults: €224.00 Children: €54.00 Duration 7 hours About A special day in the wonderful Chianti countryside through the rolling hills. You’ll try deliciuos wines and along with wine you’ll be enjoyed in a unique environment where everything tells of the history, art and traditions of the farm’s wine. After lunch you will discover one of the most famous Medieval hilltop villages in Italy, SAN GIMIGNANO, where you can explore the maze of cobbled streets, the small squares and many local artisan shops. data.name: Tuscany: Chianti Tour + Medici Villa Wine Tasting
data.description:
Join an engaging trip behind the scenes of a lush vineyard and busy winery. The adventure starts in the courtyard of a grand villa and continues on a scenic Medicean terrace overlooking Florence and its Renaissance garden.

Guides will take you through the wine-making cellars and aging rooms, including a 17th-century orciaia, where the real magic happens. The tour wraps up with a delicious tasting session featuring three interpretations of Sangiovese, the renowned grape variety of Tuscany.

To complete the experience, don't miss the chance to taste the vineyard's own extra virgin olive oil paired with a board of Tuscan delights.

data.name: Chianti: Wine & Olive Oil Tasting with Guided Tour + Roundtrip from Florence
data.description:
Explore the world of authentic Tuscan wines and olive oil on the Chianti Wine & Olive Oil experience. A knowledgeable sommelier guides you through the scenic Chianti and Chianti Classico landscapes aboard a comfortable Mercedes Minibus.

This ride takes you through olive groves, cypress trees, and renowned vineyards, offering both comfort and captivating views.

Enter the world of wine, unraveling the complexities of acidity, taste, and food pairings. It's an enlightening exploration into the rich history and traditions of winemaking, fostering a deep appreciation for this ancient craft.

The tour includes a visit to an ancient noble estate's olive oil mill, where past and present harmonize. Witness the olive oil production process and taste the gourmet flavors crafted with passion and dedication.

Next, explore three distinct wineries and their cellars, gaining insight into diverse aging techniques and the unique flavors offered by Tuscan winemakers.

data.name: Florence: Small-Group Guided Tour
data.shortDescription: Explore the city's 15th-century palaces and history
data.description:
Explore Florence with a pleasant stroll through its cobblestone streets. Take in the beauty of the city's Roman origins and 15th-century palaces. Admire the historic Ponte Vecchio bridge and the beauty of the Uffizi courtyard, with Brunelleschi's Dome peeking above the "Gate of Paradise" of the Baptistery.

This walking tour offers a genuine taste of the Florentine lifestyle, enjoyed by thousands of tourists every year. With friendly local guides, embrace the allure and history of Florence for a day.

data.name: Textile Museum: Entry Ticket
data.shortDescription: Discover the wonders of fabric and fashion between past, present, and future
data.description:
The Textile Museum is a place for families, tourists, designers, stylists, and all fashion, costume and textile enthusiasts. 

The tour begins with the factory's spectacular boiler room where the steam generator that once powered Campolmi's textile machinery still stands. From there, the tour continues inside an atmospheric space where collections of antique textiles are displayed in rotation. The next section is dedicated to materials and processes, which explains textile fibres and their manufacturing process in a simple and clear way. 

The Textile Museum's first floor opens with a visit to the Prato textile city room, dedicated to local textile history, and continues with an engaging multimedia installation focusing on recent transformations of the district and the city. Finally, the tour concludes with two large 800-square-meter rooms that periodically host major temporary exhibitions.

data.name: Florence: Sunset Food and Wine Tour
data.shortDescription: Savor Florence's finest delicacies as the sun sets over the city
data.description:
Join a local food expert to visit wine bars, restaurants, and other spots that highlight the city’s best flavors.

The evening starts at a small bar in the Oltrarno neighborhood, where you’ll try bruschette, Tuscan salame, pecorino cheese, and a glass of Chianti Classico wine.

Next, stop at a wine window to enjoy a glass of Prosecco. Then, head to a local spot to learn how to make a Negroni, Florence’s signature cocktail. After mixing your drink, enjoy it with some freshly baked schiacciata flatbread.

Dinner includes a serving of fresh Tuscan pasta, followed by Florentine steak, a popular local dish. To end the night, take a short walk to a local gelateria for a scoop of gelato made with regional ingredients.

data.name: Florence: Small Group Guided Wine Making Workshop + Tasting
data.shortDescription: Taste six wines and blend your own creation
data.description:
Join a masterclass to create your wine. Taste six single-variety wines and learn about Tuscan winemaking. Blend your ideal wine and take home a personalized bottle.

In this small-group session, a wine expert will guide you through local traditions. Discover the aromas and characteristics of six different wines, then blend your favorites to create a wine that matches your taste.

During the blending activity, enjoy local foods and hear stories about Tuscany’s wine heritage. Finish by bottling your wine and designing a custom label to take home.

data.name: Private Tour: Accademia Gallery and City Tour
data.description: Explore the breathtaking beauty of Florence with a guided tour of the Accademia Gallery and its historic center! Our expert guide will lead you through the Accademia Gallery, where you can admire some of the most famous masterpieces in the world, including Michelangelo's famous David. The walking tour instead provides an overview of the main places in the historic center including the imposing Cathedral of Santa Maria del Fiore dominated by Brunelleschi's famous dome. Don't miss the opportunity to explore Florence and live an unforgettable experience!

data.name: Florence Day Trip: Pisa, San Gimignano, and Siena with Lunch
data.description: Departing from Florence, you'll reach Pisa. During this journey, you'll have the chance to admire the typical scenery of Tuscany, made of hills and cypresses. Once in Pisa, you'll spend your free time admiring the beauty of Piazza dei Miracoli. The view of Baptistery, Cathedral, and Leaning Tower will take your breath away. The white marble and the Leaning Tower will be the fantastic beginning of this day dedicated to Tuscany and some of its most beautiful and fascinating cities.Traveling through the lands of Chianti without stopping in San Gimignano, between Pisa and Siena, would mean not discovering the authentic Tuscany. The system of towers of San Gimignano tells the glories of the powerful families. Between saffron fields and typical indigenous vineyards, the city knows how to offer postcard views.Medieval city and UNESCO heritage, the elegant Siena welcomes you among the typical landscapes that embrace the art of the places. Already alive in the Etruscan era, Siena boasts very ancient origins. A strategic center for trade, the city was a reference during the Middle Ages and the streets show the signs of its rivalry with Florence. If you choose the tour with the walking guided tour included, one of our best local guides will take you to know the Duomo, the Baptistery of San Giovanni, and the Torre del Mangia, with its history halfway between reality and legend. Moreover, if you want to see the interior of the Cathedral of Siena, you can include the ticket at the moment of reservation.After lunch, you'll reach a winery in the Chianti Area, where you'll join a wine tasting. Here you'll have also the chance to buy typical Tuscan wine and products.
