data.name: Wine enthusiast's dinner at Diadema Wine Cellar
data.description: Wine and Olive Oil are the essence and the two kings of Tuscan food and wine culture. There is no Tuscan recipe that doesn't include olive oil in its preparation and doesn't consider a specific wine to be paired with. With this fine dinner experience, you will discover all the secrets of the production of Wine and Olive Oil while visiting and dining at a boutique Winery in the Chianti Wine region. A wine expert will welcome you and take you for the ancient cellar visit, still used today for wine production. The sommelier will explain the sophisticated techniques of wine making and teach you to distinguish the different and various scents and flavors that each wine presents.

data.name: The Mall Outlet Florence from Rome: Private Shopping Tour
data.description: Italy is famous around the world for its fashion, so add some quality, made-in-Italy items to your wardrobe with a private shopping trip from Rome to The Mall, a luxury outlet in the scenic Tuscan hills. Shop brands like Gucci, Prada, Valentino, and Versace all in one place while enjoying discounts of 20%-50% off retail prices. Round-trip transportation by minivan and a personal shopping assistant make it easy to bring Italian style back home.

data.name: Florence Santa Croce Basilica Guided Tour
data.description: Learn secrets of Santa Croce Basilica that you wouldn’t likely learn if you visited on your own on this guided tour Florence’s “Temple of the Italian Glories.” See the tombs of luminaries including Michelangelo, Galileo, and Machiavelli, admire museum-worthy frescoes by Giotto, and learn about the design of this Franciscan jewel.

data.name: Val D'Orcia: Tuscan Wine, Food & Hidden Villages Adventure
data.description: Dive into the enchanting UNESCO wonderland of Val D'Orcia! Start your day soaking up Tuscany’s breathtaking views and exploring the hidden gems of Montalcino, home to the legendary Brunello wine. Savor a delicious Tuscan lunch with pasta, local cheese, and olive oil in Pienza, famous for its "pecorino" cheese and timeless charm. Wrap up with a wine tasting in Montepulciano. With comfy transport and culinary delights, this tour is the ultimate Tuscan escapade for foodies and wine lovers.

data.name: Florence: Wine Tastings + Minivan Tour
data.description:
Ready for a scenic journey soaked in Tuscan beauty and wine culture? Dive headfirst into the heart of Chianti on a minivan tour through rolling vineyards and traditional wineries!

This tasty tour uncovers family-run cellars and classic tastes, offering a chance to try Chianti Classico, Riserva, and other exceptional wines.

Each taste is perfectly paired with a delightful appetizer, made from locally sourced products. Why not hand-select your favourite bottles from the tour to take home?

This adventure is perfect for wine lovers, and those seeking a romantic escape filled with delectable food and drink.

data.name: OT Florence Boboli Garden Tour
data.description: TOUR HIGHLIGHTS • Join a guided tour of the royal Boboli Gardens in Florence • Stroll through acres of gardens, trees, fountains and terraces with a knowledgeable guide • Learn the history of the 16th-century Italianate gardens behind the Pitti Palace - Boboli is one of the most elegant and ancient Italian-style gardens. It has a breath-taking, landscaped garden, which is an open-air museum, filled with ancient statues, fountains, and an incredible artificial grotto designed by Niccolò Tribolo and after his death, the works were completed by his collaborators: Giorgio Vasari, Bartolomeo Ammannati, Bernardo Buontalenti, and others.

data.name: Florence Duomo Tour with Dome Climb and Skip the Line Ticket
data.description: Make your experience of Florence’s Duomo one to remember with skip-the-line tickets and the opportunity to climb Brunelleschi's grand dome. You’ll ascend the steps into the famous dome to immerse yourself in its history and see its frescoes up close, while enjoying panoramic views of the city.

data.name: Florence Boboli Garden Small-Group Tour
data.description: Visit the famous Boboli Gardens, an oasis in the heart of Florence, on an express guided tour of the Pitti Palace’s magnificent gardens. Built for Cosimo I de' Medici in the 16th century, the gardens feature exquisite landscaping with a variety of plant life, fountains, and statues by master artists including Michelangelo. Your guide shares stories about the garden’s design and architects for a comprehensive overview.

data.name: Florence Evening Food Tour with Florentine Steak and Tuscan Wine
data.description: Navigating Florence’s food scene on your own can mean missing the city’s most genuine flavors. With 14 tastings at 5 local restaurants and a super foodie tour guide, we solve that problem for you. This tour includes Florence’s best wine, gelato, and the legendary Florentine steak. Visit hidden eateries and even sip wine from one of the city’s historic wine windows, guided by a foodie who knows all the culinary secrets.Tour OverviewMeet your guide in Piazza della Signoria to begin experiencing Florence’s vibrant food culture on this 3-hour evening walking tour, perfect for food lovers and curious travelers. With a passionate local guide, you’ll enjoy authentic Tuscan dishes like ribollita, handmade pasta, and the legendary Florentine steak, all paired with local wines.From wine windows to gelato, this tour blends traditional flavors with Florence’s cool, laid-back charm for an unforgettable culinary adventure. Your tour will end at an award winning gelato shop in Santo Spirito.Florence Food Tour DescriptionYour 3-hour food tour includes:Small-group walking tour5 wonderful stops with 10 tastings and 4 glasses of wineA traditional dinner with Florentine steakVisit a traditional wine windowAward winning gelato for dessertA passionate, English-speaking foodie guideMaximum of 12 peopleTuscan Antipasti and AperitivoYour journey begins with a stroll through Florence’s historic streets, where your guide leads you to a classic buchetta del vino, the city’s famous wine windows that date back to the Renaissance. Legend has it that this particular buchetta is the oldest in town, and even Michelangelo himself would frequent the window! Sip on a glass of wine paired with a crunchy tarallo, a perfect introduction to Tuscany’s knack for simple yet unforgettable flavors.A Taste of Tuscany’s Comfort ClassicsNext, settle in at a cozy spot for a true Tuscan experience, where the focus is all about hearty, seasonal comfort food. In summer, you’ll savor the fresh flavors of pappa al pomodoro, a tomato and bread soup that’s bursting with Mediterranean warmth. In winter, enjoy the rustic richness of ribollita, Florence’s famous bread-and-vegetable stew. A spread of pecorino cheese, cured meats, and the bold flavors of chicken liver pâté crostini rounds out the tasting, all perfectly paired with a glass of locally sourced wine. It’s a feast of traditional flavors that feels like a warm Florentine welcome.Cross the Ponte Vecchio to Florence’s Coolest Food DistrictAs the sun sets, you’ll cross Ponte Vecchio, a bridge steeped in history, and head into the trendy Oltrarno neighborhood, where Florence’s vibrant food culture comes alive. Your next stop serves up fresh, handmade pasta like raviolo, crafted with a simplicity that lets the quality of the ingredients shine. It’s a quick tasting that’s packed with flavor, giving you just enough to leave you wanting more. Oltrarno’s lively streets, buzzing with local charm, set the perfect backdrop for this mid-tour treat.Florentine Steak DinnerThe evening peaks with a sit-down dinner featuring one of Tuscany’s most celebrated dishes: Florentine steak. This massive, tender cut is cooked to perfection—crispy on the outside and red in the center, just the way locals love it. Served alongside roasted potatoes and paired with a robust Tuscan red wine, this meal is a celebration of Florence’s deep-rooted culinary traditions. It’s a moment to slow down, savor the incredible flavors, and soak in the lively atmosphere of a classic Florentine eatery.End on a Sweet Note with Florence’s Finest GelatoNo food tour is complete without dessert, and Florence doesn’t disappoint. End your evening at a beloved local gelateria, where you’ll indulge in the creamiest gelato made with the finest ingredients. Whether you choose a classic flavor like pistachio or venture into something more unique, every bite reflects the artistry of Italian gelato making. It’s the sweetest way to wrap up a night filled with authentic tastes, local stories, and the kind of food memories you’ll treasure long after you’ve left Florence.This tour is Florence at its best—relaxed, flavorful, and unforgettable. Perfect for anyone who wants to experience the city the way locals do, one incredible bite at a time.

data.name: Boboli Gardens: Reserved Entrance
data.shortDescription: A lush sculpture park with views of Tuscan countryside
data.description:
A wonderfully landscaped sculpture park behind the Pitti Palace, Boboli Gardens is an extravagant mix of nature, architecture, and sculpture – as well as various museums; it's many attractions rolled into one. 

These Boboli Gardens tickets allow you to skip the line, and also give access to the Porcelain Museum and the nearby Bardini Gardens. A trip here is a journey deep into the heart of Renaissance perfection.

data.name: Orsanmichele Church and Museum: Entry Ticket
data.shortDescription: Discover Florence's unique blend of civic, artistic, and spiritual history
data.description:
Explore The Museum, located between Palazzo della Signoria and the Cathedral of Santa Maria del Fiore. 

The first floor features original sculptures by renowned Florentine artists from the fifteenth and sixteenth centuries, adding historical charm to the building.

But the art experience doesn't stop there! Head to the second floor for a breathtaking panoramic view of Florence that will leave a lasting impression. 

Continue your journey to discover the marble tabernacle of the Madonna delle Grazie in the in-house church—a place of worship where holy masses are held.

data.name: Siena & San Gimignano: Day Trip from Florence + Dinner
data.shortDescription: Explore the beautiful landscapes of two UNESCO World Heritage Sites
data.description:
Prepare for a trip through Siena, San Gimignano, and the Chianti countryside. The adventure begins in Florence with a comfy, air-conditioned minivan, guided by a friendly English-speaking driver and tour leader.

Start with Siena, a city rich in history. Explore the famous Piazza del Campo, known for the Palio horse race, and stroll through medieval Contrade in quiet backstreets. Each corner has a story, ending with a taste of local cuisine.

Then, be amazed by San Gimignano, known for its medieval buildings. After free time to explore, enjoy a beautiful Tuscan sunset over the hills.

The highlight? A traditional Tuscan dinner with a wine tasting in the Chianti countryside. Explore centuries-old cellars and learn about wine production. The best part? This all-encompassing experience leaves the morning open for more adventures.

data.name: Palazzo Vecchio, Arnolfo Tower, Museum: Entry Ticket + Audio Guide
data.shortDescription: One of the most famous symbols of Florence
data.description: Skip the line and explore Palazzo Vecchio, the symbol of civic power in Florence for centuries, on a audio-guided tour. Climb the Tower of Palazzo Vecchio for fantastic views over Florence, and visit the museum that's still the seat of the local city government.

data.name: Day Tour from Florence with lunch and wine-tasting in Chianti
data.description: Wine lovers, this trip into Tuscany from Florence is designed just for you. You’ll leave the city behind and head to the Chianti region, known around the world for its red wines. But you won’t just learn about them, you’ll have the chance to sample some, too. Enzo, one of our expert local guides, says “Chianti wine is known for its deep red colour and flavour profile that contains dried herbs, balsamic vinegar and red fruits. See if you can taste these traits when you sample them.”You’ll be picked up from the meeting point in Florence and driven to Tuscany and the Chianti region – the views on this journey are seriously good. Your first stop is the Medieval village of Greve, where you’ll look around its cute, cobbled streets. Then, you’ll head to Montefioralle, which has been perfectly preserved since the 12th century. Chianti Classico, one of the most iconic Italian red wines, has a black rooster on its label – you’ll hear the backstory for this during your time in Montefioralle.From here, you’ll make tracks to a family-run wine estate for lunch and a wine-tasting session. The cellars here have been around since Medieval times, and they use oak barrels to do a lot of their aging. You’ll learn all about this before sitting down to eat and drink. Food-wise, you can expect Italian classics prepped with ingredients grown on the property. Alongside this, you’ll have three different Chiantis to sample. This region is also known for its olive oil, so you can try some of that while you’re here, too.

data.name: Florence city pass for 5 days with Uffizi, Accademia and Dome
data.description: Florence is exceptionally rich in museums and monuments that you absolutely can't miss, but visiting them all requires time and careful planning. Discover all the best this extraordinary city has to offer stress-free and without wasting your time!Your 5-day city pass includes skip-the-line entrance to Florence's most visited museums. Avoid wasting hours in queues and conserve your energy to fully enjoy the masterpieces that await you!Discover all about the works by some of the greatest artists of all time thanks to the audio guide on your smartphone, which will accompany you during the visit and offer you insights into the main attractions included in your city pass.You'll visit up to 9 museums according to the schedule below:Day 1Uffizi Gallery at 9.30amDay 2Boboli and Bardini GardensPitti Palace and Tesoro dei GranduchiDay 3Florence Cathedral and Brunelleschi's Dome at 10.00amAccademia Gallery at 11.30amDay 4/5National Archeological MuseumOpificio delle Pietre Dure Museum

data.name: Private Chianti Villages and San Gimignano with Cooking Class
data.description:
Embark on a private journey through the heart of Chianti along the iconic Chiantigiana Road, with scenic views of rolling hills, vineyards, and olive groves. Before leaving Florence, we will stop at Piazzale Michelangelo to admire the stunning view of the city.

Our first stop is Greve in Chianti, where we will visit the main square and a famous grocery store to sample typical Tuscan products like salami and cheese. We will then continue through picturesque villages like Montefioralle and Badia di Passignano.

Next, we’ll visit the medieval town of San Gimignano, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, known for its 13 towers. After free time to explore, we’ll head to a local farmhouse for a 2-hour group cooking class, followed by a delicious lunch and generous wine tasting.

At the end of this unforgettable experience, we will return to Florence.

data.name: Florence Hills Private E-Bike Tour with Gelato
data.description: Escape the hustle, bustle, and oppressive heat of central Florence and head for the cooler, quieter hills with this private e-bike tour. Take on the slopes without breaking a sweat thanks to an electric bike, and listen as your guide tells you about the history of outlying villages like Fiesole and Vincigliata, where Leonardo da Vinci once escaped the city. Relax over an authentic gelato before heading back to the city with your guide.

data.name: Florence Skip the line Uffizi Gallery with Vasari Corridor Access
data.description:
Explore Florence’s art and history with a guided tour of the Uffizi Gallery and the exclusive Vasari Corridor. Skip the line at the Uffizi to admire masterpieces by Michelangelo, Raphael, and Leonardo da Vinci, tracing Italian art’s evolution from the Middle Ages to the Renaissance with expert guides.

The Vasari Corridor, a hidden gem designed in 1564 by Giorgio Vasari for the Medici family, connects Palazzo Pitti to Palazzo Vecchio via the Ponte Vecchio. Closed to the public since 2016 for extensive restorations, the corridor reopens in 2025, offering a rare chance to rediscover its architectural brilliance and historical significance.

With its eagerly awaited reopening, you can now walk in the footsteps of the Medici family, enjoy stunning views of Florence, and uncover the stories of the dynasty that shaped the city’s history. Don’t miss this unique opportunity to experience Florence like never before!

data.name: Uffizi and Accademia semi-private guided tour
data.description: Discover two of the most visited art galleries in the world in the company of a local guide. Skip the line at the museum entrance to admire superb masterpieces and learn more about the art and history of the Italian Renaissance.You'll start the tour from the Uffizi Gallery, where you will be able to admire works by artists such as Michelangelo with his Tondo Doni, the only painting made on wood by the Florentine genius, Botticelli and his two most famous paintings, The Birth of Venus and The Spring, Caravaggio and the shield with the head of Meduse, Leonardo da Vinci, Raphael, Giotto and many others.The guide will then take you to the Accademia Gallery following a route through the wonderful historic center of Florence. The gallery houses one of the greatest collections of sculptures by Michelangelo including the iconic David, one of the emblems of the Renaissance and a symbol of Florence and Italy all over the world. At the end of the guided tour, you can stay inside and continue to explore the museum in total freedom.

data.name: Family Friendly Tuscany Tour from Florence
data.description: Enjoy a family friendly, alcohol-free tour of Tuscany from Florence. Visit a local farm for a tasting of premium balsamic vinegar, olive oil, honey and local specialties. Then, explore San Gimignano.

data.name: Uffizi Galleries Skip-the-Line Ticket and Audioguide
data.description:
The Galleria dei Offices is without doubt the most prestigious museum in Florence. Quite an achievement considering the cultural offer of the Tuscan capital.

This gallery houses some of the most beautiful masterpieces of the Renaissance, including the famous Birth of Venus, a 15th century painting by Boticelli. There are also works by Michelangelo, Caravaggio, Titian and Leonardo da Vinci. This museum is also known for housing older works, from the Middle Ages and even from Antiquity.

Thanks to your host, you will be able to access the museum quickly and make the most of your visit.

data.name: Skip-the-Line Florence Highlights and David Walking Tour
data.description: A guided walking tour Florence discovering the main attractions such as Piazza della Signoria, the Ponte Vecchio, Michelangelo's David and hidden gems of this magic city. Possibility for private tour upgrade.

data.name: Florence Silent Disco Evening Tour
data.description: Opt for a different start to your night out in Florence, and dance your way around Florence with this silent disco. You’ll meet a local guide, plug in some headphones, and explore the city’s tucked-away corners against a backdrop of tunes. Plenty of insider tips and an aperitivo break for an Aperol spritz are among the perks.

data.name: From Florence:Siena, San Gimignano & Pisa Private Tour by Minivan
data.description: During this private tour in a comfortable minivan, you will explore the breathtaking towns of Siena, San Gimignano, and Pisa.In about 1 hour we will arrive in Siena and you'll meet your guide for a tour of the old town. You will see the famous Piazza del Campo, where the renowned Palio takes place every year. Before leaving you will have some free time to walk around the typical medieval alleys.Our tour will continue towards San Gimignano, where you will have free time to explore the city center on your own. On our way from Siena to San Gimignano we will also make a quick photo stop in Monteriggioni.The last gem of our tour will be Pisa: the city is known for its beautiful monuments. You will take a walk in Piazza dei Miracoli and will be able to admire the 11th-century Cathedral, the Baptistery, and the famous Leaning Tower (no tickets included). Before going back to Florence, you will have free time to take amazing pictures and do some shopping.

data.name: Guided tour with a private laboratory experience
data.description: During this tour you will walk for about 2 hours together with a professional specialized tour guide in the Oltrarno district in Florence, across Ponte Vecchio. This area is famous because of the presence of many craftmen's worshop. You will visit these workshop with the possibility to see how an artisan works and creates his products. Time for a lunch break choosing a typical trattoria or just getting a sandwich from the local bars or bakery. Afterwards, you will attend a laboratory of a very special kind of mosaic together with a florentine English speaking artist, who will share her experience with you and teach you how to make a mosaic. You will create your own art work and you will take it with you as a very special souvenir of your holiday. After the laboratory a private driver will pick you up and drive you back at the hotel/apartments.

data.name: Uffizi Gallery Priority Access Timed Entry Admission Ticket
data.description:
The Uffizi Gallery is one of the most renowned art museums in the world and, as a result, long lines are common, with many visitors eager to see inside. Save yourself a few hours of wait time with this assisted service, and head straight in when you arrive.

The Uffizi comprises work from Ancient Greece to the 18th century, but its true gems hail from the Renaissance era. The 45 rooms are arranged chronologically, so you can begin exploring through the early Renaissance first, pausing to admire work from Giotto and Fra Angelico, before heading to the masterpieces of the High Renaissance. See Botticelli’s "Birth of Venus", Michelangelo’s "Doni Tondo" and da Vinci’s famed "Annunciation". Pass by Titian’s Venetian paintings and head upstairs to check out Caravaggio.

Roam around the museum for as long as you like, resting your legs at the rooftop café (own expense), if you wish.

data.name: PRIVATE Full-Day GUIDED Tour: Siena, San Gimignano and Chianti
data.description: • ESPERIENZA PER IL TUO GRUPPO PRIVATO • This GUIDED tour will take you in the morning to visit the city of Siena accompanied by an expert official guide. The afternoon will be dedicated to the discovery of the historical wine territory of Chianti. You will have the opportunity to visit some of the most famous vineyards, or small family-owned businesses, see their cellars and taste their excellent food and wines. Lastly, explore the wonderful medieval city of San Gimignano, considered one of the most beautiful historic Italian villages. Add an optional, unforgettable lunch to savor traditional Tuscan wines and specialties in a local organic farm or winery! • 9hr Full-Day private tour of Tuscany from Florence • Licensed TOUR GUIDE in Siena included • Visit the medieval cities of Siena, Monteriggioni, San Gimignano and Fonterutoli • Craft Chianti Classico wine at a local vineyard • Private transportation by Mercedes Minivan air-conditioned

data.name: Florence Small-Group Home Cooking Class With Market Visit
data.description: Pasta is a pillar of Italian gastronomy, but recipes can be closely guarded. Get exclusive guidance in preparing ravioli and fettuccine from scratch during this small-group cooking experience. Begin with a shopping excursion in the bustling Oltrarno neighborhood. Then, prepare classic Florentine dishes alongside a local chef in a professionally fitted-out home kitchen. End with lunch or dinner (depending on your start time) paired with unlimited Tuscan wines.

data.name: Chianti Wine Tour in Vintage Fiat 500 from Florence
data.description: Make your journey just as exciting as your destination on a private 3-hour Tuscany tour in a vintage Fiat 500. You'll indulge in wine tasting at a family-run vineyard in Chianti without having to worry about driving afterward—your private guide takes the wheel to allow you to soak up the scenery.

data.name: Uffizi Gallery Private Guided Tour
data.description: The Uffizi Gallery is one of the most renowned art museums in the world, home to an extraordinary collection of masterpieces from the Renaissance and beyond. Located in the heart of Florence, the museum houses iconic works by Leonardo da Vinci, Michelangelo, Botticelli, Caravaggio, Raphael, and many more.With our private guided tour, you’ll experience the Uffizi in an exclusive and immersive way. Your expert guide will lead you through the museum’s most famous rooms, including those featuring Botticelli’s "The Birth of Venus" and "Primavera," Leonardo’s "Annunciation," and Caravaggio’s dramatic masterpieces.This personalized experience allows you to explore the rich history, techniques, and secrets behind each work of art at your own pace, with the opportunity to ask questions and dive deeper into the stories behind the paintings.Whether you're an art enthusiast or a first-time visitor, our private Uffizi tour offers a unique and unforgettable journey through one of the greatest artistic treasures in the world.

data.name: Private Florence Cooking Class and Lunch at a Tuscany Farmhouse
data.description:
If you're looking for private cooking lessons, our incredible full-day tour starts in Florence and includes a tour of the historic central market as well as hands-on teaching in a typical farmhouse situated in the breathtaking Tuscan countryside.

You will visit the famous San Lorenzo food market, where you will interact with Tuscan-born farmers, including bakers and butchers. Locals shop here, and you may peruse with them an extensive selection of cheeses, olives, fruits and vegetables, as well as balsamic vinegar.

Then your guide will take you to a state-of-the-art kitchen. It is there, in a gorgeous Tuscan farmhouse on a private estate, that the class will begin. This goes beyond simple demonstration. Under the guidance of the skilled chef, you will prepare a traditional four-course Tuscan meal on your own. He'll show you how to make rich beef tomato sauce, pasta made with farm-fresh eggs, a delicious bruschetta, roast pork loin with potatoes and tiramisu. Chianti wine is included.

data.name: From Florence: Pisa, Siena, San Gimignano and Chianti Day Trip (with Lunch and Wine Tasting)
data.description: You want to feast your eyes and tantalize your taste buds with the delights of Tuscany in one day? This tour is for you! Your day will begin with a free tour of Pisa, where you will have time to admire the magnificent cathedral, the baptistery, the monumental cemetery and the famous Leaning tower of Pisa.Afterwards, you'll move to a Typical Winery in the Chianti Hills, on the slopes of San Gimignano, where you will enjoy a typical Tuscan lunch and a local wine tasting.After lunch you will discover one of the most beautiful medieval villages perched, San Gimignano: the Medieval Mahanattan, where you can explore the maze of cobbled streets, small squares and many local craft stores.Your trip will continue with a panoramic view of the Chianti countryside before arriving in Siena, where a professional guide will let you discover the city's most important squares, from Piazza del Campo to the Cathedral, passing through the beautiful "contrade" that characterize this city.At the end of the guided tour, you will have free time to enjoy a cup of coffee, taste Pan Forte (typical local cake) and have some shopping in typical local shops. Your return to Florence will have a magnificent sunset as a backdrop, a perfect ending to an unforgettable day spent in Tuscany.

data.name: Palazzo Vecchio Skip-the-Line Admission Ticket
data.description: Don’t waste a minute of your Florence vacation waiting in line. Instead, sail past the lines for Palazzo Vecchio with a skip-the-line admission ticket that grants you fast-track access to the 13th-century monument. Plus, your ticket includes an audio guide that provides context guaranteed to enhance your experience.

data.name: Express guided tour of Florence Duomo with Skip-the-Line Access
data.description: Steer clear of the long queues and take advantage of a privileged access to the majestic Florence Duomo, the architectural masterpiece symbol of the city! Don’t miss the chance to learn all about it on this guided tour with exclusive access!This incredible feat of engineering required a whole new process for its construction! Your guide will explain you everything while you're touring the inside and the outside. Brunelleschi's innovative approach involved vaulting the dome space without any scaffolding as he used a double shell with a space in between.Inside, the Duomo is no less impressive, with elaborate marble floors mirroring its exterior and beautiful frescos lining the dome, made by Vasari, namely the Last Judgement.This tour also includes entry tickets to the Museo della Misericordia, which displays some works of art from the Renaissance. You will be able to access the museum independently after the tour.

data.name: Florence Cooking Class : Pizza & Gelato Making Experience
data.description: Embark on an unforgettable Italian culinary adventure, where your journey isn't truly complete until you've savored the authentic local cuisine. However, the pinnacle of pleasure lies in mastering the art of crafting two iconic Italian delights: pizza and gelato.Italy's global reputation for pizza is unparalleled, boasting a myriad of types that make choosing the best a delightful challenge. Yet, what truly distinguishes Italian pizza is its exceptional dough. Join us on this tour, guided by a skilled chef who will unveil the secrets to creating the perfect, irresistibly flavorful pizza dough.Now, let's talk gelato. While there's ice cream, there's also Italian gelato—the latter not only tastes good but transcends into an experience of incredible flavor. Seize this exclusive opportunity to witness the intricate process behind the making of authentic Italian gelato. Don't let this chance slip away!Cap off your experience by indulging in the delectable dishes you've personally prepared, paired with a glass of exquisite Tuscan wine. We eagerly await your presence! IMPORTANT INFORMATION:- Vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-free options are available upon request.- Kindly inform us in advance of any allergies.- Regrettably, pets are not permitted.- While we're continually striving to enhance our services, we're currently unable to accommodate clients in wheelchairs.- For your safety, closed-toe shoes are recommended.- Please note that this class is not suitable for children under the age of 12.

data.name: Accademia Gallery: Priority Entry Ticket + Audio Guide
data.shortDescription: See Michelangelo’s "David" and explore other Renaissance sculptures
data.description:
Skip long lines in Florence by opting for fast-track entry to the Accademia Gallery. Secure your chance to see Michelangelo’s David without the wait.

David stands 17 feet tall. Stand only feet away from this famous masterpiece and observe its detail and artistry up close. Take 45 minutes to an hour to view David and other Renaissance works.

data.name: Florence: Authentic Italian Dinner With Wine Pairings
data.description: Dine like a local with a 4-course dinner in the home of a Florence resident on this small-group dining experience. Enjoy authentic local dishes, including traditional Italian appetizers, a course of handmade pasta, and a refreshing glass of ammazzacaffè, all paired with regional wines that come recommended by a member of the Italian Sommelier Association.

data.name: Honeymooners in Florence with Professional Photographer & Driver

Forget selfies! The latest Tour accessory is a professional photographer!

At Least 100 Digital Images Included!

During your private Honeymooners Florence Tour you will explore the best highlights of Florence with the guidance and experience of a professional English-speaking driver, while a personal photographer captures your memories for you.

data.name: Exclusive Evening Tour of Michelangelo's David
data.description:
Your journey begins with a private viewing of Michelangelo's iconic masterpiece, David, basking in the serene ambiance of the evening. You'll also have the chance to explore the four evocative Prisoners sculptures, delve into the fascinating Music Instrument Room, and marvel at the intricate plaster casts that reveal the artistic process behind some of the world's most renowned sculptures.

After the guided tour, you are welcome to continue exploring the museum at your own pace, soaking in the beauty and history of the Accademia Gallery in a tranquil, unhurried setting. Don't miss this chance to experience one of Florence's greatest treasures in a way few others can.

data.name: Chianti Private Tuk-Tuk Tour with Wine Tasting from Florence
data.description: Discover the Tuscan countryside in style on a private tuk-tuk tour of Chianti from Florence, zipping through three charming villages in a classic Ape Calessino. Your guide takes the lead, ensuring stunning views and perfect photo stops along the way. Enjoy a leisurely lunch complete with wine and olive oil tastings—a true taste of Tuscany.

data.name: Florence: Sant'Ambrogio Grocery Market Small-Group Food Tour
data.description: While Italian cuisine is popular around the world, each area of Italy has its own culinary traditions and unique tastes. On this half-day small-group food tour, explore one of Florence’s food markets with a locally born chef, learning about Tuscan cuisine as you visit various food stalls and sample locally sourced dishes.

data.name: Florence Small-Group Winery and Lunch Morning Tour
data.description: Discover the inspiring landscapes and famous flavors of the Chianti wine region on a small-group tour from Florence. Enjoy leisure time to explore the charming medieval town of San Gimignano with helpful pointers from your guide. Visit local wineries for tours, followed by a tasting of renowned Chianti varietals along with a traditional Tuscan lunch.

data.name: Duomo Cathedral audio guided tour with local expert commentary
data.description: Enjoy a visit to the Cathedral of Santa Maria del Fiore, the most important building in the heart of Florence!You'll skip the line and enter the Cathedral immediately. Inside, you'll enjoy a multilingual audio-guided experience, available in 15 languages, allowing you to explore the monument at your own pace while learning its fascinating history and artistic significance.The Duomo is the third-largest church in the world and was the largest in Europe at the time of its construction in the 15th century. You'll be enchanted by the sophistication of the polychrome marble on the facade and by the majesty of the dome designed by Brunelleschi, which continues to dominate the Florence skyline.An expert will be present throughout the visit to provide support, ensure a smooth experience, and offer further insights or explanations as needed.

data.name: Traditional Tuscan Cooking Class in Florence
data.description:
What better way to explore a city than by discovering its cuisine first hand? Put on a chef's hat for the day and learn how to make classic dishes, local specialties and impressive plates with our expert hosts. Sign up for one of our fun, immersive cooking classes and discover a new hidden talent!

Nothing ever tastes better than ‘mama’s’ cooking and in your host, Patrizia's, home you’ll get all the hearty Italian home cooking you could ever need!Get ready to learn how to make rustic local dishes from scratch. Roll out and stretch fresh pasta and pizza dough between your own floury fingers and enjoy the satisfaction of eating what you cooked in true, Tuscan style. Make sure you save some room for dessert as we all know that no Italian dinner is complete without La Dolce Vita!

data.name: Montalcino, Orcia Valley, Pienza Wine and Cheese from Florence
data.description: Discover some of the highlights of Tuscany on this day trip from Florence by coach. Visit historical hill towns Pienza, Montalcino, and Montepulciano; admire the gorgeous, vineyard-covered scenery of Orcia Valley (Val d’Orcia); and enjoy cheese and wine tastings as you stop at local wineries and other venues. It’s a great day out in the Italian countryside.

data.name: Florence to Venice: The Floating City
data.description: Discover the magical city over the water, just a short drive away from Florence. Wandering through the maze of alleys and narrow streets of Venice is an experience that you will not forget easily..So get aboard our comfortable GT coach and get ready to enter another world. Florence and Venice are equally beautiful but at the same time poles apart as for artistic heritage and architectural style. And, what is more, in Venice the main means of transport is a gondola or a vaporetto, meaning that the city has been entirely built on water! You will be amazed by the wealth of art and of elegant palaces dotting the city centre, a real feast for the eyes and a triumph of Baroque style and Rococo. Your tour leader will take you directly to the heart of the city itself: the majestic Piazza San Marco, housing the luxurious and radiant St Marks’Basilica, an incredible example of Venetian Gothic and Byzantine style architecture. Admire the colorful mosaics decorating the church as well as the incredible triumph of details decorating the façade. Just a short walk from the Basilica, there is the elegant Palazzo Ducale, a real masterpiece in terms of elegance and grandeur. Actually, it is no coincidence that this majestic building represented for centuries the seat of the Venetian political power! Finally, discover Venice from the most natural point of view: on board of a gondola (optional activity)! You will be stunned by the reflections of the palaces overlooking the canals, as well as by the incredible skills of balance displayed by your personal gondoliere. Finally, meet again your tour leader at the end of the day, and get back to Florence full of happy memories.

data.name: Vivaldi's Four Seasons: Cortile di Palazzo Medici Riccardo
data.description: The Firenze Academy Ensemble will perform Vivaldi's 'Four Seasons' in the wonderful atmosphere of the Cortile di Palazzo Medici Riccardo.

data.name: Best of Florence: Walking Tour & Uffizi Gallery Audio Guided Visit led by Tour Leader
data.description: This tour combines a 2.5-hour walking tour of Florence’s historic center with a 2-hour audio-guided visit to the renowned Uffizi Gallery.In the morning, your tour leader will guide you through the city's most iconic landmarks, part of the UNESCO World Heritage Site, sharing insights into Florence’s rich artistic and architectural heritage. For both parts of the tour we provide the Audio Guide in your native language, and our tour leader will be happy to answer your questions in either English or Italian.After the walking tour, you’ll have a few hours of free time to relax, enjoy lunch, or continue exploring the city on your own.In the afternoon, your Florentine experience continues with an audio-guided visit to the Uffizi Gallery, home to Italy’s most important Renaissance art collection and one of the world’s most celebrated museums.

data.name: Florence by Night Walking Tour
data.description: Make the most of your time in Florence by stretching your sightseeing into the evening hours with this walking tour. Avoid the midday heat and crowds and join your guide for a stroll through the Renaissance old town after sundown, stopping to admire A-list sights like the Duomo, Piazza della Signoria, and Ponte Vecchio. Learn about Florentine history and culture and stop to snap photos of the city by moonlight.

data.name: Explore Florence Highlights including the 'David': Private Tour
data.description: Discover the highlights of Florence and follow an expert and entertaining tour guide to the most significant places through the historical centre and learn about the amazing history of the city from the time it was the capital of the Renaissance to the time it became the capital of early unified Italy. On your private half-day tour, you will: Begin your tour at Galleria dell'Accademia (Accademia Gallery), the home to the largest collection of Michelangelo's sculptures; Admire "The David" and marvel at the elegance and details of this 5.17-metre (17 ft 0 in) marble sculpture; Learn why Michelangelo is considered a genius and see traces of his sculptural technique in the chisel marks of the unfinished sculptures of the "Slaves"; Enjoy a walking tour of Florence's highlights, including the magnificent Duomo (Cathedral of Santa Maria del Fiore) and the famed baptistry with its gilded 'Gates of Paradise' doors; Learn about Italian leatherwork, and discover the best places to shop in the city; Explore the historical political heart of Florence with the medieval castle-like Palazzo Vecchio and the elegant RenaissanceUffizi Gallery buildings; Admire the beautiful sculptures in the Loggia dei Lanzi outdoor Sculpture gallery, including Cennini's Perseus holding the head of Medusa; End your tour on the Ponte Vecchio, Florence's most famous and ancientbridge over the ArnoRiver. Your tour begins in the prestigious Accademia Gallery, where you will enjoy timed entrance tickets to the museum, and explore stunning artwork, including Michelangelo's David.Then see the religious centre of the city: admire the Duomo, whose impressive Dome was designed by Brunelleschi, and the Baptistery of Saint John, one of the oldest buildings in Florence. From the religious centre, you will walk to the political centre, and enjoy a pleasant stroll through Piazza Della Signoria, surrounded by its ancient buildings and the Loggia Dei Lanzi. In this open-air museum, we will see original masterpieces by Giambologna and Cellini. From there, you'll cross the famous Ponte Vecchio, the medieval bridge on the Arno River. This half-day tour of Florence's Renaissance artwork and architecture is a must for all visitors. Please note: that there is often a long line to enter into the Duomo of Florence. If the line is too long you will not visit the interior of the Cathedral on tour, and your guide will give you tips on the best time to return to avoid standing in line.

data.name: Skip-the-Line Accademia Gallery of Florence

As well as avoiding lines, tour the gallery with a guide and learn things about the paintings that you may otherwise have missed. Plus, choose from several departure times to suit your schedule.

data.name: From Florence: Cinque Terre & Pisa Day Trip
data.description: The Ligurian coastline, home to a cluster of picturesque Italian villages—Cinqueterre—usually requires several days or more. Ideal for travelers short on time, this one-day extravaganza covers the region's highlights on an excursion from Florence. Travel by coach through the Tuscan countryside, then ride a train across sea cliffs. Free time is included, plus an optional walk. You’ll also get a chance to unwind along scenic Fegina Beach.

data.name: Full-Day Cinque Terre Tour from Florence with Boat Ride
data.description: Head to the Italian Riviera on a day trip from Florence to the Cinque Terre, a UNESCO World Heritage site made up of five cliffside villages perched dramatically on the sea. After the drive from Florence, you’ll travel by boat (weather dependent) and short train rides to the villages of Monterosso, Vernazza, and either Riomaggiore or Manarola. You'll also have free time for swimming or to explore the workshops of local artisans.

data.name: Florence Accademia & Uffizi Gallery small Group Tour with Lunch option
data.description: Explore Florence’s two must-see art museums—the Accademia and Uffizi galleries—on this combo tour. Learn about the famous Renaissance artists of Italy and see highlights like Michelangelo’s 'David' at the Accademia and Leonardo da Vinci’s 'Annunciation' on your Uffizi tour. data.name: Walking tour of Florence
data.description: Discover 2000 years of history of the cradle of the Renaissance through the eyes of an expert local guide, who will show you the most beautiful squares and monuments of Florence. The city of the Renaissance is literally dotted with architectural wonders and works of art: joining this unforgettable tour, you'll be able to admire with your own eyes the sites and monuments that have made Florence one of the most visited destinations in the world.Start your enlightening guided promenade in Repubblica Square, where the most refined cafés of the city are located. Follow your guide through the most characteristic streets and alleys until you reach the Loggia del Mercato Nuovo, home to a delightful leather market, where you will find out how to win good luck caressing the nose of the famous Porcellino, the city’s statue of a piglet. At a stone throw, there is the suggestive Ponte Vecchio, which is famous for hosting the most exclusive jewelry stores of Florence and for its unique structure, and also for being the only bridge of the city spared from the bombings during the Second World War.Then reach the Accademia and the Uffizi Square, and discover the beating heart of Florence, Signoria Square, dominated by the imposing Palazzo Vecchio and the magnificent Loggia dei Lanzi, which houses wonderful original statues.

data.name: Santa Maria Novella Private Tour
data.description: Step inside one of Florence’s spiritual gems with a guided tour of the Santa Maria de Novella church, a Gothic-Renaissance design that’s steeped in centuries of Florentine history. Admire evocative frescoes and devotional sculptures by Giotto, Brunelleschi, and Ghirlandaio that decorate the chapels while a guide explains their meaning and importance. For a sensory treat that combines the feel of a medieval apothecary with the fragrance of luxury Italian perfume, browse elixirs and bath products in the little-known pharmacy tucked within the church walls.

data.name: Climb the Dome, Own the View: Duomo Complex Tour Pass
data.description:
Most travelers see Florence’s Duomo. Few truly experience it.

This immersive small-group tour goes beyond the basics, led by a passionate, expert guide who brings to life the golden mosaics of the Baptistery, the treasures of the Duomo Museum, and the stories behind the Cathedral’s iconic façade. It’s not just a tour—it’s your front-row seat to the heart of Florence.

Skip the stress and head straight to your reserved Dome climb—your moment at the top is finally here. After 463 unforgettable steps, the reward is all yours: panoramic views that make every step worth it. No long waits, just a short 10–15 minute security check, and then… magic.

Your 3-day Duomo Complex pass unlocks even more: climb Giotto’s Bell Tower, enter the Cathedral via the faster Crypt entrance, and descend into the ancient Crypt to complete your journey through centuries of history.

Everything’s taken care of—tickets, timing, and insider insights. Just show up, soak it all in, and own the experience.

data.name: Florence in one day with a localGuide: David-City walk-Uffizi
data.description: Breeze past notoriously long lines at the Uffizi Gallery when you book this small-group tour with a pre-reserved admission ticket. Going with a guide is recommended, as you’ll get to hear stories and secrets about the Medici family that you won’t find in the guidebooks. The small group size provides an intimate experience, with ample time for questions and a break on the rooftop terrace for refreshments and city views.

data.name: Accademia Gallery Guided Tour from Montecatini
data.description: Start your day in Montecatini and take the train to Florence (tickets are included and will be sent by email).. Upon arrival in Florence meet our guide at the meeting point in In front of the Main Entrance of Accademia Gallery , where after the check-in you’ll start the guided tour. Immerse yourself in Michelangelo’s art and enjoy his most famous work, the statue of David, and other important masterpieces. The young Michelangelo sculpted the statue of David in three years, starting from a huge block of rough marble. The result was an absolutely beautiful, imposing sculpture, a real icon of the Renaissance ideal. He portrayed a magnificent nude young man in his full physical vigour, whose intense expression of force and courage, which stemmed from his absolute faith in God, was taken as a symbol of the power and invincibility of the Republic of Florence at the height of its splendour. After the tour make your way back to Montecatini on the train.

data.name: Private Florence City and Dome Climb Walking Tour
data.description: Take in the beauty and mystery of Florence on an exclusive 2.5-hour walking tour and Dome experience. From a private guide, learn about some of its most renowned artistic masterpieces like Filippo Brunelleschi's wondrous creation. Then ascend to new heights with a climb up the Cathedral of Santa Maria del Fiore dome for sensational panoramic views—be sure not to miss out on any hidden secrets you'll discover along this informative journey through one of Italy’s treasure cities.

data.name: Michelangelo's David Small-Group Tour
data.description: Learn all about Michelangelo’s David on this small-group tour in Florence, where your guide takes you through the Accademia Gallery, making sure you don’t miss out on any details. data.name: Cinque Terre and Pisa from Florence Full-Day Trip
data.description: Soak up sea views and a slice of history on this day trip to Cinque Terre and Pisa from Florence. Wander the colorful cliffside village of Manarola, hop a coastal train to Monterosso al Mare, and explore expansive sandy beaches, traditional Ligurian houses, and local eateries. After soaking up the coast, head to Pisa to see the Leaning Tower and medieval monuments.

data.name: Florence: Santa Croce Basilica and Leather School Private Tour
data.description:
Choose from a morning or afternoon tour, and meet your private guide near the entrance to the basilica, located in the Piazza Santa Croce. Admire the striking neo-Gothic exterior constructed from polychrome marble before purchasing your entrance ticket and stepping inside the world’s largest Franciscan church.

Learn about the nearly 700-year history of Santa Croce from your expert guide as you wander through the various chapels adorned with frescoes by Renaissance masters such as Donatello and Giotto. See the many magnificent tombs and funerary monuments that mark the final resting place some of Italy's greatest artists and thinkers, including Michelangelo, Galileo, Machiavelli, and Ghiberti. Pass through the solid marble pillars of the Brunelleschi Cloister, and take in the serenity of the Pazzi Chapel inside the Ancient Cloister.

Visit the adjacent Leather School, where Franciscan monks began working with leather as early as the 13th century. Learn how the workshop’s location near the Arno River provided the water supply needed for early leatherworking methods, and watch skilled artisans at work carrying on this Florentine tradition as they create purses, bags, and belts by hand using time-honored methods.

Please note: The Leather School is closed on Saturday and Sunday.

data.name: Florence Private Express Accademia Tour with ‘David’
data.description: Michelangelo’s iconic 'David' statue is one of Florence’s top treasures, but visiting the Accademia Gallery to admire this masterpiece can significantly cut into your sightseeing time. Make the most of your day with this private express tour that allows you to zip past the crowds with skip-the-line tickets and learn about the history and lore surrounding this world-famous work from your guide.

data.name: A day in the life of Florence - Private tour with a local
data.description: Florence is romantic, historic, and gorgeous, everything is meant for you to fall in love with this city. Our fun and entertaining guide will make this a memorable experience for you filled with sightseeing, visitng local popular hangout places and trying the local food & drinks. It is one of the best experiences to immerse yourself into the rich Italian culture.

data.name: Florence Museo di San Marco Private Walking Tour
data.description:
Make your own way to the San Marco complex to meet your guide.

Commissioned by Cosimo de' Medici and designed in part by the architect Michelozzo, the complex features sublime architecture along with a stunning collection of artwork by Fra Angelico. Your guide explains the five parts of the complex that you visit: the church, convent, facade, and the first and second cloister.

Hear about many important 15th-century figures that were associated with San Marco, including Fra Girolamo Savonarola, Cosimo de' Medici, and Fra Angelico. This lesser-known site is a hidden gem in Florence.

data.name: Private Pisa Half Day Tour from Florence
data.description: A splendid private excursion with a chauffeured vehicle through the fertile and picturesque Tuscan countryside to the historic university city of Pisa, famous for its architectural beauty. Meet your private driver at your hotel, and upon your arrival in Pisa, your private informative guide will take you on a thorough outdoor guided walking tour of Piazza dei Miracoli and its white-marble monuments. You will be dazzled by this marvelous square, which is dominated by the impressive Cathedral, a stunning model of the distinctive Pisan Romanesque architecture, the celebrated Leaning Tower, and the round-shaped Baptistery,surrounded by its suggestive columned arcades. During the walking tour it will also be possible to purchase the admission ticket to the Baptistery (to be paid on site directly from your guide), which include also a priority access inside the wonderful Cathedral!

data.name: Private Self Drive Tuscany Vespa Tour from Florence with a Guide
data.description:
Our exclusive Vespa tour departing from Florence offers an enjoyable and genuine Italian experience. As you speed through the winding alleyways you'll feel like a local.

You will check in at your lodging with our guide and after proceed to our garage. You'll select one of the stunning Vespas to ride, following the orientation of the guide.

Starting cautiously, your private trip will allow you to get acclimated to the scooter and follow your guide through Florence. There will be time to visit one of the oldest churches in the area and take additional pictures of the famous Florence background! Your guide will be at your side, leading you through the countryside, which is home to castles, olive orchards, and stunning houses.

Enjoy the finest cheese and prosciutto at our magnificent country house, paired with a glass of Chianti.

With the wind in your hair, the sun on your face, and adventure in your heart, you will have an exciting journey back to the city before the day is out.

data.name: Palazzo Pitti & Palatine Gallery: Entry Ticket + Guided Tour
data.shortDescription: Take a tour of the Pitti Palace and discover the secrets of the Medici family
data.description:
Pitti Palace has been home to the Medici family since the 16th century and features some amazing art and architecture you have to see to believe. With these Pitti Palace tickets you'll have an extra layer of depth to your experience, as a knowledgeable guide will provide you more meaning to each location as you walk around.

See the famous private collection of the Medici family in their last residence, which includes important masterpieces by Botticelli, Titian, Rubens, Caravaggio and many other Italian and European painters from the 15th to the 17th century. You will discover the history of the Palace and its inhabitants, and some of their secrets, too.

This tour is a unique chance to admire more than just the surface layer of Renaissance beauty.

data.name: Florence Vespa Rental
data.shortDescription: Zip around the historic city on a colorful Vespa of your choice
data.description:
Channel your inner-Audrey Hepburn as you cruise through the heart of the Tuscan capital on an iconic Vespa scooter. 

Buzz by the Duomo di Firenze, visit Ponte Vecchio and enjoy views of the city from the Arno. Equipped with LED headlights, a convenient trunk, and a USB charger, you are ready to spend all day roaming around Florence. 

Pay homage to the Italian flag and select the color of your Vespa – mint green, pearl white, and the special edition red. Grab the matching helmet before you climb on and leave your worries to the wind.

data.name: Brunelleschi Dome & Florence Cathedral: Guided Tour
data.shortDescription: Ascend the Dome for a heart-stopping view of Florence!
data.description:
Take a moment to explore the UNESCO World Heritage Cathedral of Santa Maria del Fiore, an architectural masterpiece.

An experienced and knowledgeable guide will lead you through the cathedral. Gaze up at the dome built by architectural genius, Brunelleschi.

The journey isn't over! The ticket also grants you access to the Cupola, where a climb gradually reveals Georgio Vasari's _The Last Judgment_ fresco.

When you reach the top, you'll be treated to an awe-inspiring 360-degree view of Florence. Don't let this amazing view pass you by! Grab a ticket today and prepare for an unforgettable Florentine experience.

data.name: Discovering Florence Nightlife Guided Walking Tour

data.name: Chianti Region: Day Trip from Florence + Off-Road Tuscany Wine Tour
data.shortDescription: A full day adventure for wine and food lovers!
data.description:
**Winery visit:**

Your first stop of the day is at a beautiful winery belonging to one of Italy's prestigious aristocratic families. 

Here you'll taste three wines paired with salumi (cured meats) – but first, there’s a fascinating guided tour of the historic cellars and the olive mill, which you'll reach through underground tunnels that pass beneath the villa.

**Off-roading and dinner:**

Now buckle up and get ready for some off-roading through ancient woodlands and rolling hills. 

Hop in and take in beautiful scenery, as you make your way to Rignana, a typical Tuscan restaurant and winery with stunning views. Get your taste buds ready for lunch of delicious food and red wine (and a blind olive oil tasting).

**Villa visit and wine tasting:**

The adventure continues as you drive through the countryside on your way to the final stop of the day.

data.name: Siena, San Gimignano & Monteriggioni - Small Group Excursion from Florence

Moreover, this area is full of excellent food specialties that you will surely have the chance to taste, like Panforte and Pici.The tour lasts 8 hours and the schedule is as follows: departing from Florence, 2 hours in Siena with 1 hour guided tour of the city, a short stop in Monteriggioni to take some pictures, and approximately 1 hour of free time in San Gimignano.Don't miss this opportunity to have an unforgettable experience! Book your exclusive small-group tour today!

data.name: Wine tasting at Castello Sonnino close to Florence
data.description: The Tour includes the guided visit of the Medieval Cellars and the Ancient Rooms of the farm, the Vinsantaia (XVII cent.) with the explanation of the wine, the extra virgin olive oil making process and Castello Sonnino history. A journey of discovery that takes you to the heart of our agricultural estate: from the historic cellars to the special place where the vinsanto is made, taking in the oil store and the secret rooms of the Castle, through to the wine bar premises where visitors will be offered excellent tastings of wine and oil accompanied by outstanding food products. We have different options to choose for the wine tasting experience: Basic Wine Tasting: 3 Sonnino wines, accompanied with house baked bread Gourmet Experience: Wine tasting of 3 Sonnino wines paired with our "KM 0" products of mixed bruschettas, selection of salami, cheese with honeys and jams, Vinsanto and Cantuccini Taste & Lunch: Wine tasting of 3 Sonnino wines paired with our products of mixed bruschettas, selection of salami, cheese with honeys and jams, Main Course, Vinsanto and Cantuccini Tuscan Lunch Experience: Wine tasting of 3 Sonnino wines paired with our "KM 0" of mixed bruschettas, selection of salami, cheeses with honeys and jams, Main Course, Second Course, Vinsanto and Cantuccini

Continue through the rolling Chianti hills to two hand-picked wineries, where you’ll learn about the art of winemaking and enjoy guided tastings of Chianti Classico wines. Discover the historic town of Castellina in Chianti, with its Etruscan roots and medieval fortifications. Walk the famous Via delle Volte, once used by soldiers in times of war. End your day with a relaxing Tuscan brunch at a local winery—featuring regional specialties like cured meats, cheeses, fresh bread, and exceptional wines. With stunning landscapes and a knowledgeable guide sharing local stories, this tour is the perfect way to experience the heart of Chianti.

Visit the Uffizi Gallery to see a vast collection of Italian Renaissance art. Use an audio guide to explore both floors of this renowned museum.

data.name: Pisa and Lucca guided tour from Florence with beach stop in Versilia

data.description: Experience the magic of Florence on an enchanting evening e-bike tour, where the cool breeze and quiet streets create a truly unforgettable atmosphere. Glide effortlessly through the city’s charming alleys and across the Arno River, as the illuminated monuments transform into a breathtaking spectacle, like a grand theatre stage. The highlight of the tour is a stop at the iconic Piazzale Michelangelo, offering a panoramic view of Florence’s Gothic and Renaissance treasures from above. Admire the city's skyline, with its domes, towers, and bridges bathed in golden light, creating a picture-perfect moment. Ride along the picturesque “Lungarni,” where elegant street lamps cast shimmering reflections on the river. This effortless journey by e-bike allows you to embrace the beauty, romance, and timeless charm of Florence at night, leaving you with memories that will last a lifetime.

data.name: Chianti Small-Group Guided Vespa Tour from Florence with Lunch
data.description:
Meet your guide in central Florence, and hop aboard a minivan with your group that will transport you to the Tuscan hills. Once outside of the city, begin with a safety briefing and orientation to ensure that you feel comfortable riding before you hit the road. This small group tour is limited to 15 people to keep the experience as intimate as possible.

Then saddle up on your single- or double-seater Vespa and begin your ride along the scenic hillside, with stops for photo opportunities and the guided visit of two wineries. Your guide will lead you to a castle for a relaxing lunch, including tastings of famous Chianti wines and fine olive oils, all locally produced.

After satisfying your taste buds, you’ll head back toward Florence, enjoying the fresh air and panoramic views before your Vespa tour concludes.

Please note: You must present a valid drivers license, but do not need a motorcycle license. Children 12-18 years can ride as a passenger. It is highly recommended that you have previous driving experience on a Vespa, scooter or motorcycle.

data.name: Florence Private Tour with Uffizi and Accademia Gallery
data.description: Dive into Florence's Renaissance past in just one day on this private tour, ideal for first-time visitors. Learn the history behind the sculptures, fountains, and palaces of the city’s grand squares, step inside gleaming churches, stroll through the medieval streets where Dante once lived, and admire the spectacular monuments of the Duomo Complex. Then, get an up-close look at some of the world's most iconic paintings and sculptures with included tickets and guided tours to the Accademia Gallery and Uffizi Gallery.

data.name: Florence Accademia Gallery Small-Group Skip-the-Line Tour
data.description: Gain more from your visit to the Accademia Gallery (Galleria dell’Accademia) with a small-group guided tour. Listen to expert commentary about the museum and its artists as you marvel at masterpieces like Michelangelo’s ‘David’ statue. When the guided portion ends, you can stay at the museum to continue browsing independently.

data.name: Florence Cathedral complex and Dome tickets
data.description: Piazza del Duomo in Florence is an extraordinary open-air museum full of chests holding incredible and priceless treasures: the Cathedral of Santa Maria del Fiore with the magnificent Brunelleschi's Dome, Giotto's Bell Tower, the Baptistery of San Giovanni, the Crypt of Santa Reparata and the Opera del Duomo Museum.Visit the Cathedral of Santa Maria del Fiore, the third-largest church in the world and the largest in Europe at the time of its construction in the fifteenth century. You'll be enchanted by the sophistication of the polychrome marble of the facade and the majestic Dome that dominates it, designed by Brunelleschi.Under the Cathedral, you'll see the remains of the ancient Basilica of Santa Reparata, among the largest early Christian complexes of the Tuscia. Admire the famous Gates of Paradise and the precious mosaic of the dome inside the Baptistery of San Giovanni.You'll also be able to enjoy an unforgettable view of the city from the terrace of Giotto's Bell Tower and access the Museo dell'Opera del Duomo to see masterpieces by Michelangelo, Arnolfo di Cambio, Ghiberti, Donatello, Luca della Robbia, Antonio Pollaiolo and Verrocchio.

data.name: Chianti: Guided Winery Tour + Wine Tasting
data.shortDescription: Learn about the wine-making process and taste varieties of fine wines in Chianti
data.description:
Start with a tour of the cellars to discover the company’s history and the wine-making process. Observe the machinery and barrels used in production.

Taste four different wines in a spacious room, including two IGT Toscana wines, one Chianti Classico, and one Chianti Classico Riserva. Receive explanations about each wine's composition and flavors, paired with Tuscan crackers.

Stroll through the picturesque vineyards for a closer look at the natural surroundings. Add extra food, wines, liquors, and spirits to the visit for an additional cost.

data.name: OT Tuscany Cooking Class, Lunch & Wine Tasting in San Gimignano Winery from Florence
data.description: TOUR HIGHLIGHTSFollow the steps and the instruction of a real Italian chef to prepare a great Tuscan Pasta dishLearn the magic of the Italian cuisine of handmade pasta with friends and family while tasting fifteen Tuscan productsLearn from a passionate local chef and enjoy what you’ve created during lunch or dinner paired with Tuscan WineIf you love cooking, Star Florence invites you to come to learn together with a qualified chef in authentic Italian cuisine. Join to learn the homemade pasta preparation and other simple and delicious Tuscan recipes, incredible sauces, meats and desserts using only the freshest ingredients.

data.name: Skip the line: Accademia Gallery guided tour
data.description: During this tour, you will admire not only this amazing work but also other Michelangelo’s famous statues! The young Michelangelo sculpted the statue of David in three years, starting from a huge block of rough marble. The result was an absolutely beautiful, imposing sculpture, the real icon of the Renaissance ideal. He portrayed a magnificent nude young man in his full physical vigor, whose intense expression of force and courage, which stemmed from his absolute faith in God.The statue was taken as a symbol of the power and invincibility of the Republic of Florence at the height of its splendor. You cannot visit Florence without seeing the magnificent statue of David.

data.name: Florence Santa Croce Church tour
data.description: Visit the Basilica di Santa Croce, also known as the Temple of the Italian Glories because it houses the tombs of some of the most illustrious Italians, such as Michelangelo, Galileo, Machiavelli, the poet Foscolo, the philosopher Gentile and the composer Rossini.Santa Croce is situated on the Piazza di Santa Croce, where the famous soccer game in medieval costumes, the Calcio Storico Fiorentino, takes place here every year in June.It is the main Franciscan church in Florence and a minor basilica of the Roman Catholic Church and it's considered to be one of the most important, interesting and beautiful churches in Italy.Here you will find frescos by Giotto, a chapel designed by Brunelleschi, works by Donatello and a monument dedicated to Dante Alighieri, author of the Divine Comedy.

data.name: Transfer per Firenze

data.name: Florence Foodie Epic Day: Pasta Class & Street‑Food Safari
data.description: Immerse yourself in Florence’s culinary and cultural soul on this unique full‑day experience. Morning: Fresh Pasta‑Making Masterclass Start your friendly lesson in a historic building, where a multilingual chef teaches you ancient techniques to create three types of fresh pasta and a typical seasonal dessert from scratch using organic, local ingredients. You’ll roll dough by hand and with a machine, learn easy and foolproof tips to recreate these dishes at home, then savor your homemade creations over a leisurely lunch with good Tuscan wine, in the warm and convivial atmosphere of a small group. Afternoon: Hidden Gems Street‑Food Tour After lunch, set out on foot through Florence’s winding streets with a food‑loving guide. Discover hidden corners and authentic eateries known only to locals and uncover five iconic bites — crispy crostini, melt-in-your-mouth budino di riso, the famous schiacciata all’olio filled with local delights (skip the line at the historic venue of the legendary " Antico Vinaio"), the irresistible coccoli with cheese or ham, and a heavenly artisan gelato. You’ll also sip on two Chianti wines and, for the adventurous, there's the option to try Florence’s iconic street foods—trippa or/and lampredotto. As you taste, your guide will regale you with medieval legends, Renaissance anecdotes, and insider tips on the city’s artisan heritage. This isn’t just a food tour—it’s a sensory journey blending hands‑on cooking, authentic flavors, and Florence’s timeless charm

data.name: Pitti Palace Tour
data.description: Enjoy a guided tour inside this marvelous and renaissance palace built during the XVth Century. Was then bought by the Medici Family and became their glorious residence. With our expert guide discover the Palatine Gallery and the Royal Apartments. The Palatine is the main gallery inside the Palace and it contains around 500 Renaissance paintings as it was the a private collection of the Medici family. There are 28 rooms and inside their last sumptuous residence we can still admire remarkable masterpieces by Botticelli, Titian, Rubens, Caravaggio and many other Italian and European painters from the XVth to the XVIIth centuries.

data.name: Join us for dinner and jump into Florentine cuisine
data.description:
Join the latest culinary trend of immersive and social dining where local hosts invite you into their homes for a magical meal.

We are happy to welcome you in our house in the hills of Florence. Our home is wide but warm, and there's also a beautiful garden where you can relax during the sunny season. During the dinner we will introduce you to our culinary tradition, explaining ancient recipes, most of them passed through generations in our families. Just as you know, the queen of our table it is always hand made pasta! My husband and I are a couple in life and in the kitchen.We were born in Florence, so we know every anecdote and curiosity about the city and its traditions. We are passionate about art and cooking, especially Medieval and Renaissance cuisine :)

data.name: Natural wine & Veggy food pairing in a bookstore
data.description:
Giulia will teach you how to taste with your heart, not your mind, as well as the ways to really experience and describe wine. She will share a simple method for pairing food and wine. 

You'll have a private, guided wine tasting and enjoy Libreria Brac's delicious vegetarian Piatto Unico. All the wines are organic, biodynamic or natural. 

Learn about winemakers, wine regions, native grapes and more on this cultural wine and food tour.

data.name: Homemade pasta class and lunch in the heart of Chianti
data.description:
What better way to explore a city than by discovering its cuisine first hand? Put on a chef's hat for the day and learn how to make classic dishes, local specialties and impressive plates with our expert hosts. Sign up for one of our fun, immersive cooking classes and discover a new hidden talent!

We will welcome you in the garden of our farmhouse nestled in the Chianti hills among olive trees, cypresses and mulberry trees.You will be able to experience the wonderful emotion of being part of a real Tuscan family for one day. Together with my wife Valentina, our friend Anna and our two dogs we will be proud to share you our traditions. We will teach you some traditional Tuscan recipes such as homemade pasta the way our grandmothers used to make it, then we will cook it together. We will also prepare a Tuscan dessert with grandmother's secret recipe. While our dessert is cooking in the oven you can sit in our garden to enjoy the appetizers. Some cutting boards will be served with various types of croutons and typical dishes, pappa al pomodoro , fettunta and many others delicious recipes created with natural and quality products from the family farm. The lunch will continue with tasting the pasta prepared together and finally two desserts will be served with the coffee made with moka. All naturally accompanied by an excellent Chianti wine.

data.description: Learn how to cook Tuscan food in Florence Do you want to learn how to prepare homemade pasta or pizza dough? Learn how to cook like an Italian 'mamma' with Patrizia, then enjoy a delicious dinner together! Feast on homemade pasta, pizza and dessert Wine is included Communal cooking class for up to 6 people Patrizia has over 30 rave reviews on TripAdvisor!
