data.name: Accademia Gallery: Skip The Line Ticket
data.description:
Skip the line and see Florence’s artistic heritage with direct access to the city’s famous works. This ticket allows you to enter key art and cultural sites, including Michelangelo’s *David* and other significant contributions to art and music.

View Michelangelo’s *David*, a hallmark of Renaissance art. With your skip-the-line ticket, avoid the crowds and see this 5-meter-tall marble statue. Notice the intricate details and the artist’s precision.

Check out Florence’s Gothic art collection, which illustrates the shift from medieval to Renaissance art. Look at works by artists like Giotto and Lorenzo Monaco. Visit the Museum of Musical Instruments to find a Stradivarius violin and the oldest surviving piano.

data.name: Tuscany and Siena Day Trip with Chianti Wine Tasting from Rome
data.description: Experience the allure of Tuscany without the hassle of tricky logistics with this all-inclusive day trip from Rome. Save time with a high-speed train to Florence, where you’ll hop on a minibus with your tour leader and small group to visit Monteriggioni, Siena, and San Gimignano. End your Tuscan adventure with a wine and olive oil tasting in Chianti before heading back to Florence for the return train to Rome.

data.name: Florence Palazzo Vecchio Museum Ticket & Audioguide
data.description: Palazzo Vecchio, which stands majestically on Florence skyline, is one of the most recognized symbols of the city. Built during the Middle-Ages, it still preserves the austere architecture of the fourteenth century, with its crenellated top that surrounds the imposing Arnolfo’s Tower which, with its 95 meters high, is the highest viewpoint of the city, after Brunelleschi’s Dome. The indoor parts of the building, beautifully renovated in the '500 when the Palace became the house of Medici, are instead typically Renaissance and hold priceless treasures and works of art. In the sumptuous halls and the private apartments of the family, worked the greatest artists of the period. Visit the palace means to stroll among the wonders of Renaissance and retrace its history, discovering also the secrets and tales linked to the powerful Medici family. The elegant courtyard by Michelozzo, welcomes you at the beginning of a visit that will enable you to admire the famous and beautiful “Hall of the 500”, the charming and intimate study of Francesco I de’ Medici, the beautiful private apartments of Eleonora of Toledo and Cosimo I de’ Medici and the sumptuous and stunning boardrooms, in an incredible series of frescoes, paintings, decorations and statues of the greatest Renaissance artists as Michelangelo, Donatello, Verrocchio, Vasari, Ghirlandaio and Bronzino, just to mention some of them. End your experience with a delicious Lunch in a typical restaurant in the heart of the Florence (if option seleted).

data.name: Uffizi Gallery: Skip The Line Ticket + Guided Tour + Vasari Corridor Access
data.shortDescription: Explore masterpieces by legendary artists and walk through a historic passageway
data.description:
Take a guided tour of Florence's rich history and art at the Uffizi Gallery and the Vasari Corridor.

First, enter the Uffizi Gallery with fast-track access and see works by Michelangelo, Raphael, and Leonardo da Vinci. Learn about Italian art from the Middle Ages to the Renaissance.

Then, walk through the Vasari Corridor, a passageway built by Giorgio Vasari in 1564 for the Medici family. This elevated path connects Palazzo Pitti to Palazzo Vecchio and crosses the Arno River over Ponte Vecchio. Closed for restoration since 2016, the corridor will reopen in 2025, giving you an opportunity to walk through this historic passage.

data.name: Accademia Gallery Skip the line tickets (without the guide)
data.description: Admire the one and only Accademia Gallery with these skip the line entrance tickets. Immerse yourself in Michelangelo’s art and enjoy his most famous work, the statue of David, and other important masterpieces. The young Michelangelo sculpted the statue of David in three years, starting from a huge block of rough marble. The result was an absolutely beautiful, imposing sculpture, the real icon of the Renaissance ideal. He portrayed a magnificent nude young man in his full physical vigour, whose intense expression of force and courage, which stemmed from his absolute faith in God, was taken as a symbol of the power and invincibility of the Republic of Florence at the height of its splendour.

data.name: Florence Inferno Quest: Dante’s Haunted Trail Adventure
data.description: Step into the shadows of Florence and uncover the chilling secrets behind Dante’s Divine Comedy. Inspired by one of the most legendary works in literature, this self-guided walking adventure takes you through the city’s most iconic and mysterious spots - where fact and fiction blur. Using your smartphone, you’ll follow cryptic clues that guide you from one location to the next, revealing Dante’s inspirations, spine-tingling stories, and the darker side of Florence’s history. Discover sites like Palazzo Vecchio, the Duomo, and hidden alleyways steeped in legend - all while solving puzzles and learning curses, myths, and eerie truths tied to the city’s soul. What makes this tour unique? It’s an immersive outdoor escape game where you become the main character in a Dante-inspired mystery, blending literature, history, and urban adventure into one unforgettable experience. Perfect for curious travelers, couples, and families who enjoy storytelling with a spooky twist.

data.name: Florence Grand Tour by Electric Golf Cart
data.description: Explore the historic center of Florence by electric golf cart and leave your conscience clean as you can cover more sights than you could on a walking tour. Climb aboard the eco-friendly cart in Piazza Madonna degli Aldobrandini and drive through the streets of the cradle of the Renaissance, crossing Piazza Signoria and the Porcellino Market. Continue towards the Duomo and the marble façade of the Basilica of Santa Maria Novella. Ride along the banks of the River Arno to Piazza Ognissanti. Amaze yourself in front of Pitti Palace and Ponte Vecchio. End your tour with the amazing view of Florence from Piazzale Michelangelo.An MP3 audio guide will be provided with commentary on the history of the city and its sites so that you can sit back and relax.PLEASE NOTE: Golf carts cannot travel through some parts of the historical city center so you need to get off the golf cart and walk to see some attractions.

data.name: Florence Cathedral, Uffizi & Accademia: Guided Tour
data.description: Make the most of your time in Florence with the Florence Art Pass. Your Florence Art Pass allows you to fast-track your entrance to two of the most significant art galleries in Italy – the Uffizi and Gallerie dell'Accademia – and its trademark Duomo, all with the knowledge and experience of a licensed guide.

data.name: Pisa highlights tour with Leaning Tower entry from Florence
data.description:
From the Renaissance beauty of Florence this trip whisks you off to world-famous Pisa – home of that legendary lean. A scenic drive through rolling hills and olive groves before you arrive at Pisa’s showstopper – the Piazza dei Miracoli. There you’ll meet the big three: the Leaning Tower, the Cathedral, and the Baptistery.

You’ll get the chance to conquer all 294 steps of the Leaning Tower. The climb’s a bit of a leg-burner, but the views from the top are totally worth it. Sweeping scenes of Pisa’s rooftops, rolling hills, and the river Arno. Your guide will share the tower’s backstory, from medieval blunders to modern engineering marvel, before your climb.

Next, you’ll head into the Cathedral and Baptistery. These Romanesque masterpieces are jaw-droppers, inside and out. And just when you think you’ve seen it all, there’s one final stop – Piazza dei Cavalleggeri. Here, you’ll learn how a young Galileo gazed at the stars and changed science forever.

data.name: SiChef Florence- Vegetarian Fresh Pasta/Sauces - Tiramisu Class
data.description:
After your hard work in the kitchen, it’s time to sit down and enjoy the fruits of your labor. Gathered around the table, you’ll savor the fresh vegetarian pasta and tiramisu you’ve crafted, allowing you to experience firsthand the beauty of authentic Italian flavors. This tasting session is an opportunity not only to enjoy the dishes you’ve prepared but also to connect with others, sharing stories and experiences in a warm, convivial setting.

To complement your meal, we provide a selection of local wines, each carefully chosen to enhance the flavors of your vegetarian creations. This immersive culinary experience will leave you with a deeper appreciation for vegetarian Italian cuisine and the satisfaction of having created it yourself.

data.name: Accademia Gallery: Priority Entry Ticket
data.description:
Visit the Accademia Gallery in Florence to see Michelangelo’s larger-than-life statue of _David_ up close.

While there, you can also walk through halls filled with Renaissance paintings and impressive sculptures.

Learn about the history of Florence’s art and enjoy the museum’s special exhibits and collections.

data.name: Chianti Authentic Experience morning Tour: two Wineries, cellars Visit and Wine Tastings
data.description: A comprehensive experience in one of the most fascinating areas of Tuscany, known all over the world for its wine and its countryside of unrivalled charm, where woods alternate with vineyards and olive groves, in a landscape dotted with Romanesque parish churches, farmhouses, villas and castles of rare beauty. The first stop of the tour is in the heart of the Florentine Chianti Classico, in a small cozy Winery. Here, guided by the owner, you will discover the secrets of winemaking and enjoy a delicious tasting of the best wines produced, accompanied by local products. The tour continues along the historical "Via Chiantigiana"; you will cross the Sienese Chianti Classico area, admiring the breathtaking views of the rolling hills that made so famous this part of Tuscany, before to reach a family-run Winery, which stands out for the excellent quality of its wines. Here you will be warmly welcomed by its passionate winemaker and after the guided tour of the cellars and the lovely aromatic garden, a delicious tasting of four different wines and local products will be waiting for you. Take the unique opportunity to buy the excellent wines and Tuscan local products you have tasted and that can be found only in these small farms with organic production Please note that the order of the visits may change

data.name: Palazzo Pitti, Boboli & Bardini Gardens: Skip The Line Ticket
data.shortDescription: Visit Pitti Palace and explore the botanical beauty of Florentine gardens
data.description:
As Florence’s only royal palace, Palazzo Pitti is a must-see on the city’s tourist trail. It's also the largest museum complex in the City of Lilies; at some 32,000 square meters this is a residence fit for absolute rulers - from grand dukes to kings and emperors. 

After enjoying its architecture you can't miss visiting its surroundings, the exotic plants of Boboli Gardens. Of equal beauty, Bardini Gardens offer what is widely considered to be the most beautiful panoramic view over Florence.

-Follow your guide as you stroll down cobbled streets lined with trendy boutiques

data.name: Palazzo Vecchio Secret Passages Guided Tour
data.description: Experience the exciting discovery of the places and paths of Palazzo Vecchio that are not accessible to the general public and that have been made available recently, for very small groups only. You will ascend the narrow passages of the Duke Gualtieri’s medieval stairway and you will discover an unexpected path beyond a door hidden by a painting, admire the precious and imposing coffered ceiling of the Salone dei Cinquecento and explore the Medicean Palace from a different and intriguing prospect.

data.name: Private Wine Blending Masterclass in Florence
data.description:
Dive into the heart of Tuscan wine with your own private expert sommelier. Tailored exclusively for your group, this 3-hour masterclass invites you to:

Savor six premium single-variety Tuscan wines, carefully selected to showcase regional excellence.

Learn hands-on blending with the guidance of your sommelier to create your own custom personal blend.

Enjoy an intimate, engaging deep dive into Tuscan wine traditions and techniques—all in a relaxed, elegant private setting.

data.description: For all those customers who wish to visit both museums in total freedom and at their own pace, guided by an audio commentary of expert art historians recorded in their own language. data.name: Flavors of Florence & Chianti: 2 days culinary escape with food & wine tour
data.description: Day 1: Benvenuti a Firenze! Arrive in Florence, the cradle of art, culture, and exquisite cuisine, where you’ll be greeted with the charm of this iconic city. Check in to your 4-star hotel, ideally located in the heart of Florence, offering you easy access to everything this Renaissance city has to offer. After settling in, enjoy some free time to explore Florence at your own pace or simply relax and soak in the ambiance of your surroundings. As evening approaches, experience Florence through its authentic flavors with five delicious tastings and two Chianti wines while avoiding tourist traps! Savor crostini, Italian sweer pastry, schiacciata from the famous Antico Vinaio, coccoli, and artisanal gelato. For the adventurous, trippa and lampredotto are available. Stroll through hidden alleys, visit traditional bakeries and wine shops, and get recommendations for the best Florentine steak. Along the way, immerse yourself in history, legends, and the charm of medieval and Renaissance Florence. After a fulfilling day, unwind at your comfortable 4-star accommodation, with a restful night’s sleep and a delicious breakfast awaiting you the next morning. Day 2: Chianti Exploration Start your day with a delicious breakfast before venturing into the picturesque Chianti countryside. On a half-day excursion, visit two local wineries nestled in the heart of the Chianti Classico region. Here, you’ll discover the centuries-old art of winemaking and enjoy a guided tasting of some of the finest wines Tuscany has to offer, complemented by light, mouthwatering Tuscan snacks. After this unforgettable experience, return to Florence in the early afternoon, where you’ll have time to further explore the city or relax before your departure. Check out from your hotel at your leisure, with options for private transfers or additional activities available to extend your stay. Thank you for joining us on this unforgettable Tuscan adventure. We hope your time in Florence and Chianti leaves you with memories to cherish forever. Buon Viaggio e Arrivederci! Not Refundable and not Modifiable Package

data.name: Florence and Pisa Full Day Tour from Rome by Train
data.description: Explore the two most iconic cities of Italy in a single day on a day trip from Rome. Go on our budget-friendly day tour from Rome to Florence and Pisa, save hours with direct transportation by train with the tickets we provide, from Rome to Florence, Florence to Pisa and from Pisa to Rome back. Dive into Florence's Renaissance charm and marvel at Pisa's iconic Leaning Tower in the Square of Miracles. This curated experience blends art, history, and architectural wonders, offering a full-day odyssey through Italy's scenic countryside. Join us for a memorable journey filled with culture and beauty. Immerse yourself in the rich culture and history of Florence and Pisa

data.name: Chianti Rufina Private Wine Tour with Lunch from Florence
data.description: Discover a corner of Chianti’s wine country that most tourists miss with this private tour to Chianti Rufina. Explore the picturesque hills that have been producing wines since the time of the Medicis, stopping in two boutique wineries along the way for cellar tours and tastings, plus a traditional Tuscan lunch. Learn about the wine production and history while you take a break from the crowds in Florence.

data.name: Coffee Roastery Tour & Tasting Experience in Florence
data.description: Uncover the secrets of Florentine coffee culture with this exclusive coffee roastery tour and tasting experience in Florence! Begin your journey at a family-owned coffee roastery, originally established in 1939 near the Bargello and later relocated to San Niccolò. Enter through a hidden passage in Florence’s ancient city walls, and step into a place where generations of coffee artisans have preserved traditional roasting techniques. On this behind-the-scenes tour, you’ll follow the journey of high-quality coffee blends from bean selection to roasting and production. Learn about the unique hillside roasting process, a technique that enhances the aroma and depth of the coffee, setting it apart from industrial methods. No coffee experience is complete without a tasting! End your visit with a guided coffee tasting, where you’ll experience freshly roasted blends, learning how to identify flavor notes, aroma, and body like a true coffee connoisseur. Before or after the coffee tour, take a walk through San Niccolò, one of Florence’s most charming and authentic districts. Sit down for a savory tasting experience, pairing local delicacies with a glass of fine Tuscan wine, perfectly complementing your Florentine coffee adventure. This experience is perfect for coffee lovers, food enthusiasts, and travelers looking for an authentic taste of Florence’s artisanal traditions!

data.name: OT Florence City Walking Guided Tour in English Promo 2025
data.description: Join an amazing journey through the most famous squares and streets of Florence with an informative, friendly, and engaging guide. Walk to the stunning Florence Duomo, the Old Bridge, and the Signoria Square with its replica of Michelangelo’s David.TOUR HIGHLIGHTS• Visit the stunning Santa Maria del Fiore Cathedral• See the Signoria Square with its replica of Michelangelo’s David• Walk over the famous Old Bridge• Learn from a professional guide who will show you the city's hidden treasures

data.name: Florence Private walking Full Day Tour from Venice by Train
data.description:
Enjoy this private full day tour of Florence from Venice with a local tour guide once in Florence.

During the tour, you will visit some of the most famous landmarks in Florence. First on the list is the stunning Florence Cathedral, also known as the Duomo. This Gothic cathedral is famous for its dome designed by Brunelleschi and the beautiful bell tower designed by Giotto. Your guide will share the history and significance of this iconic cathedral and its architecture.

Your guide will provide an overview of the museum’s highlights and share their knowledge about the art and artists.

Then, after visiting the Uffizi Gallery from the outside, you will take a stroll through the beautiful Piazza della Signoria. This is the main square of Florence and home to the Palazzo Vecchio, the town hall of Florence.

data.name: Best of Montepulciano, Montalcino, Cortona: Small Group Guided Tour from Florence
data.description: Starting from Florence, the journey takes you to Cortona, one of the most ancient and charming villages in Tuscany. Perched on a hill in the Val di Chiana and made famous by the movie Under the Tuscan Sun, Cortona boasts Etruscan origins, evidenced by the imposing walls surrounding it, which date back to the 4th century BC. The village offers a perfect blend of medieval architecture, authentic atmospheres, and local culture, making it an unmissable destination for those seeking timeless beauty and authenticity. As an exclusive experience, you'll have the privilege of entering the workshop of a master ceramic artisan —a true "cocciaio" (*)— where you'll uncover the secrets of this ancient craft. Discover the traditional production process and witness a live demonstration of hand-painted decoration using the authentic colors that have made these creations so renowned for centuries. The next stop is Montepulciano, a captivating Renaissance town where you will have the opportunity to taste five fine wines including the prestigious Nobile di Montepulciano, while uncovering the secrets of its production in a setting steeped in history. As part of this refined tasting, you will also have the chance to sample also the iconic Brunello di Montalcino, a world-renowned wine that you will later discover in its place of origin.Here, you will enjoy also an exclusive and immersive light lunch experience in one of its historic underground wine cellars (if option selected), a truly unique setting where centuries of tradition meet the excellence of Tuscan winemaking. After this extraordinary experience, you’ll have time to explore the town’s enchanting historic center, famous as the set for films like "New Moon" and the series "Medici: Masters of Florence", featuring Dustin Hoffman and Richard Madden. As you continue toward the Val d'Orcia, you will enter the heart of one of Tuscany’s most scenic areas, where you can admire the iconic landscapes of rolling hills dotted with cypress trees, known worldwide for their ineffable beauty and recognized as a UNESCO heritage site. Along the way to Montalcino, you will spot the settings of famous film "The Gladiator"—a perfect opportunity for taking iconic photos. The final stop is Montalcino, a charming medieval town nestled in the rolling hills of Tuscany, characterized by an evocative 14th-century fortress still intact. Famous for its prestigious wines, Rosso di Montalcino and the world-renowned Brunello that you will have already appreciated in the tasting done in Montepulciano. Montalcino boasts a rich history and breathtaking landscapes. As you explore its small and enchanting historic center, with colorful shops and wine bars overlooking the medieval streets, you’ll be surrounded by ancient stone buildings, picturesque alleyways, and stunning views of the Val d’Orcia, a UNESCO World Heritage site. The tour concludes with a return to Florence in the late afternoon, leaving you with unforgettable memories of breathtaking landscapes and a collection of authentic experiences in art, history, and wine that will carry the flavors and aromas of this unparalleled region with you. (*) if not available, it will be replaced with a visit to authentic artisan shops, with traditional and typical works of the village Please note the order of the visit may change.

data.name: Florence Small-Group Walking Tour with Uffizi, Accademia
data.description: Discover Florence—the cradle of the Renaissance and home to Dante, Michelangelo, and Leonardo—on this immersive small-group tour. Walk through the city’s historic streets and squares, uncovering its Roman origins and medieval rise. Explore the renowned Uffizi and Accademia Galleries to admire masterpieces like Michelangelo’s “David” as well as the vibrant Piazza della Signoria, an outdoor museum of Renaissance sculpture and history.

data.name: The Best of Pisa: Private Day Trip from Florence by Train
data.description: Explore the famous city of Pisa on this day trip from Florence by train with an expert private guide. See the iconic 'Leaning Tower of Pisa' in the famous Piazza dei Miracoli, but also soak up the vibrant atmosphere created by the locals and many students who study here, as you wander off the beaten track along the cobbled streets of the historic centre. On your private tour, you will:  Meet your guide outside Florence's train station Santa Maria Novella and catch the train to Pisa;  Arrive in Pisa just over an hour later and begin your walking tour of the city's highlights - and a few hidden gems; See the famous Tuttomondo mural by Keith Haring then walk towards the historic centre; Hear how Pisa was once a powerful maritime trading destination that rivalled Venice and Genoa; Walking along cobbled streets, learn how the city became famous as a place of learning with its elite university; Walk past the Palazzo Blu - a modern art exhibition space; Visit the pretty church of Santa Maria della Spina (of the thorn) a pretty little gothic church dating back to 1230 that houses a thorn, a relic of the crown of thorns worn by Christ; Walk over the Solferino Bridge to arrive at the "Square of Miracles" and admire the famous Leaning Tower; Discover why the tower was built in 1173 - to be the bell tower of a larger cathedral complex; Learn how it 'miraculously' still stands without falling;  Admire the other buildings that surround the Tower: the stunning Cathedral and the Baptistry of St John;  Pass by the magnificent Camposanto and hear about the "holy field" created with soil brought over from Golgotha; Walk by the impressively old medieval Chiesa di San Sisto built from a rough-hewn rock in 1087;  Wander into the magnificent Piazza dei Cavalieri "Knight's Square" the most important piazza of the city after the Duomo; Make your way back through the charming cobbled streets of Pisa for your return train to Florence; End outside Santa Maria Novella station in the centre of Florence - and where you'll find plenty of taxis.  Famous - or indeed infamous - for an architectural monument gone wrong, the medieval leaning bell tower, Pisa is unquestionably one of the prettiest and most interesting cities in Tuscany.Just an hour's train ride from Florence, visit this medieval and Renaissance city for your iconic photo of the Leaning Tower and come back having enjoyed wandering around its quaint, historic cobbled streets, admiring its mix of gothic and Romanesque architecture, soaking up the vibrant atmosphere and learning about its fascinating history as one of Italy's most important maritime powers in the 16th and 17th centuries. Pisa today is also famous for its elite university, as well as its 'miraculous' architecture - and is definitely a city on the bucket list!

data.name: Tuscany Highlights Small-Group Day Trip
data.description: Discover the countryside and towns of Tuscany on a day trip from Florence, and see more of the region than you could manage alone. You’ll travel with a guide in a small group of no more than 12 people, and enjoy a mix of guided tours, free time, and tastings for an in-depth visit. Highlights include Siena, San Gimignano, the Leaning Tower of Pisa, and lunch at a Tuscan winery.

data.name: Florence: Local Market Visit and Private Cooking Class
data.description: Visit the vibrant local market and the traditional food shops under the guidance of an expert home cook and immerse yourself in a private cooking class at a local's home. Learn the secrets of the most famous dishes of Florence cuisine and taste the fruit of your labour accompanied by a selection of local wines. During the class, the local host will reveal the tricks of the trade of 3 authentic recipes. Have fun putting your cooking skills to the test. Participants will have a workstation equipped with utensils and all the ingredients to make the dishes. Then, taste everything you have prepared over a lovely Italian meal accompanied by a selection of local wines. Every host serves local specialties from their family cookbooks to tell the story of their traditional regional cuisine. A sample menu always includes starter with seasonal ingredients, fresh pasta of the region, and typical dessert. Cesarine is Italy’s oldest network of more than 1000 home cooks all over the country in more than 500 cities. They are passionate and welcoming hosts that open the doors of their own homes to curious travellers for immersive culinary experiences.

data.name: Duomo Complex & Accademia Gallery Tour with Cupola Entry Tickets
data.description:
Join us on a captivating combined tour of Florence’s most iconic landmarks! Begin at the Piazza del Duomo, the city's religious heart, and marvel at Brunelleschi’s architectural masterpiece.

Visit the Galleria dell'Accademia di Firenze, home to Michelangelo’s original David, and let our passionate, art-loving guide bring the Renaissance to life. After the guided portion, ascend the Dome on your own for a breathtaking panoramic view of Florence.

This unforgettable experience blends history, art, and stunning scenery in one perfect tour.

data.name: From Florence to Chianti by E-Bike: Ride Through Vineyards & Hills
data.description: Get ready for an unforgettable adventure through Tuscany's rolling hills! Hop on a powerful e-bike and follow your expert guide from the vibrant heart of Florence, pedaling along scenic paths that lead us into the breathtaking landscapes of Chianti. Feel the thrill as the pedal assisted bike helps you glide through picturesque olive groves and vineyards, reaching the serene area of Mezzomonte, the gateway to the Chianti region. Halfway through our ride, we will pause at a charming organic farm where you will catch a glimpse of the farm’s animals and breathe in the fresh country air. A simple and delicious organic lunch, prepared with local ingredients, we will be served afterwards. On the way back to Florence, take a moment to capture the stunning views of the Tuscan countryside, snap some unforgettable photos, and let the beauty of Tuscany stay with you long after the ride is over.

data.name: The Best Of Classic Florence - Private Tour
data.description: Discover the magic of Florence with an exclusive two-hour private walking tour, led by an expert guide who will take you through the city's most iconic landmarks, including the elegant Via Tornabuoni, renowned for its luxury boutiques.The tour begins in Piazzale San Lorenzo, in front of the historic Basilica of San Lorenzo, one of the oldest churches in Florence and the burial site of the Medici family. Here, you will admire its imposing Brunelleschian architecture and its stunning unfinished façade. After a brief introduction to Florence’s history, we will move towards Piazza del Duomo, where you will be enchanted by the majestic Cathedral of Santa Maria del Fiore, the extraordinary Brunelleschi’s Dome, the magnificent Giotto’s Bell Tower, and the famous Baptistery of St. John, decorated with its splendid Gates of Paradise.We will continue to Piazza della Signoria, the political heart of Florence, dominated by the grand Palazzo Vecchio and the fascinating Loggia dei Lanzi, home to some of the city's most famous sculptures, including a copy of Michelangelo's David.During the tour, we will also stroll along Via Tornabuoni, the ultimate symbol of elegance and luxury shopping, where you will find exclusive boutiques such as Gucci, Prada, Ferragamo, Bulgari, and Cartier, alongside magnificent Renaissance palaces that showcase the city's aristocratic charm.Next, we will cross the Ponte Vecchio, the most famous bridge in Florence, known for its historic goldsmith shops and breathtaking views over the Arno River.This private tour offers a unique opportunity to experience the history, art, and style of Florence in a personalized and relaxed way, perfect for those who want to discover the city in the most exclusive way.Book now for an unforgettable experience in Florence!

data.name: Exclusive Assisi & Sagrantino di Montefalco Wines from Florence
data.description:
True travelers are always driven by a desire to discover new places. This same curiosity inspires those who visit the birthplace of the famous Saint Francis of Assisi. It’s also the region where one of Italy’s finest wines, Sagrantino di Montefalco, is produced.

Ever-changing, untouched landscapes in the green of winding valleys make Umbria a region that will never fail to amaze. Umbria is also a region rich in art, history, culture and spirituality—characterized by an important cultural heritage.

Assisi is a town with religion very close to its heart. Visitors shouldn’t be surprised to see monks in long brown robes roaming the streets or bands of pilgrims walking the country roads surrounding the town.

Pilgrims have been coming to Assisi since the 13th century to venerate St. Francesco, who was born and buried here. But you don’t have to be religious to enjoy one of the best-preserved medieval towns in the world, which is also one of Italy’s most spell-binding gems.

data.name: Florence Private Giotto's Bell Tower Climb and Duomo Museums
data.description: Discover one of the best views in Florence with an exhilarating climb to the top of Giotto’s Bell Tower. A private guide is with you every step of the way. Afterwards, get an up-close look at the famous baptistery doors and original treasures by Michelangelo, Ghiberti, and other masters inside the Opera del Duomo museums.

data.name: Florence Leather Workshop and Golf Cart City Tour
data.description: After the tour of the center of Florence, we will move to the artisan leather workshop of Mrs. Marisol, who will masterfully demonstrate to our guests the process of making a small leather accessory (key ring or card holder).

data.name: Brunelleschi Dome & Cathedral: Premium Skip The Line Ticket
data.description:
It's hard to miss the Opera di Santa Maria del Fiore on the Florentine skyline, distinguished by Brunelleschi's revolutionary Duomo. Tickets to the Duomo di Firenze grant exclusive access to the base of the dome and sweeping 360° views of the birthplace of the Italian Renaissance.

Characterized by its terracotta tiles and white marble ribs against the blue Tuscan sky, the Florence Duomo is the ultimate symbol of Italian Renaissance architecture and stands as a stroke of genius from its creator, Filippo Brunelleschi. With a total height of 116m, the Florence Duomo is the largest masonry vault in the world, all built without the help of a supporting structure.

With your Florence Duomo tickets, you'll gain access to a reserved area of the dome, typically closed to the general public and see the largest mural painting in the world, _The Last Judgement_ by Giorgio Vasari and Federico Zuccari.

data.name: Florence Guided Walking Tour  & Uffizi Skip-the-line Ticket with mobile-guided Tour
data.description: If you want to discover the best of Florence with a friendly professional guide, this is your Tour! Your guide will take you on an exciting journey through time, revealing the history, anecdotes and secrets kept in this wonderful city. From the still visible traces of the Roman foundation of the city (in 59 BC), in the Middle Ages, up to the glorious Renaissance, a period in which Florence was ruled by the powerful Medici family. You will admire the most iconic squares and monuments of Florence among noble palaces and artisan shops. You will discover the spectacular Piazza della Signoria dominated by the majestic Palazzo Vecchio, the Renaissance Palazzo Strozzi, the iconic and picturesque Ponte Vecchio, the district of the Medici family with the ancient Basilica of San Lorenzo, the Medici Chapels and Palazzo Medici-Riccardi, the their first residence. You will be breathless in front of the beauty of the monumental complex of the Duomo, with the Cathedral of Santa Maria del Fiore, the famous Brunelleschi's Dome, the elegant Giotto's Bell Tower and the beautiful Romanesque Baptistery of San Giovanni. After the city center Walking Tour, do not miss the chance to explore one of the most famous Museums in the world in a completely independent way, guided by the audio commentary of our interactive and easy to use APP! Thanks to your skip-the-line ticket and our user-friendly APP-Guide, you will uncover the impressive collection of masterpieces by the most renowned Renaissance artists, without stress and wasting time! Feel free to spend as much time as you wish with the displayed artworks, in an easy and entertaining way! Strolling down the marvelous halls of the gallery, you will be overwhelmed by the unrivaled beauty of the Ognissanti Madonna by Giotto, the Spring and Birth of Venus by Botticelli, the Annunciation and the Adoration of the Magi by Leonardo, the Tondo Doni by Michelangelo, the Bacchus by Caravaggio and many others. Download the APP from the APP Store on your smartphone. The App code and the skip-the line ticket you will be delivered at the Museum entrance. The APP users must be provided by their own smartphone and hearphones. PLUS: if you want, in addition to the guided tour, you can also enjoy an audio guide provided by the APP included in the tour price. In this way you can explore other aspects of the city on your own and in total freedom by following the thematic itineraries available on the app, including "Florence as seen by Dante" dedicated to the great poet who was born in this city and lived until his exile

data.name: Florence: Restaurant Dinner with Concert
data.description: An evening in genuine Italian style, devoted to discovering Tuscan cuisine and the most celebrated Opera arias and famous Neapolitan songs. You will enjoy your dinner in the suggestive atmosphere of a typical Florentine Restaurant, located in Piazza Signoria. A few steps from the Restaurant, talented singers will be awaiting you after dinner in Santo Stefano al Ponte Church, an intimate, old setting to perform the most beautiful arias from the operas of Puccini, Verdi, Rossini and other renowned Italian composers, in addition to world famous Neapolitan songs. The excellent acoustics of this site, its position in the old town centre and its inside magnificently decorated, make this venue unique in its genre. The atmosphere becomes incredibly magic in the night, when the lights turn down and the music fills the religious silence, and the audience immerse itself in the unforgettable experience of the union of Art, Architecture and Music. The performance is inspired by the famous show "The Three Tenors" and accompanied by a corps of ballet. This unforgettable and magnificent concert will leave you a wonderful memory of your trip to Italy!Please Note: No refund is possible if you cancel.

data.name: Florence Uffizi Gallery and Accademia: Private Walking Tour

Then, visit iconic sites like the Florence Cathedral, featuring a magnificent dome designed by Brunelleschi. With your own guide, you can really take your time.

data.name: Electric Bike Tour of the Hills of Florence with delicious "gelato" – small groups
data.description: Admire Florence magnificent hills in an active and original way and be surprised using this new electric bike that allows you to see a lot with little effort! Anyone who knows how to ride a bike, though not in tip-top shape, can embark on this wonderful adventure with the help of the new technology! Climbing once again, you can admire the magnificent Romanesque basilica of San Miniato al Monte, and then immerse yourself into the sound, the good smells and the colours of the countryside, with secular cypresses, olive groves and small vineyards hidden in the middle of the hills from where to enjoy amazing and breathtaking views. Finally, what better way to end such a fantastic tour, than tasting one of the best “gelato” of the city? After all, ice cream was invented exactly in Florence and Florentines love to enjoy one with their friends, so… cone or cup??

data.name: Florence Small-Group City Highlights Sightseeing Tour
data.description: Meet your guide in the Piazza della Repubblica in central Florence, for a welcome presentation at 9:30 am. Then begin your walking tour along the Arno River as you walk across the medieval arches of Ponte Vecchio before continuing on to Palazzo Strozzi where you explore the courtyard. data.name: Pasta & Tiramisu Cooking Class + Italian Market Tour in Florence
data.description: This cooking class stands out by offering an authentic and immersive experience in the heart of Florence. Back in our traditional Tuscan kitchen, you’ll learn to prepare classic Italian dishes from scratch, including tagliatelle with ragù sauce, ricotta and spinach-stuffed ravioli, and the iconic tiramisu. Our small group setting ensures personalized attention, making it perfect for food enthusiasts of all ages. data.name: Olive Oil & Wine Tasting with Traditional Lunch in Barberino Tavarnelle
data.description: Discover the culinary traditions of Tuscany in one of the most breathtaking locations in the Chianti Classico wine region. Your journey begins in a historic 17th-century villa with panoramic views of the rolling Tuscan countryside. Upon arrival, enjoy an Italian-style moka coffee while learning about the villa’s history and the family’s winemaking heritage. You’ll then embark on a guided walk through the estate’s vineyards, olive groves, and gardens, discovering the art of homemade wine production and organic vegetable cultivation. Learn the secrets of Extra Virgin Olive Oil (EVOO) production, passed down through three generations of the family. Our experts will guide you through a professional olive oil tasting, where you’ll discover the different varieties of Italian olives and how to distinguish a high-quality EVOO from the rest. The experience continues with a delicious Tuscan light lunch, featuring: - A selection of local cheeses, cured meats, and freshly baked bread - A homemade pasta dish crafted with seasonal ingredients - A tasting of the villa’s handcrafted wine, perfectly paired with your meal - The stunning backdrop of the Tuscan hills, offering an unforgettable dining experience This authentic Tuscan tasting experience is perfect for food and wine lovers, offering an intimate, farm-to-table experience in one of Italy’s most celebrated wine regions.

data.name: Accademia Gallery Ticket with Direct Access  &  Florence Walking Tour
data.description: Skip the line to enjoy at your own pace the beautiful Accademia Gallery, one of the most famous art galleries in the world. Among other wonderful masterpieces, you will be able to admire works of art by Michelangelo including his most famous work, David, as well as other important works of art such as “I Prigioni” and “San Matteo”. The young Michelangelo carved the David from a huge block of rough marble in three years, creating an imposing sculpture of absolute beauty, an icon of the renaissance model. He depicted a magnificent nude young man at the height of his physical vigor, whose intense expression of strength and courage, which originated from an absolute faith in God, roses as a symbol of power and invincibility of the Florentine Republic at the time of its maximum splendor. Explore the city of Florence, with a Walking Tour with a professional English speaking guide. Learn about the powerful Medici family who ruled the city during the Renaissance era, discover the places where they lived in the San Lorenzo neighborhood and be fascinated by the beauty of the Duomo Monumental Complex with the Cathedral, the Brunelleschi Dome and the Giotto Bell Tower. Admire the Basilica di Santa Croce, a masterpiece of Gothic art and the elegant Renaissance façade of the Basilica di Santa Maria Novella. Explore the medieval quarter of the city, seeing Piazza della Signoria, the Ponte Vecchio and the Oltrarno Neighborhood with Palazzo Pitti. Then take full advantage of your APP Guide and enjoy unlimited self-guided sightseeing from your own mobile device, with suggested itineraries that you can join in total freedom!

data.name: Skip the line: Florence Duomo Cathedral small group guided tour
data.description:

Better known as the Duomo, this timeless masterpiece has become the symbol of the city of Florence over the years. You will SKIP THE LONG LINES at the entrance, which will save you precious time during your vacation! Your local guide will take you on a JOURNEY THROUGH TIME to discover the history of the creation of the Duomo: learn about its origins as a VII century small church and how it became the THIRD LARGEST CATHEDRAL IN THE WORLD. The anecdotes of the innovative techniques used by Filippo Brunelleschi to build the Dome will leave you speechless. Thanks to a preferential route reserved exclusively for our group, you can access the area below the Dome, to admire closely Zuccari and VASARI’S FRESCOES depicting THE LAST JUDGMENT.

data.name: Private Guided Tour of Florence Basilicas and their Cloisters
data.description: Meet your private guide and you will head towards the striking square where the Basilica di Santa Maria Novella stands with its splendid Renaissance façade by Leon Battista Alberti covered with white and green marble. Inside the Basilica, founded by the Dominican Fathers at the beginning of 1200, you will have the chance to see masterpieces such as the "Crucifix" by Giotto the "Trinity" by Masaccio and the spectacular frescoes by Filippino Lippi and Ghirlandaio and also hear the story of the "mendicant order" of friars who have always been present in this church. Your tour ends inside the elegant "Green Cloister" so named for its beautiful murals in green earth by Paolo Uccello. In the heart of the lively Medici quarter, bordering the Piazza del Duomo, you will find yourselves in front of the Basilica di San Lorenzo, Florence's the oldest church, consecrated in 393 by Sant'Ambrogio, rebuilt in the year 1000 and enlarged in 1400 by Brunelleschi at the behest of the Medici family who chose it as their parish church. Inside the Basilica is the “Old Sacristy”by Brunelleschi with the tombs of the founders of the Medici family and works by Donatello, Bronzino, Filippo Lippi, Rosso Fiorentino and Pontormo, to name but a few. Leaving the church, you will enter in the impressive “Cloister of the Canons” at the centre of which stands an imposing 16th-century orange tree which was dear to the Medici family and became a kind of symbol of their dynasty. You will then pass into the Piazza del Duomo, the city's religious centre, where you will be able admire the Cathedral with its famous Dome, the Baptistery and Giotto's Campanile (bell tower). Soon we will arrive at the famous Piazza della Signoria, a concentration of architectural and sculptural masterpieces which has no equal in the world. Here begins the fascinating story of the powerful Medici family whose history was tied to that of the city for more than three centuries. Your tour ends at the Basilica di Santa Croce, a masterpiece of Gothic architecture with a facade clad in polychrome marble. This is the ancient church in which the Franciscan friars chose to set up and begin treating pelts and leather and meditate in peace in a place that was, at that time, located outside the city walls. We will admire, from close up, the beautiful frescoes by Giotto and Agnolo Gaddi, the “Crucifix” and “Annunciation” by Donatello and the world-famous funerary monuments and tombs of illustrious figures from the past such as Michelangelo, Galileo and Machiavelli. Next, we will enter the elegant “Brunelleschi Cloister” bordered by columns carved from pure stone, and then pass into the fourteenth-century “Ancient Cloister” at the end of which lies the beautiful “Pazzi Chapel”, a sublime example of Renaissance harmony, also the work of Brunelleschi.

data.name: Florence Private Tour: Brunelleschi’s Dome Experience
data.description:
Unlock the mysteries of Florence's iconic Duomo with our exclusive private guided visit!

Immerse yourself in the captivating history of this architectural marvel. The history of this monument is ancient and very peculiar: it began in 1418, when a daring competition was announced to design the Dome. Imagine the scene - leading architects flocking to Florence, each competing for the grand prize: 200 gold florins and everlasting fame!

Brunelleschi was the winner, with Lorenzo Ghiberti by his side as co-superintendent. Many considered the design absurd, declaring it impossible: the construction was indeed difficult and full of obstacles, yet Brunelleschi's genius prevailed. Witness the fruits of his vision first-hand as your private guide leads you on a captivating journey up the Dome.

After the guided tour of the Dome, with the same ticket, you will have 72 hour to visit the other attractions of the Complex at your own pace.

Book now and discover the magic of the Duomo!

data.name: Palatine Gallery and Pitti skip-the-line tickets and guided tour
data.description: Enjoy the guided tour inside Palazzo Pitti, which was built during the 15th century and then bought by the Medici Family, becoming their glorious residence. The guide will escort you through the Palatine Gallery (Galleria Palatina) in order to admire the beauties kept there. This private collection is made up of a vast group of paintings owned by the Grand Dukes, and they are displayed in the official staterooms on the first floor of the Pitti Palace.Along with your guide, you will discover dozens of Renaissance paintings, including the most remarkable masterpieces by Botticelli, Titian, Rubens, Caravaggio, and many other Italian and European painters from the 15th to the 17th century, through the Planetary Rooms. These rooms were designed by the great Baroque painter Pietro da Cortona and they create an overwhelmingly stunning environment of frescoes and stucco, where you will soon find that this beautiful setting provides the perfect background of the superb exhibition of paintings from the Medici collection.Finally, you will visit the royal apartments. The tour takes about one and a half hours, the perfect amount of time to appreciate the art collections, and you are also free to return to anything you might want to see again after the tour ends. This is the ideal tour for anyone who enjoys both art and history, and your knowledgeable tour guide makes it even better.

data.name: Historic Florence: Guided Walking Tour
data.description: Florence is packed with attractions—so much so, that the Renaissance city is often called an “open-air museum.” Tick off more landmarks than you ever could on your own by booking this guided walking tour. Your guide will reveal Florence's rich history and culture as they lead you through the city, from the Palazzo Medici to the Duomo, Ponte Vecchio, and Palazzo Pitti.

data.name: Florence Haunted Secrets: Echoes of the Dead Exploration Game
data.description: Embark on a quest around Florence by solving clues based on the real story of the Monster of Florence, a serial killer that killed 20 people, all with the help of your smartphone. Unlock new stories as you discover on your own Palazzo Vecchio, the Santa Maria del Fiore Cathedral and Dome, Loggia del Bigallo, and more. + Discover the real story of the so-called Monster of Florence + Visit the scenes of the crimes, following the directions on your app + Explore the haunting stories of Piazza della Signoria and Palazzo Vecchio Each clue will lead you from one place to another, giving you exact directions, so you won’t need a map or GPS. Once solved and answered correctly, the secret story of that place is unlocked. The tour and clues can be followed at any hour, but it is recommended that you try it at night, for the full haunted experience. There’s no time limit, so you can finish it at your own pace. Start and stop whenever you want. Are you ready? Book now!

data.name: 8 hour exploring Florence in E-Bike

data.name: Pisa, Lucca, and Volterra Tour from Florence
data.description:
Meet your guide and tour group at a central location near the main train station in Florence. In a comfortable tour vehicle, transfer to your first destination: Pisa. 

Once you arrive, meet your local guide and embark on a walking tour of the Piazza dei Miracoli. Hit all the landmarks, such as the famous Leaning Tower, the Baptistery, and the Cathedral. Please note: If there is a long queue at the Cathedral, you will visit the Piazza dei Cavalieri instead. At the conclusion of your tour, spend some free time shopping and exploring, or grabbing a bite to eat. 

Continue to Lucca, where you'll take a walking tour along the city's 16th-century walls and into the historical city center. Stop at highlights such as the antique dealers' street, the Duomo di San Martino, the Torre Guinigi, and the Piazza Anfiteatro. End your tour with a pastry tasting in a historic café and some free time. 

Travel back to Florence for drop-off at your original location.

data.name: Pisa, Siena & San Gimignano: Day Trip from Florence + Wine Tasting
data.description:
Witness the magic of the Tuscan hills with a day trip from Florence to Siena, San Gimignano, and Pisa, including a traditional Tuscan lunch in a typical wine cellar.

In a comfortable coach bus, your day trip from Florence will have you traveling through the hills, vineyards, and cypress-lined roads of Tuscany, where each glance out of the window is worthy of a postcard.

Once you spot the tell-tale white marble tower in the distance, you'll know you're in Pisa. Spend your free time admiring the beauty of Piazza dei Miracoli with a self-guided tour and snap pictures of the leaning tower.

Then, traverse through the vineyards between Pisa and Siena to San Gimignano, where a self-guided tour of the towers tells the glories of powerful Italian families through the ages. Between sunflower fields, olive tree groves, and ancient vineyards, it doesn't get more Tuscan than this.

data.name: Florence Historic Markets Food Tour & Semi Private Cooking Class
data.description: Indulge in Florence like a VIP! Join our exclusive cooking adventure. Explore hidden shops brimming with authentic Tuscan flavors on a guided walking tour. Learn from a passionate chef, taste gourmet products, and gather fresh ingredients. In a small group, receive personalized attention as you transform into a master of Italian cuisine. Craft handmade pasta, rich sauces, and delectable desserts using traditional methods. Savor your creations paired with Tuscan wines. Take home a recipe booklet and a Florence guidebook - Buon appetito!

data.name: Private Transfer Florence to Rome with Optional Orvieto Stop
data.description: Maximize travel time between Florence and Rome with private transportation. Get picked up at your hotel in Florence by an English-speaking driver and drive to Rome in an air-conditioned vehicle. Customize the trip with a stop in the town of Orvieto and use free time to explore at your own pace. Get dropped off directly at your hotel in Rome.

data.name: 2-Hours Walking Tour in Florence
data.description: Choose your own course on this 2-hour guided walking tour of Florence. See the must-see sites, including the Duomo and Ponte Vecchio or opt to go somewhat off the beaten path by seeing Boboli Gardens and the Church of Santo Spirito, among many other spots. This is a great option for first timers and return visitors.

data.name: Florence: Small Group Guided Wine Making Workshop + Tasting
data.description:
Join a masterclass to create your wine. Taste six single-variety wines and learn about Tuscan winemaking. Blend your ideal wine and take home a personalized bottle.

In this small-group session, a wine expert will guide you through local traditions. Discover the aromas and characteristics of six different wines, then blend your favorites to create a wine that matches your taste.

During the blending activity, enjoy local foods and hear stories about Tuscany’s wine heritage. Finish by bottling your wine and designing a custom label to take home.

data.name: Private Transfer from La Spezia to Florence
data.description: Enjoy a hassle-free arrival in Florence with our private transfer service full of wonderful experiences and insights into the local culture. Meet your driver wherever you wish in La Spezia and relax on the journey to one of the most beautiful cities in the world. Our experienced local driver always has your safety and comfort in mind, from the beginning of the trip, when he picks you up in La Spezia at your desired time, until the end of your journey in your chosen location in Florence. data.name: Authentic Pasta Making Class in Florence with a Local Chef
data.description:
Join a hands-on, 2.5-hour cooking class led by one of Florence’s most talented pastaioli (pasta makers). Learn the secrets of traditional Italian pasta from scratch using fresh, local ingredients.

Under expert guidance, you’ll craft your own personalized pasta shapes and sauces — from silky tagliatelle to delicate ravioli — all while enjoying a fun, authentic culinary experience in the heart of Tuscany. Whether you're a beginner or a food lover, this class is the perfect way to deepen your appreciation for Italy’s most beloved dish.

data.name: Florence by Bike: Audio Guided Tour with Live Guide
data.description: If you are a lover of classical biking this Tour is perfect for you. This mobility approach that we propose is ideal to visit Florence , a city that is people-friendly but has a relatively large Downtown. Our guide will bring you through squares, streets, and alleys that are rich in history and Art. The Tour will make you live again in the centuries of glorious events and will bring you to the discovery of artist of the caliber of Brunelleschi, Donatello, Michelangelo, Leonardo and many others. Thanks to our comfortable Bikes, we will be able to visit all the four historical neighborhood of the city: San Giovanni, Santa Maria Novella, Santo Spitito and Santa Croce. We guarantee an unforgettable experience that will be at the same time instructive and fun. Everything will be carried out with an eco-friendly approach ... Firenze thanks you !

data.name: Florence Duomo Complex and Wine Tasting Tour with Cupola Tickets
data.description:
Immerse yourself in the heart of Florence with this Duomo complex and wine tasting tour! Explore the iconic sites of the Duomo Complex with a skip-the-line guide, unlocking the secrets of the Baptistery, Cathedral, Giotto's Bell Tower, and the Opera del Duomo Museum. Witness Brunelleschi's architectural marvel firsthand, and be awestruck by the artistic masterpieces within.

Later, tantalize your taste buds with a guided wine tasting led by an expert. Savor delicious Tuscan wines paired perfectly with a platter of regional appetizers – a delightful conclusion to your Florentine adventure!

data.name: Private Florence Guided City Tour with visit of the Uffizi Gallery
data.description: Meet your private driver and guide at your hotel for a fine and chauffeured private tour offering panoramic views of the unparalleled beauty of Florence, Piazzale Michelangelo: a stop to admire the wonderful panorama of the city, one of the most beautiful in the world. The tour continues to the old city centre for a visit to the Franciscan Church of Santa Croce (exterior). A short walk with your private and expert guide through the historic streets of the heart of Florence brings you to the famous Piazza Signoria, where you can admire the imposing Palazzo Vecchio (exterior) and the beautiful Loggia del Lanzi. Your private tour continues with the guided visit of the famous Uffizi Gallery where you can admire the superb paintings of Botticelli, Michelangelo, Leonardo da Vinci, Raffaello, Giotto, Cimabue, Masaccio. Your private guide will bring you at the Uffizi Terrace where you can enjoy an amazing and exclusive view of the city’s most important monuments. Once the private guided tour is over, it is possible to stay in the museum.

data.name: Private Full day Florence with Accademia and Uffizi Galleries
data.description: An expert private guide will be with you all day to show the city. This is the best way to know a place thanks to the comments of who lives the city every day and knows it like no one else. During the morning meet your private guide at your Hotel and visit the renowned Accademia Gallery, where you can admire the famous David by Michelangelo and other works by the great artists. The tour proceeds then with a walking tour including the outdoor guided visit of San Lorenzo Church and the Duomo complex: the Baptistery with its bronze doors including the famous Porta del Paradiso and the Cathedral with the magnificent Brunelleschi’s Dome and Giotto’s Bell Tower. Then you drive along the romantic Viale dei Colli up to Piazzale Michelangelo: a stop to admire the wonderful panorama of the city, one of the most beautiful in the world. Free time for lunch. During the afternoon, a fine car tour, by chauffeured vehicle, will offer panoramic views of the unparalleled beauty of Florence, taking in Fiesole, a delightful town of Etruscan origin set on the hills overlooking Florence and the Arno Valley. Your private tour continues to the old city center for a visit to the Franciscan Church of Santa Croce (exterior). A short walk through the historic streets of the heart of Florence brings you to the famous Piazza Signoria, where your private guide is pleased to show you the imposing Palazzo Vecchio (exterior) and the beautiful Loggia dei Lanzi. The tour continues with a private guided tour of the famous Galleria degli Uffizi where you can admire the superb paintings of Botticelli,Michelangelo, Leonardo da Vinci, Raffaello,Giotto, Cimabue, Masaccio. The guided tour ends at the Uffizi Terrace where you can enjoy an amazing and exclusive view of the city’s most important monuments. Once your private guided tour is over, it is possible to stay in the museum. Please note that the order of the visits may change

data.name: Palazzo Vecchio Secret Passages Guided Tour with Skip the Line Admission and Lunch
data.description: Experience the exciting discovery of Palazzo Vecchio´s secret paths that are not accessible to the general public. Only recently these areas have been made available for small groups (maximum of 12). Ascend the narrow passages of Duke Gualtieri´s medieval stairway and you will discover an unexpected path beyond a door hidden by a painting. Admire the precious and imposing coffered ceiling of the Salone dei Cinquecento as you explore the Medicean Palace from a different, intriguing prospect. data.name: Florence Guided Tour of Boboli Gardens
data.description: Discover the enchanting paths of Boboli, the traditional Italian garden, with an easy 1-hour guided tour. Admire the elegant fountains, classical statues, and breathtaking views that have captivated Florentine nobility for centuries. Immerse yourself in the courtly life of the noble Medici family as you explore a place rich in history and beauty. After your tour, enjoy free time to wander the grounds on your own.

data.name: Italian Opera at Museo Zeffirelli
