data.name: 3 Days Tuscany Highlights Tour: Pisa, San Gimignano, Siena and Florence
data.description: DAY 1: Pisa, San Gimignano & Siena On the first day, depart from Florence and travel to Pisa, where you'll be mesmerized by the iconic Leaning Tower, the Cathedral, and the Baptistery in the stunning Piazza dei Miracoli. Afterward, continue your journey to San Gimignano, a medieval gem famous for its towers and enchanting streets. Here, you’ll enjoy a traditional Tuscan lunch with a delightful wine pairing. In the afternoon, arrive in Siena, where a guided walking tour will introduce you to the city's rich history and notable landmarks, including the renowned Piazza del Campo and the charming, winding streets of the city center. Please note that there is no entry to the Cathedral. In the evening, check in to your 4-star centrally located hotel in Siena, where you can unwind and explore the city at your leisure, soaking in its unique atmosphere. DAY 2: Leisure in Siena & Return to Florence After a delicious breakfast, the morning is yours to enjoy at your own pace in Siena. You may choose to wander the picturesque streets, shop for local crafts, or simply relax at one of the inviting cafés. In the afternoon, meet your group again and make your way back to Florence, taking in the stunning Tuscan countryside along the way. Once you arrive, check in to your 4-star centrally located hotel in Florence. The evening is yours to explore Florence’s vibrant streets and indulge in a memorable dinner at one of the city’s excellent restaurants. DAY 3: Florence Exploration Your final day begins with an exploration of the most important sites of Florence with this amazing guided walking tour! Visit both the religious and the political heart of the city center, including San Lorenzo, Piazza del Duomo, Piazza Signoria, Palazzo Vecchio and much more! Thank you for choosing us to experience the beauty and culture of Tuscany and Florence. Buon Viaggio e Arrivederci Not Refundable and not Modifiable Package

data.name: Florence 2 Budapest, Vienna & Salzburg
data.description: Three cities, two countries, one weekend. These three cities are a winter wonderland, perfect to explore at the beginning of your semester abroad. Get off the beaten path and check out the Eastern European hotspot of Budapest, where you can relax (and warm up) in the renowned outdoor thermal baths, heated by naturally warm spring waters. When the sun sets, dine while cruising past the glowing monuments on the banks of the Danube River, then check out the local ruin bar scene. Next, head west to Vienna to indulge in the mother of all chocolate cakes, Sachertorte. Marvel at the palaces of the Habsburg Empire and feast on Wiener Schnitzel, an Austrian delicacy. In Salzburg, sing along with the Von Trapps on the Sound of Music tour while winding your way through the rolling green Alps, or adventure off on your own to admire the view from the Hohensalzburg Fortress. This trip typically departs Santa Maria Novella station at 19:00 Thursday night and arrives first thing Friday morning between 07:30 and 08:00. Included: Round trip luxury coach transport (with A/C, and a DVD player) Stay with your friends at top-rated accommodations Breakfast each morning Budapest walking tour Vienna walking tour Szechenyi Thermal Baths One included dinner and lunch Exclusive discounts on Danube Dinner cruise, Sound of Music tour and other activities Bus2alps trip leader

data.name: Florence: Wine Tastings + Minivan Tour
data.shortDescription: Be whisked away to Tuscan hills to discover unique wines!
data.description:
Ready for a scenic journey soaked in Tuscan beauty and wine culture? Dive headfirst into the heart of Chianti on a minivan tour through rolling vineyards and traditional wineries! 

This tasty tour uncovers family-run cellars and classic tastes, offering a chance to try Chianti Classico, Riserva, and other exceptional wines. 

Each taste is perfectly paired with a delightful appetizer, made from locally sourced products. Why not hand-select your favourite bottles from the tour to take home?

This adventure is perfect for wine lovers, and those seeking a romantic escape filled with delectable food and drink.

data.name: Officina Profumo-Farmaceutica, Ferragamo Museum and Gucci Palace Fashion Tour in Florence
data.description: Step into the world of Italian fashion and elegance with a private sightseeing tour through Florence’s most iconic style landmarks.Begin your experience at the Gucci Garden Museum, located in the historic Palazzo della Mercanzia. This vibrant space showcases the evolution of the Gucci brand through fashion pieces, multimedia installations, and archival treasures that reflect the creativity and boldness of one of Italy’s most influential fashion houses.Continue to the Salvatore Ferragamo Museum, where you’ll explore the legacy of the legendary shoe designer. Discover his most iconic creations and learn about his innovative craftsmanship that shaped 20th-century fashion.Conclude your tour with a visit to the enchanting Officina Profumo-Farmaceutica di Santa Maria Novella, Europe’s oldest historic pharmacy, dating back to 1612. Still active today, it offers an immersive experience with its Renaissance-era fragrances, herbal remedies, and beautifully preserved interiors.Throughout the tour, your certified guide will share fascinating stories and insights into Florence’s enduring influence on the world of fashion and design.

data.name: The Walled City of Lucca: Private Day Trip from Florence by Train
data.description: Explore the picture-perfect Italian city of medieval Lucca on this privately guided day trip from Florence by train. Lucca, the birthplace of Puccini, is famous for its exquisite and beautifully preserved medieval and Renaissance architecture, the old ramparts that protect the city, and its atmospheric cobblestone streets. On your private tour, you will: Meet your guide outside Florence's train station Santa Maria Novella;   Catch the train to Lucca, enjoy the scenic countryside views of Tuscany and your guide's expert commentary on the historical background of Lucca;  Once in Lucca, admire, first of all, the fortress-like wall that encases the city called the "Mura di Luca";  Walk around the historic centre, stopping to admire and learn about the highlights of the city – with its mix of Ancient Roman, medieval, and Renaissance architecture;   Walk into Piazza Napoleone, dedicated to Napoleon and bordered by the 16th-century Ducal Palace of Lucca;  Explore the stunning medieval complex of buildings that include the Cathedral of St Martin and the Church of Saint John and Saint Reparata – first built in the 5th century;  See the iconic Guinigi Tower built as a symbol of wealth and power in the 14th century and planted with oak trees at the top;  Walk around the stunning Piazza dell'Anfiteatro built on top of a 1st-century Roman Amphitheatre;   Admire the huge and stunning Byzantine mosaics on the outside of the Romanesque Basilica di San Frediano;  Pass by the famous clock tower, and be wowed by the soaring façade of the Church of St Michael in Foro, built upon the old Forum in the 1100s;  Stop outside the house museum dedicated to the life of composer Puccini;   Enjoy a last stroll through the charming cobbled streets and alleyways of Lucca as you return to the train station;  Take the return train arriving at Santa Maria Novella in time to enjoy a full afternoon in Florence! Lucca is a Tuscan city famous for its imposing medieval walls – so wide you can walk and cycle on them, the massive 14th-century Guinigi Tower, its charming and well-preserved architecture dating from the medieval to Renaissance period, its Piazza dell Anfiteatro and St Michael’s Church (both built on top of ancient Roman ruins) as well as for being the birthplace of Puccini. Enjoy strolling its gorgeous streets, learning all about its stunning architecture and its place as a powerful city of trade during the medieval period – as attested by the vast Guinigi Tower. A fabulous and fascinating day trip from Florence.

data.name: Treasures of Florence walking tour with Accademia and Uffizi skip-the-line tickets
data.description: Visit two of the most famous museums in the world, the Accademia Gallery and the Uffizi Gallery, skipping the long lines at the entrance. Join a walking tour of Florence and discover its main attractions with explanations from a professional guide.At the Accademia Gallery, you'll learn why Michelangelo's David is the most recognizable symbol of Florence and what it used to represent in his time. How did Michelangelo meet the challenge of extracting the pathos of a being and fixing it forever in time in the Pietà, or the famous Prisoners who still seem to struggle free from their marble blocks? You will have the answers to all your questions.After the guided tour, you will have some free time to wander around on your own. Then, enjoy an introductory tour to learn about Florentine history, from the city's Roman origins to a 15th-century palace, from Ponte Vecchio, passing through the famous Uffizi courtyard, to the wonderful architecture of Brunelleschi's Dome.Next, visit one of the most famous museums in the world: the Uffizi Gallery. Your guide will explain the works of the greatest artists from the Middle Ages to the Renaissance: Cimabue, Giotto, Botticelli, Leonardo da Vinci, Michelangelo, Raphael, Titian and many others. Discover the secrets of the craft, techniques and tools of great artists and learn why Florence is considered the cradle of the Renaissance. After the tour, you will have the chance to stay longer in the museum and explore it on your own.

data.name: OT Florence Footsteps of Medici Tour
data.description: TOUR HIGHLIGHTSDiscover the stories of the most elite families of the timeWalk to see the most important streets and palacesSee the stunning architecture of the historical buildingsDiscover the Medici's story with a walk through the most important streets and palaces. From Giovanni de Medici to Lorenzo de Medici, see, hear about, and understand the power of this incredible family.

data.name: Clay Sculpture Art Class in Florence
data.description: You'll be transported back to the Florentine Renaissance era with an engaging art class. This experience offers a deep dive into the world of sculpture, allowing you to understand its creation process using traditional materials that birthed some of the most renowned works.During this three-hour session, under the guidance of a master sculptor, you'll work with water-based clay to recreate a figure or an anatomical detail inspired by Michelangelo's David. As your hands delve into the moist, velvety texture of the clay, it responds to your touch and pressure, taking on the shape you give it. This tactile and visual interaction fosters an intimate connection between you and the clay, creating a silent dialogue as the material transforms under your hands.This immersive experience is suitable for all skill levels and highly recommended for art enthusiasts. It provides a rare opportunity to explore and learn the secrets of sculpture in a city known for its rich artistic heritage.

data.name: Florence Palazzo Vecchio Private Tour
data.description: On the outside, the 13th-century Palazzo Vecchio looks like a stone fortress — on the inside, it's as lavish as Versailles. On this tour, you’ll get to know the palace’s stories and secrets from a local guide, wandering amongst private rooms and frescoed halls that have seen generations upon generations of royalty. With 800+ years of Florentine history, there’s so much to discover.

data.name: Florence Renaissance and Medieval guided tour with Accademia and lunch
data.description: Start your Tour from the very heart of Florence, with the guided visit of Accademia Gallery, with a total immersion in the art of Michelangelo to know his most renowned works, the “David”, and other important masterpieces such as ''I Prigioni'', ''San Matteo'' and the “Palestrina Pietà”.Then you will proceed with a walking tour which will include the outdoor guided visit to San Lorenzo Church and the Duomo complex. The walk continues along lively Via Calzaiuoli in the heart of the city, where you can admire the imposing and singular Orsanmichele Church, a masterpiece of Florentine gothic art, decorated with shrines with statues of the patron saints of the powerful medieval trade guilds. Then you reach the bustling Mercato della Paglia (Straw Market): don’t forget to rub the nose of the famous "porcellino" (pig) and toss a coin into the fountain to bring you good luck! Going on, you can admire the romantic, picturesque Ponte Vecchio, the oldest bridge in Florence, with its renowned jewelry shops. Your lovely blast from the past will end in Piazza Signoria, one of the most beautiful squares in the world and the political center of the city. Dominating the square is the majestic Palazzo Vecchio with its crenelated Arnolfo tower, one of the most famous symbols of Florence that you will be able to admire in all its magnificence.End this amazing tour with a tasty Tuscan Lunch in a restaurant located in the old town.Please note that the order of the visits may change

data.name: Uffizi Gallery: Skip The Line Ticket + Small Group Guided Tour
data.description:
Florence's Uffizi Gallery sits proudly among the world's pantheon of premier art museums. Filled with Renaissance and Baroque masterworks, the Uffizi is an odyssey into the evolution of art, and a must-see during any visit to Tuscany.

Skip the line and waltz right in for a guided tour of some of the most iconic and important artworks in the world. Botticelli, da Vinci, Michelangelo, Raphael, and Caravaggio are just some of the names you'll be casually dropping into conversation afterward!

data.name: Ferrari Lamborghini, Balsamic Vinegar Private Tour from Florence
data.description:
Discover the famous Italian engines that have made their mark on history and taste the art of balsamic vinegar.

Let's get the engines revving and hit the road: this full day private tour will take us to the Italian Motor Valley. We will visit the Ducati Factory, the Ferrari Museum, and the Lamborghini Museum. This trip is for those who are passionate about motors and supercars. And for the gourmets among you, we will also stop at a Balsamic Vinegar Factory.

Have you ever dreamed of driving a Ferrari? Or maybe you'd prefer to cruise around on a Ducati motorcycle? Either way, you can't go wrong with Italian sports cars. These vehicles are recognized all over the world for their style and performance. And if you visit the Ferrari Museum, you'll see just how popular these cars are – with over 200,000 fans visiting from all corners of the globe every year. Did you know that each Lamborghini engine is assembled by hand? You'll learn all about that.

data.name: Florence Guided Tour by Electric Golf Cart
data.description: Make every minute count in Florence with this city tour on board an electric golf cart. Take in the top sights in under two hours without getting footsore, learning about the history and culture of the “Cradle of the Renaissance” along the way via an audio guide. Snap photos as you zip past the Duomo, Piazza della Signoria, Ponte Vecchio, and other iconic landmarks.

data.name: Tuscany Cheese and Wine-Tasting Tour with Lunch from Florence
data.description:
Meet your guide in central Florence and hop aboard an air-conditioned, 4x4 minibus. Watch the city streets transform into the rolling hillside of Chianti, lined with vineyards and olive groves.

Your first stop of the day is at a winery belonging to one of the most prominent Italian families. Taste wines paired with cured meats and olive oils, and enjoy a guided tour of the historic wine cellars. Travel to the olive mill through the villa's underground tunnels, as well as to the garden.

Afterward, head to a Tuscan winery restaurant and settle in for a 3-course meal, including regional specialties such as different types of fresh pasta and glasses of fine Chianti wine. (See the Itinerary for a sample menu).

The adventure continues as we continue our drive through the incredible countryside on our way to our final stop of the day.

Here you will take a tour of the impressive villa and walk around the stunning grounds, soaking in the unique beauty and views, whilst learning more about wine before you sit for the final tasting of three wines paired with cheese. The perfect end to a truly unforgettable day.

data.name: Grand Christmas Concert
data.description: Enjoy a wonderful christmas concert in the city of Florence. The event will take place in the beatiful venue Chiesa di Santa Felicita.

data.name: Florence to Emilia-Romagna Private Gastronomy and Car Tour
data.description: Embark on an exciting day trip from Florence to Emilia-Romagna, the heart of Italy’s luxury car and gourmet scene. Explore iconic Ferrari, Maserati, or Pagani museums and witness the craftsmanship behind these legendary sports cars. Dive into the region’s culinary heritage with tastings of Parmigiano-Reggiano, traditional balsamic vinegar, and Lambrusco wine. Then enjoy a light, locally-produced lunch to cap off your day.

data.name: Florence: Vintage Fiat 500 Private Sunset Tour with Dinner
data.description: Explore the Tuscan countryside in a unique way on this private vintage Fiat 500 sunset tour from Florence. You'll drive a restored 1960s car with insights from your guide, cruising scenic backroads far from the usual crowds. Pause to soak in panoramic views, explore one of Florence’s oldest churches, and enjoy a leisurely Tuscan dinner on a peaceful terrace. From start to finish, it’s a memorable way to experience the region’s charm, with plenty of stories, flavors, and photo stops along the way.

data.name: Private Tour - Grand Panoramic Tour of Florence and Wine tasting
data.description: A  4-hour private tour by minivan during which you will admire Florence from all its best panoramic spots. The first stop of our tour will be Piazzale Michelangelo, probably the most popular observation point of Florence: from here you can see the whole city and take epic photos. We will drive past the Church of San Miniato al Monte too, one of the finest Romanesque structures in Tuscany.Then we will move to Forte Belvedere fortress, maybe less famous than the previous spot, but with an even better view overlooking Florence: you will feel as if you can touch Brunelleschi's Dome.Afterwards, we will head to the Etruscan city of Fiesole: a hilltop town overlooking Florence, with a romantic panoramic terrace.

data.name: Pizza and Gelato Making class in Florence
data.description: Learn how to make two of the most delicious Italian dishes: pizza and ‘gelato’. Meet our chef, learn the techniques and bring home the recipes to make them at home. The chef will start the class by introducing the history of these Italian wonderful creations briefly. After that you will learn how to make the original Italian pizza step by step: you will be taught the tricks for tender flexible yeast dough as well as for a tasteful, yet light, tomato sauce. Our chef will show you the right way to stretch the dough and you will have the chance to do it yourself. You will make your very own pizza: you will stretch it, sauce it and finally bake it. The result will surely be the best pizza you have ever tasted! After you have become familiar with pizza you will be taught the secrets to making Italian ‘gelato’: you will get to know the basic raw ingredients and how to select the best products. You will learn about the development and application of natural colors, the heating and freezing techniques, and how they have different effects on ingredients. You will soon realize how easily you can make these delicious dishes on your own! At the end of the class, you will also get a Graduation Certificate! Then you can go home and impress your friends with your great Italian creation skills. In the end, you will be driven back to the departure place in the center of Florence.

data.name: Florentine Gondola Boat Tour
data.description: Come aboard this Florentine gondola for a romantic and unique cruise on the Arno river! Meet your guide and enjoy a short walk through Piazza Signoria and Piazzale degli Uffizi, admiring the Ponte Vecchio bridge from the bank all the way through to the pier.Get on board the “barchetto”, one of the few four original and traditional wooden boats left in Florence, conducted by a “barcaiolo”, who will guide the boat with his long-reaching pole. Your expert guide will unveil the secrets of the Arno river as you sail on its calm waters, discovering the history and the beautiful palazzos that frame its ancient riverbed. The commentary is informative but very entertaining and may include a few local stories and anecdotes.You will pass in front of the Uffizi Gallery, beautiful caretaker of artistic treasures, under the unique Ponte Vecchio bridge, and you will also get the chance to learn more about the mysterious Vasari corridor. Discover Santa Trinita bridge and the amazing Palazzo Corsini. Lastly, enjoy a refreshing glass of cool wine to celebrate your stay in Florence!

data.name: PRIVATE Full-Day Tour of San Gimignano and Volterra
data.description: • EXPERIENCE FOR YOUR PRIVATE GROUP • Dedicate one day to the magnificent cities of San Gimignano and Volterra, and explore the history of the Tuscan hills on a private tour from Florence. A succession of winding roads cross vineyards and olive groves, to reveal the incredible medieval city of San Gimignano which offers breathtaking views of the Tuscan countryside from its over 1000 ft of elevation. Discover the Italian Etruscan heritage in Volterra, where ancient tombs, Roman ruins and squares lined with bricks intertwine with lively alabaster shops. • 8-hrs Full-Day private tour of hill town trip from Florence. • Hotel pick-up and drop-off at your Hotel or address provided. • Travel in a private luxury car or minivan (up to 8 passengers) • Visit two UNESCO World Heritage sites in a single day. • Our drivers will happily assist with any questions or requests. They are vastly familiar with Tuscany and will share curiosities and facts, or offer suggestions about the area.

data.name: Florence walking tour with Uffizi Gallery tickets and guided visit
data.description: Join a walking tour of Florence and admire its main sights. Then visit one of the most famous museums in the world, the Uffizi Gallery, skipping the long waiting lines at the entrance.This comprehensive introductory tour is dedicated to those who want to know all the facts and secrets of two thousand years of Florentine history: from the city's Roman origins and the Ponte Vecchio, passing through the famous Uffizi courtyard, to the wonderful architecture of Brunelleschi's Dome which overlooks the golden Gates of Paradise of the Baptistery. After the walking tour, you will have 3 hours of free time.Then, you'll visit one of the most famous museums in the world: the Uffizi. Your knowledgeable guide will explain the works of the greatest artists from the Middle Ages to the Renaissance: Cimabue, Giotto, Botticelli, Leonardo da Vinci, Michelangelo, Raphael, Titian, and many more. You'll learn about the secrets of the artists' craft, techniques, and tools. Looking at the most famous artworks of the period, you'll understand why Florence was the birthplace of the Renaissance.

data.name: Legends of Florence: Private Walking Tour by Night
data.description: Get beneath the skin of Florence and explore its ghosts and curiosities by night. Hear historical anecdotes and stories that you won't find so easily. See legendary sites such as the Duomo under the magic of their nocturnal illuminations.Let your private guide lead you through the heart of Florence and discover the city from a completely different perspective, under the charm of the night. As you walk through quiet streets and glowing squares, uncover hidden stories, legends, and historical anecdotes that go beyond any traditional guidebook. Admire iconic landmarks like the Duomo, beautifully illuminated, and experience Florence as you've never seen it before: mysterious, elegant, and full of secrets waiting to be revealed.

data.name: Florence: Dinner and Italian Opera Arias Concert
data.description: Let yourself be moved by the "Bel Canto", right in the city where the Opera was born in the 16th century. You will enjoy one of the best pizzas in the city in a well-kept location, furnished with furniture and antiques in the trendy Oltrarno district and you will end the evening with live music and talented singers, in the evocative atmosphere of a 15th century church. You will listen melodies known all over the world and interpreted by the magnificent voices of sopranos, mezzo-sopranos, tenors, baritones and basses, in the Renaissance settings of the Santa Monaca Church. Famous and romantic opera arias from La Bohème, La Traviata, Tosca, The Barber of Seville and Madame Butterfly. Experience an evening in typical Italian style that will give you a suggestive memory of your stay in the city.

data.name: Verdi & Puccini: at St Mark's Anglican Church
data.description: Experience the magnificent design of Florence's captivating St Mark's Anglican Church while indulging in a concert that will enlighten your appreciation of opera. Two exceptional soloists will perform arias and duets from Italy’s renowned opera composers Giuseppe Verdi and Giacomo Puccini within the enchanting St. Mark's Anglican Church in Florence! Featured in the program are duets from famed Italian operas such as La Traviata, Rigoletto, La Bohème, Tosca, and Madame Butterfly, alongside beloved Neapolitan songs.

data.name: Tickets to the Stibbert Museum in Florence
data.description: Book your tickets to the Stibbert Museum in Florence and discover about 50.000 objects including weapons and armors, costumes, paintings, tapestries, furniture and works of applied art on display in the elegant mansion of the Italo-British gentleman Frederick Stibbert.His father Thomas was a colonel of the Coldstream Guards, and his grandfather Giles had been Governor of Bengal, in India. The museum's extraordinary collection is the result of the original nucleus left by Friederick and increased by later additions and donations.Stibbert ended up transforming his home into a museum that documents the areas in which changes in taste and the development of techniques stimulated the creation of art objects. When he died, the museum became a foundation according to his last will.Frederick Stibbert made numerous changes to his house during his lifetime, adding new rooms and engaging the Florentine architect Giuseppe Poggi to transform the gardens from a simple Italian garden to a delightful romantic English garden, complete with caves and fountains, temples, and a greenhouse.

data.name: Skip the Line: Florence's Uffizi Gallery Guided Tour
data.description: Discover with your professional guide one of the most important art galleries in the world, the UFFIZI GALLERY. Thanks to a wonderful woman, Anna Maria Luisa De'Medici, this incredible collection of artworks that originally belonged to the most powerful dynasty of the city, is nowadays open to visitors from all over the world. This is a unique experience for those who want to immerse in Florence artistic background and history: your PROFESSIONAL GUIDE will create a comprehensive and fascinating itinerary that will catch the attention of first time visitors and art lovers'alike. The museum is huge but thanks to your guide, you will make sure to admire all the main masterpieces and, what is more, to understand the development of Italian art during the centuries. Starting from GIOTTO and MASACCIO, the real innovators of our history, you will be involved in an exciting celebration of beauty, admiring such masterpieces as BOTTICELLI's BIRTH OF VENUS, LEONARDO's ANNUNCIATION and MICHELANGELO's TONDO DONI, to name a few. You will be guided through the huge rooms and bright hallways of the museum, stopping from time to time to take in the breathtaking sights of Florence that you can admire from the panoramic windows and terraces of the museum. At the end of the guided tour you can remain in the Uffizi Gallery until closing time.

data.name: Florence Duomo Complex Guided tour
data.description: Discover the heart of Florence and learn all the secrets and the history that lies behind the Duomo Complex. Santa Maria del Fiore, designed by Arnolfo di Cambio. Our local guide will show you the main sight while telling you interesting anecdotes on how this masterpiece was created. You’ll also visit the Duomo Museum in which you’ll discover masterpieces of Arnolfo, Ghiberti, Donatello, Luca della Robbia, Antonio Pollaiolo, Verrocchio, Michelangelo. This is the largest concentration of Florentine monumental sculpture in the world includes medieval and Renaissance statues and reliefs in marble, bronze and silver by the leading artists of the era. Last but not least admire the stunning Baptistry of San Giovanni, one of the most ancient churches in Florence, sits opposite the city's cathedral, the church of Santa Maria del Fiore and its incredible East Door, which Michelangelo called the Gates of Paradise, is the now fully Renaissance masterpiece of Ghiberti.

data.name: Football Museum
data.shortDescription: Relive the history of the Italian football team
data.description:
In the world-famous locale of Coverciano, The Football Museum offers an impressive journey through six captivating rooms. There, the past and present of the Azzurri and Azzurre come to life. 

From the humble beginnings of the FIGC in March 1898, the museum has a treasure trove of tales to tell. Relive the glory of Silvio Piola's debut in the Azzurri jersey, and the International Cup.

Among these treasures, you'll find Enzo Bearzot's pipe, Fabio Cannavaro's World Cup final jersey, and the seven shirts from the seven Euro 2020 battles.

data.name: Florence: Afternoon or Evening Pizza and Gelato Making
data.description: Join this late afternoon or evening cooking class where professional chefs will introduce you to the history of two glorious Italian creations. Learn to prepare pizza and gelato just like Italians do!Make pizza together with an experienced pizza chef, a pizzaiolo. You will learn how to make tender, flexible yeast dough that stretches to almost paper-thinness, and even the trick for a flavorful yet light tomato sauce. Even if you bake pizza in your own oven, these techniques are universal and using them really makes a difference. With the pizzaiolo, you’ll make your very own pizza, you’ll stretch it, sauce it, bake it, slice it. It will be the best pizza you ever tasted, and you make it yourself!The chef will tell you why gelato is Italy's favorite dessert while giving an insight into the 'gelato culture' that continues to evolve. You will get to know the basic raw ingredients, how to select the best products available according to specific principles and you will have a presentation and tasting of some of the flavors used in gelato making. You will learn about the development and application of natural colors, the heating and freezing techniques and how they have different effects on ingredients.It is always a good day to discover the recipe for the world's most loved dessert! A booklet with recipes will guide you to cook for your friends once you get back home. And finally, get your certificate of participation! This activity is strongly recommended to families that wish their children to learn about the Italian food culture, an easy and fun experience that will last forever in their memory.

data.name: Florence Self Guided Audio Tour
data.description: Download a vibrantly-narrated mp3 audio guide combined with a map detailing the area of your tour. Fall in love with the beautiful Italian city of Florence! The birthplace of the Italian Renaissance and famous artist Michelangelo, Florence is a city that is rich in history and culture. This fascinating audio tour will guide you through the wonderful cobblestone streets to a few of the city’s highlights. Enjoy some of Florence’s famous gelato and enjoy this slice of Italian paradise! You'll also see the Central Market, the Museo Di San Marco, the Galleria Dell'accademia, the Bargello, the Piazza Della Signoria, the Ponte Vecchio, and an additional option to see the Basilica of Santa Croce. The Galleria dell'Accademia displays Michelangelo’s “David,” while the Uffizi Gallery exhibits preeminent works such as Botticelli’s “The Birth of Venus” and da Vinci’s “Annunciation.” One of its most iconic sites is the Florence Cathedral, with its terra-cotta-tiled dome (Duomo) engineered by Brunelleschi and the bell tower designed by Giotto. Florence is a delight to the senses. Your tour. Your way.

data.name: Best of Renaissance and Medieval Florence walking tour
data.description: Immerse yourself in the history and art of Florence, thanks to the passionate story of the local guide, full of stories, anecdotes and curiosities, will make you live an unforgettable experience to discover the most famous monuments but also unusual and hidden places.You can also enjoy an audio guide provided by the APP. You can explore other aspects of the city on your own and in total freedom by following the thematic itineraries available on the app, including "Florence as seen by Dante" dedicated to the great poet who was born in this city and lived until his exile.

data.name: Statue of David Evening Tour
data.description: Seeing Michelangelo’s David should be awe-inspiring, not chaotic. Don’t let daytime crowds and long waits diminish the experience. Our skip-the-line closing time tour offers a quieter, more intimate setting, free from the usual crowds. Led by a local expert, you’ll journey through Florence’s renowned museum, uncovering the stories behind each masterpiece before a peaceful, unhurried encounter with David. End your day with Florence’s greatest art, experienced the right way.Tour OverviewAfter meeting your small group and expert guide in the early evening in nearby Piazza Santissima Annunziata, you’ll take a short walk to the Accademia Gallery, learning the museum’s rich history along the way. Once there, your skip-the-line tickets mean you can quickly head inside to start exploring.With much smaller crowds at this time of day, you’ll be able to explore at a leisurely pace and really get up close and personal with the masterpieces and exhibits held within the gallery. The highlight, of course, is the chance for an unhurried, undisturbed viewing of Michelangelo’s iconic statue of David!Accademia and David Evening Tour DescriptionYour 1.5-hour tour includes:Skip-the-line evening tickets to the Accademia GalleryAn engaging, English-speaking guide with art history expertiseA maximum group size of 18 peopleEvening Tour of the Accademia GalleryYour tour begins with skip-the-line entry to the Galleria dell'Accademia. After the Uffizi Gallery, the Accademia Gallery is the most visited museum in Florence. This means that long lines are usually a sure thing. Luckily, we reserve your Accademia tickets ahead of time, meaning that you'll skip the general admission line with our shorter access line.Your guide is adept at enlivening the gallery's masterpieces and exhibits with captivating stories about their history and significance, ensuring a deeper connection with the stunning artwork on display, including the most renowned piece.Halls of the AccademiaAside from Michelangelo's David, there's plenty more to see within the Accademia Gallery's walls. Your guide will show you all of the most celebrated exhibits, including Gipsoteca Bartolini, which is a large hall covered floor to ceiling in sculptures. There, you'll be transported back in time to a period when the Accademia was a teaching gallery. In this hall, you can find countless works that aspiring Florentine artists crafted.You'll also be able to visit the Museum of Musical Instruments, Florentine Gothic Hall, as well as the Hall of the Prisoners. In these galleries, you'll become acquainted with early forms of Gothic art that paved the way to the Italian Renaissance period.Michelangelo's DavidThe highlight of the tour for most is the chance to see Michelangelo's iconic statue of David without the huge crowds that usually surround it. When you enter the gallery in which the David stands, you'll immediately notice his height, beautiful smooth surface, and famously determined expression.Your guide will explain how Michelangelo heroically carved this masterpiece out of a block of Carrara marble that no other artist wanted to touch. Make sure you take a good look at David's hands and feet, as they're out of proportion as the statue was supposed to be placed on top of the Florence Duomo.In the summer months, the Accademia Gallery stays open until 10 pm. If you want to stay inside the Accademia Gallery after the conclusion of your evening tour, you can take your time and revisit the David or your other favorite works of art.

data.name: Pisa & Lucca - Small Group Excursion from Florence
data.description: Be enraptured by the magic cities of Pisa and Lucca during this full-day tour by minivan from Florence. In just one day, this trip will allow you to discover two of the main cities of Tuscany.The first stop of our wonderful trip will be the charming city of Pisa, with its famous Square of Miracles (Piazza dei Miracoli) and the fascinating Leaning Tower. Here you will have an interesting 1-hour guided tour of the center and the Cathedral and approximately 1 hour of free time afterwards.Next, we will head to the ancient town of Lucca, where you will have plenty of free time to discover every picturesque angle on your own, including the nearby ancient forum.

data.name: OT Florence Medici Tour with Michelangelo's David
data.description: Discover the Medici's story while skipping the line to see more of the great masterpiece of Michelangelo’s David. From Giovanni de Medici to Lorenzo de Medici, you can watch, listen, and understand the power of the Medici Family.TOUR HIGHLIGHTSDiscover the story of the most elite families of the timeGain exclusive entrance to the Accademia Gallery, the home of Michelangelo's original sculpture of DavidLearn from a passionate and art-loving local guideCover the most of your stay in Florence with a Medici walking tour See the stunning architecture of historical buildings

data.name: Horseback Ridings and Wine Tastings in a Winery of San Gimignano
data.description: Swap the crowds of Florence for the tranquility of San Gimignano on a wine-tasting and horseback riding tour through vineyards and olive groves. In an intimate small group limited to 15 people, you’ll feast on the bounty of Tuscany and sample wines grown in the vicinity.

data.name: Florence to Anchiano: Da Vinci Private Tour with Lunch
data.description:
Depart from your centrally-located Florence hotel in a comfortable van and travel through the Tuscan countryside.

Stop first in Anchiano, where Leonardo was born, to visit the museum established inside his first home. A hologram of the Renaissance genius welcomes visitors to the museum, sharing stories from his life and of his works.

Travel next to the Leonardiano Museum in the town of Vinci, which features many models of machines Leonardo designed. Finally, make your way to a country farmhouse for a wine tasting and lunch.

data.name: Audio guided bike tour led by a tour leader
data.description: If you love riding bikes, this eco-friendly tour is perfect for you. Discover Florence on two wheels - the ideal way to explore a city that is people-friendly yet has a relatively large downtown. With a multilingual audio guide available in 15 languages, you'll be able to follow the route and learn about Florence's incredible history and culture at your own pace.As you ride through squares, streets, and alleys steeped in history and filled with extraordinary works of art, the audio guide will bring to life the centuries of Florence's greatest splendour and the stories of legendary artists such as Brunelleschi, Donatello, Michelangelo, Leonardo, and many more. An Italian and English-speaking tour leader will accompany the group to provide support, ensure everything runs smoothly, and offer further insights or explanations during the experience. Thanks to your comfortable bike, you'll visit all four historic districts of the city: San Giovanni, Santa Maria Novella, Santo Spirito, and Santa Croce.With your bike, you'll enjoy an educational and fun experience - truly unforgettable!

data.name: Florence Accademia Gallery Timed Tickets (Audio Guide Option)
data.description: Florence’s Accademia Gallery is home most famously to Michelangelo’s iconic “David”, but also his unfinished ”Prisoners”, works by Botticelli and Fra’ Bartolomeo, and more. Experience it at the pace that suits you without waiting in long ticket purchase lines when you prebook your tickets online. Upgrade to enrich your cultural experience with an informative audio guide.

data.name: From Florence: Private Minivan Tour Discovering Arezzo & Cortona
data.description: A full day to visit Arezzo and Cortona, another beautiful experience to learn about a very beautiful area of the Tuscany region. After only one hour drive to Arezzo by car or minivan, you will walk through the narrow streets to visit the city centre. Have you seen the Oscar Film ” La Vita è Bella ” by Benigni? This is exactly the same!!! In the afternoon arrive in Cortona, one of the best Etruscan City. Do you remember the Book and Film " Under the Tuscan Sun "? Right here

data.name: Private excursion from Florence to Siena - 5 hours
data.description: During this private open-air tour in a comfortable minivan, you will visit two of the most important cities of Tuscany: Siena and Monteriggioni. Characteristic elements of these locations are the historic towers, pointed arches, and narrow streets. Moreover, this Tuscan area is full of superb food specialties you will surely have the chance to taste, such as Panforte and Pici. The tour lasts 5 hours with 2 hours spent in Siena, and a short visit to Monteriggioni for a photo stop. You will also get a detailed description from our expert local guide in Siena with a 1-hour guided tour.

data.name: Diadema full experience
data.description: A magical journey through the history of our winery, Chianti area and Tuscany will immerse yourself in our way of life and have a true and authentic winery experience. Gaze in owe during the visit to the Diadema boutique winery, led by an expert sommelier who will explain the phases of the our wine production. Then you will be part of the tasting: an real immersion in Diadema wines and an other local great wine, will make you appreciate the best flavours and scents in Tuscan wine production. After this experience, you will have a better understanding of all the operations involved in the art of winemaking: the sommelier will guide you by contrast or by analogy, through the essential rules of tasting wines and pairing wines with food. Simply a perfect experience, capable to charm and make them fall in love not only wine experts but also those who start to explore the great world of wine!

data.name: Historic Villa Travignoli cellar tour and wine tasting
data.description: Embark on a journey that transports you back in time, as you explore the historic fermentation and ageing cellars of Villa Travignoli. These cellars, dating back to 1473, are steeped in history and tradition. As you wander through the private courtyards and gardens, you'll be immersed in an atmosphere of timeless elegance.The experience doesn’t end there. You will also have the opportunity to indulge your senses with a tasting session. Sample four distinct wines - a white, a rosé, and reds. To complement this, you'll also savour the rich flavours of extra virgin olive oil. This immersive exploration offers a blend of history and gastronomy, providing a truly unforgettable experience.

data.name: Pisa, Siena & San Gimigniano: Day Trip from Florence + Wine Tasting
data.shortDescription: Spend a memorable day visiting the jewels of Tuscany!
data.description:
**Tour itinerary:**

**Depart Florence**

Your exciting journey begins along scenic roads of the Chianti countryside, before arriving in Siena. 

**Siena**

Your professional guide will meet you for a fascinating tour of the most important sites in the heart of the city. Learn all about the city as you walk from Piazza del Campo, to the Gothic Cathedral, and visit its stunning interior decorations. At the end of the tour, there will be time to enjoy a coffee and to do some exploring on your own.

**Wine estate visit**

Then you will move onto a rustic wine estate in the foothills of San Gimignano, where you can enjoy a typical Tuscan lunch of three courses, enriched by a high quality tasting of local wines. After lunch, you will discover one of the most famous medieval hilltop villages in Italy, San Gimignano, famous for its ancient skyscrapers! You will have free time to explore the maze of cobbled streets, the small squares, and the many local artisan shops.

data.name: OT Florence Transportation to Cinque Terre from Florence on GT Coach
data.description: TOUR HIGHLIGHTS  Explore the colorful cliffside villages of the Cinque Terre on land and by boat Enjoy some time at leisure in Manarola, Portovenere, and Vernazza Spend an unforgettable day on the rocky coast of the Monterosso beach Spend a full-day exploring Cinque Terre from Florence: A marvel at its beauty with five little pastel-colored villages surrounded by a stunning landscape. These villages are suited in the rugged Italian Riviera coastline, so you can cruise along the coast by a boat and stop by for a swim and for a delicious seafood lunch at a local restaurant.

data.name: Day trip to Florence: Uffizi Gallery and David entrance included
data.description: Leave Rome on board of a comfortable Mercedes Minivan and discover Florence, the town famous to be the craddle of Renaissance. Visit the Uffizi Gallery Museums and discover the masteripiece of arts made by Botticelli and other famous artist. You will have all the time you need inside because we will provide you a skip the line ticket and you will have free time to visit all the museum. After an hour of free time for lunch and shopping in the famous leather market you willl visit the Accademia Museum. It will be an unforgettable moment because you will be in front of David, the most famous statue made by Michelangelo. At 5pm  you will leave the town to come back in Rome.

data.name: Tenuta il Corno wine tasting experience
data.description: 40 minutes drive from Florence, Tenuta Il Corno is more than happy to welcome you for a great wine tasting moment. Once you arrive at our winery, you will be greeted by a member of the staff who will bring you throughout your visit at the estate. All the wines you will taste are of own production, as well as the extra virgin olive oil and the Vin Santo. All the other products that will accompany them are of home made or obtained from raw materials of excellence rigorously in Tuscany! During your tour you'll be surrounded by a gorgeous view of the typical Tuscan landscape. The green Tuscan hills speckled with vineyards, olive trees, woods and 16th century Villas and country houses are waiting for you.  You will taste 3 different labels of their wines. With the passing of time, the winery has selected autochthones grape varieties, which produce high quality Tuscan wines, such as the Colorino del Corno or the Malvasia di Santa Lucia used for the typical Tuscan dessert wine called Vin Santo, or several clones of original Tuscan Sangiovese grapes.  You can choose among 2 options:   "Standard Tasting and Tour": Guided tour to the winery and tasting of 3 labels accompanied by bruschetta with extra virgin olive oil (EVO)"Standard Tasting and Tour Plus": guided tour to the winery and tasting of 3 labels accompanied by a light lunch If the season allows it, you will enjoy the tasting experience in the garden.

data.name: Vivaldi's Four Seasons at Museo Zeffirelli
data.description: The Firenze Academy Ensemble will perform Vivaldi's 'Four Seasons' in the wonderful atmosphere of the Museo Zeffirelli. The program opens with an 'Air' by Bach and Mozart's famous 'A Little Night Music'.

data.name: Explore Palazzo Vecchio and its tower
data.description: Admire the Town hall of Florence on a 2-hour tour of the Palazzo Vecchio Museum, which  overlooks the Piazza della Signoria the amazing square that holds a copy of Michelangelo's David statue, and the gallery of statues in the adjacent Loggia dei Lanzi. Visit the private apartments of the Medici Family.   Admire the impressive murals that decorate the walls of the Salone dei Cinquecento — the Hall of the Five Hundred — which is the most imposing chamber as it was enlarged by Giorgio Vasari so that Grand Duke Cosimo I could hold his court in this chamber. At the end of the hall is a small side room without windows. The studiolo was a small secret study designed by Vasari in a mannerist style.

data.name: From Florence: Small-Group Hike and Wine Tasting in Chianti (with Lunch)
data.description: Taste the wines produced in one of Tuscany's most important wine areas during a personalized hiking tour through the vineyards of Chianti Classico, the ideal choice if you are looking for a small group experience surrounded by nature and dedicated to one of the best Italian wines.During the guided excursion, you will explore the Chianti Classico wine region on foot and make several stops along the way to visit three local wineries, enjoy a great lunch and taste their wines paired with other typical delicacies.The enchanting hills, vineyards and castles that characterize the beautiful Tuscan countryside will be the perfect background for an exclusive experience designed to fully enjoy the Chianti area.

data.name: Florence: The Three Tenors Opera Concert
data.shortDescription: Elevate your city stay with Neapolitan classics performed by talented artists
data.description:
Are you set to get goosebumps? Witness a tribute to The Three Tenors on one of Florence's most exquisite stages, and the chills are sure to follow! Experience Neapolitan classics like "O Sole Mio", "Funiculì Funiculà", and "Torna a Surriento", performed by some of Italy's most gifted talents.

The unforgettable tribute to the world's most cherished three tenors: Luciano Pavarotti, Plácido Domingo, and José Carreras, is not to be missed. The performance spans from opera arias to the classics of Neapolitan tradition.

Relax in the charming Oratorio di Santa Maria Vergine della Croce al Tempio. Here, an ensemble of mandolin, cello, grand piano, and some of Italy's most captivating voices are ready to serenade you.

data.name: Chianti: Wine & Olive Oil Tasting with Guided Tour + Roundtrip from Florence
data.shortDescription: Explore Tuscany's wineries and an olive oil mill with a guide
data.description:
Explore the world of authentic Tuscan wines and olive oil on the Chianti Wine & Olive Oil experience. A knowledgeable sommelier guides you through the scenic Chianti and Chianti Classico landscapes aboard a comfortable Mercedes Minibus.

This ride takes you through olive groves, cypress trees, and renowned vineyards, offering both comfort and captivating views.

Enter the world of wine, unraveling the complexities of acidity, taste, and food pairings. It's an enlightening exploration into the rich history and traditions of winemaking, fostering a deep appreciation for this ancient craft.

The tour includes a visit to an ancient noble estate's olive oil mill, where past and present harmonize. Witness the olive oil production process and taste the gourmet flavors crafted with passion and dedication.

Next, explore three distinct wineries and their cellars, gaining insight into diverse aging techniques and the unique flavors offered by Tuscan winemakers.

data.name: Florence: Small Group Food Tour - Florence for Foodies
data.description:
Did you know that Tuscan cuisine holds its own among the tastiest regions in Italy? Or that Florentine people are more likely to eat a bowl of bread and bean soup than a plate of pasta? Taste your way through Florence on this foodie experience.
Watch a baking demonstration of homemade Cantucci Sample a deliciously fennel-spiced salami Visit a collection of an authentic Italian trattoria Taste one of Florence's seasonal soups or stews Sample different flavours of authentic gelato
On our 4-hour walking food tour through Oltrarno – the Florentine equivalent of Paris’ left bank – you’ll get to taste what makes this city’s cuisine so special and unique within Italy. Through countless food and wine tastings at 8 authentic stops, learn how to make Italian Cantucci (cookies), sample the local salami, and experience the neighbourhood’s Bohemian vibe – full of students, artists and lively culture. Meet the families that have been serving up the foodie treasures locals have savoured for generations.

data.name: The ultimate Florence bike tour
data.description: Florence is perfect for biking and this bike tour will take you across pedestrian areas and the tiny streets of the city that normal bus tours can't go! This tour will take you less time than any walking tour, showing you roads away from usual tourist paths that are too far to be reached by foot and too tiny to be reached by bus. In 2 and a half hours you'll visit some of the major attractions, under the experienced guidance of an entertaining and fun, professional history guide.You'll ride through the narrow streets of the historic center and the Oltrarno district reaching the most amazing monuments of Florence and unknown spots from where to admire the city: the artisans' district, Palazzo Pitti, San Frediano, Ponte Vecchio, the Uffizi Square, Santa Croce, Piazza della Signoria, the Medieval district, the Duomo and Piazza della Repubblica.During this pleasant stroll in Florence, you'll stop at several locations for historical explanations and fun facts about the city. You'll even be shown the best places to find gelato, bistecca Fiorentina (Florentine steak) and truffles. Relax and enjoy the tour: your guide will help you discover the most of Florence in the least time and in the funniest way... simply perfect as an introduction as well as for those who have visited the city before. Either way, we’re sure you’ll agree that biking is the best way to see the "cradle of the Renaissance".

data.name: Guided gastronomic and cultural tour through Florence
data.description: Embark on a tour of Florence that seamlessly blends gastronomic delights with the exploration of hidden gems. This journey will take you from an exclusive rooftop setting to historic shops, where you can sample the region's signature schiacciata and taste the sweetness of cantucci paired with Vin Santo. Experience the city in a new way, discovering places only the locals know.This tour is designed and led by Florentines themselves, guaranteeing an authentic and unique experience. Not only does it offer the opportunity to taste local delicacies in fantastic locations, but it also reveals lesser known corners of the city. It's a wonderful way to experience Florence off the beaten track.

data.name: Palazzo Vecchio secret passages tour with lunch or gelato tasting
data.description: Join an exclusive guided tour of the hidden areas of Palazzo Vecchio followed by a typical lunch or a gelato tasting.Feel the thrill of discovering secret places and hidden paths in Palazzo Vecchio that are inaccessible to the general public. Ascend the narrow passages of Duke Gualtieri’s medieval stairway and be surprised by an unexpected path beyond a door hidden by a painting. Admire the precious coffered ceiling of the Salone dei Cinquecento and explore the Medicean Palace from an unusual perspective.After the tour, continue this experience by choosing between a Tuscan lunch in a typical restaurant in the old city center and a gelato tasting in one of the most famous Florentine ice cream shops.

data.name: Chianti Hills Tour:Discovering Tuscany's Wine Heart from Florence
data.description:
Escape to Tuscany's Chianti Hills from Florence for a wine lover's paradise. Roam vineyard-covered landscapes, taste Chianti's renowned wines, and uncover the artistry behind each bottle. A toast to unforgettable memories!

Be prepared to be mesmerized by a tapestry of natural beauty. Endless vineyards dressed in vibrant greens stretch towards the horizon, while the ancient olive groves and charming medieval towns provide a sense of timelessness. The countryside whispers stories of generations who have toiled to create this captivating vista.

Chianti is more than just a wine; it's a testament to the harmony between the land and the hands that nurture it. Traverse the vineyards, touch the soil, and grasp the meticulous care that goes into every grape. Expert vintners will guide you through tastings that allow the flavors to unfold on your palate, showcasing the nuances that make Chianti wines revered worldwide.

data.name: Santa Croce Basilica Complex Entry Ticket
data.description:
Skip the Ticket Purchase Line and Save Time – Don’t let long lines take away from your travel experience.

Michelangelo’s Tomb: Dramatically sculpted by Vasari, marking the final resting place of the Renaissance master.

Galileo’s Tomb: A dignified monument to the father of modern science.

Cenotaph of Dante: Symbolic memorial; actual burial is in Ravenna.

Giotto frescoes: Stunning cycles in the Bardi and Peruzzi chapels depicting life of St. Francis, among earliest Renaissance art in Florence.

Pazzi Chapel: Early Renaissance jewel by Brunelleschi and decorated by Luca della Robbia in glazed terracotta.

Donatello sculptures: Including the “Cavalcanti Annunciation” and crucifixes that influenced later Renaissance sculpture.

Flexible and Independent Experience – Perfect for travelers who prefer freedom over group tours.

It is not possible to skip the security lines. There could be a line at the entrance and is mandatory for all visitors.

data.name: Florence: Uffizi Gallery Private Walking Tour
data.description: Whether it’s sculptures of Roman emperors or masterpieces such as Botticelli’s ‘The Birth of Venus’, there’s a lot for art-lovers and curious travelers to discover at the Uffizi Gallery. On this private tour, explore the works of Giotti, Leonardo da Vinci, Michelangelo, Raphael, and many more, as you learn the stories behind some of their greatest works.

data.name: Florence City Tour Fun for Families A Kid Friendly Adventure
data.description:
Enjoy a 2.5 hour engaging walking tour for families and kids through the streets and squares of Florence with an expert guide who will show you the wonders of the Renaissance and the highlights of the city.

Your local guide is specialized in working with children and will keep their attention and curiosity by using i-pad, games, flashcards, other media tools and tricks that all of you will love.

You will visit Piazza della Signoria, Santa Croce, the Porcellino, San Lorenzo Market, the Duomo square, Ponte Vecchio, Piazza della Repubblica and other fascinating sites.

data.name: Chianti Wine and Olive Oil Tour From Florence with Lunch
data.description:
Your wine tasting tour will begin with pickup in central Florence. Settle into your seat for a 1-hour drive to the famous wine region of Chianti, and watch the landscape transform from the bustling city streets of Florence to rolling vineyards, olive groves and cypress trees.

Upon arriving, make your way to two wineries to sample the best blends of the region. Learn how the Canaiolo and Sangiovese grapes are grown and sip to discover the varying characteristics of each blend. You’ll also have a chance to try a Chianti Classico, a regional favorite made from grapes grown between Florence and Siena. Taste up to six Chianti wines at both cellars, along with top-quality Tuscan olive oils.

Afterward, pause for lunch at a nearby cooking school, indulging in a typical Tuscan lunch. Sample more Italian wines while you eat, as drinks are also included with your meal.

data.name: Self-guided e-Scavenger Hunt in Florence
data.description: Get to know Florence in a unique and affordable way.Access the free game app and immerse yourself in the city. You have the flexibility to set your own pace, deciding when to commence, conclude, or pause your adventure. Utilize GPS to navigate the city's most charming squares, streets, and landmarks, while acquiring captivating insights about Florence. Embark on a one-of-a-kind e-Scavenger hunt to uncover the city's treasures. Detailed instructions for commencing the tour will be provided upon booking, and you can embark on this experience at your convenience.This city game also serves as an ideal group activity, suitable for large gatherings.

data.name: Guided wine tasting tour in Florence with a professional connoisseur
data.description: Over three immersive hours, a professional wine expert will guide you through the world of Italian and Tuscan winemaking, offering insights in an intimate and engaging setting.The experience begins with a stroll through Florence’s historic centre, discovering hidden corners and local stories. Your first stop is a renowned enoteca, where you'll taste a curated selection of premium wines, from the bold Chianti reds to the refined Vernaccia whites, learning about their unique characteristics.Next, visit a historic wine bar near the Duomo, beloved by locals since the 1950s. Inside, discover two floors lined with bottles from all over Italy and beyond. Here, your second tasting reveals the depth and complexity of Tuscan wines, with your expert sharing the secrets of traditional techniques and the role of terroir.The final tasting takes place in an elegant private location, where you’ll enjoy unlimited wine paired with authentic Tuscan delicacies: artisanal cheeses, cured meats, and more, carefully chosen to enhance each glass.

data.name: Cinque Terre and Portovenere Day Trip from Florence
data.description: Explore the breathtaking Ligurian coast, a small corner of paradise divided into five villages suspended on steep cliffs overlooking the sea. Enjoy a unique landscape where vegetation and lush vineyards frame spectacular scenery. Visit three of the five villages with our expert tour leader. This area has been declared a World Heritage Site by UNESCO. The area consists of kilometers of rocky coasts with caves, beaches, hiking paths, and breathtaking scenic spots.You’ll visit Manarola, a tiny urban jewel characterized by Genoese style ‘case-torri. Then, you will go to Vernazza, a village overlooked by the remains of a Medieval castle. You could enjoy your free time here, discovering its cylindrical tower.The third stop you’ll reach is Monterosso, known as the ‘pearl of Cinque Terre’. You will be surprised by this ancient fishing village with lovely beaches and lush vegetation that cover the rocks. Here you’ll also get the chance to take a swim as this is the biggest village with a perfect sandy beach and crystalline water.At the end, you’ll visit Portovenere, a small village of several colored house. Enjoy your free time before heading back to La Spezia where the van will be waiting for you. Enjoy a pleasant ride back to Florence where the tour will end.

data.name: Evening Cooking Class with Dinner
data.description: After a day in the city why not enjoying a funny and interactive cooking class in Central Florence where you'll prepare and then enjoy a 3-course meal.  Meet our Chef directly at Cooking School for a practical and interactive group lesson, with the instructions of an experienced chef, in a fully equipped kitchen. Starting from fresh ingredients you will prepare a traditional Italian 3-course meal, including an appetizer, main course, and traditional dessert. Menu changes every lesson depending on our Chef fantasy but just to give you some ideas you might prepare: Spinach or Potatoes soufflé, Pumpkin Risotto, Ravioli stuffed with spinach and ricotta, Chicken rolls, Fresh pasta “alla carbonara”, Tiramisù, Chocolate soufflé, Panna Cotta and much more.  The course is followed by a dinner with the dishes you prepared in our wine cellar, with bottled water and Tuscany wine.

data.name: Pisa: Day Trip from Florence + Optional Leaning Tower Ticket
data.shortDescription: Walk along medieval walls and climb the Leaning Tower
data.description:
Walk along the medieval walls to Porta Santa Maria, where you will see Piazza dei Miracoli with its white-marble buildings and green lawns. 

A guide will take you inside the Pisa Cathedral (if selected), a Romanesque structure, and show you the Baptistery, the Monumental Cemetery, and the Leaning Tower.

Climb the steps to the top of the Leaning Tower of Pisa on this half-day tour from Florence (if selected).

data.name: Wine windows, legends and secret corners of Florence evening tour
data.description: Discover Florence's hidden gems with an evening walking tour in Oltrarno neighbourhood, focused on one of the city’s latest trends—tasting wine from the historic wine windows (buchette del vino).Starting from Piazza della Repubblica, you'll stroll through secret corners and Instagram photo spots in Florence, like the Loggia del Porcellino and Piazza del Limbo. Follow the Vasari Corridor’s path, hear Medici legends, and cross Ponte Vecchio into the heart of the Oltrarno, Florence’s most authentic district. There, you’ll uncover recently restored wine windows, once used by noble families to sell wine directly to locals. Sip a glass of Tuscan wine served just as it was centuries ago—through a buchetta—while soaking in the neighbourhood’s unique charm. A blend of history, taste, and tradition awaits on this unforgettable tour.

data.name: The Best Of Medieval Private Tour Of Florence
data.description: Soak up Florence‘s must-see sights on this complete half-day tour of the Medieval city. The tour begins with your expert local guide leading you to the Bargello, a former barrack and prison now an art museum, housing mainly sculptures by great artists of the Renaissance period. In the same district, you can also admire some very ancient Tower Houses, dating back to the time of the struggles between Guelfs and Ghibellines. Other highlights of the tour are Signoria Square dominated by the massive Palazzo Vecchio and the beautiful Loggia dei Lanzi. We then reach Palazzo Davanzati, a typical residence of a rich family still preserving its original Medieval atmosphere.

data.name: Museums Special: Accademia & Uffizi combo tour - monolingual small group tour
data.description: Looking to fit the most in one day? This tour is a time-supersaver for those of you looking for a comprehensive and fascinating tour in the “Cradle of the Renaissance” while skipping the line for entry at the Uffizi Gallery and Accademia Gallery.Meet your guide and make your way to the incredible Accademia Gallery, home to many treasures including Michelangelo's iconic “David” sculpture. No need to worry about waiting in long lines… your guide will quickly usher you to the front, and you can easily enter. Your tour guide will reveal the secrets of this Renaissance treasure trove; learn all about the creation of Michelangelo’s world renowned masterpieces, such as the original version of “David,” his unfinished “I Prigioni”, and “San Matteo.” You will discover that he was not only a sculptor, but also a painter, an architect and a sensitive poet. After that, enjoy a little break and get ready for the second part of this combo tour to discover the most beautiful museums in Florence. Prepare for a feast for the eyes and the soul… the magnificent Uffizi Gallery, offering one of the largest painting collections in the world as well as stunning views of Florence’s skyline. Your professional guide will create a comprehensive and fascinating itinerary that will peak the interest of first time visitors, and art lovers alike. Starting in chronological order of the Renaissance, discover the innovators of Florentine history. Enjoy an exciting celebration of beauty, admiring masterpieces such as Botticelli's “Birth of Venus”, Leonardo's “Annunciation”, and Michelangelo's “Tondo Doni”, to name a few. At the end of the guided tour you can remain in the Uffizi Gallery until closing time. Enjoy revisiting any works of art you particularly enjoyed, and independently exploring the majestic halls. Then, grab a cappuccino or spritz from the Uffizi’s cafe and enjoy a breath of fresh air on the terrace overlooking Palazzo Vecchio and the striking Florentine skyline.

data.name: Tarot Songs
data.description: Recent laureates of the Wigmore Hall, Hugo Wolf, and Lyon Chamber Music Competitions, 2024 workshop participants Joanna Kacperek and Clara Barbier Serrano return to Florence to give our Saturday night recital. In this program, songs will be paired with cards from the Tarot de Marseille and performed in random order. With the help of the audience, the order of the concert is decided in the moment, which creates a unique and collective experience. The cards may be mysterious and spiritual, but they are also, mostly, a game...and isn't it the same with music? More Info: In this recital, the songs are paired with cards from the Tarot de Marseille and performed in random order. We start the concert with Schumann's 'Die Kartenlegerin', during which we draw the first cards. We then ask audience members to pick the next ones: that way, the order of the concert is decided in the moment, which creates a unique and collective experience of the concert. Songs are paired with cards on the ground of common themes, characters, particular energies. Some pairing are obvious, such as 'The Moon' and Schubert's 'An den Mond', others more mysterious such as 'Strength' Ingeborg von Bronsart’s “Die Lorelei”. The audience is left free to imagine the link between card and song.

data.name: La Traviata at St.Mark's Anglican Church
data.description: Seize this opportunity at the beautiful St Mark's Anglican Church in Florence to experience the breathtaking opear performance of Verdi's La Traviata. La Traviata, the story of a courtesan who falls in love with Alfredo Germont, a young nobleman, against the wishes of her father Giorgio Germont. The story also served as the basis for the films 'Moulin Rouge' with Nicole Kidman and 'Pretty Woman' with Richard Gere and Julia Roberts. The opera is performed by the Opera Company Florence and each act is explained in English.

data.name: Florence: E-Bike Tour in the Hills around Florence with Gelato
data.description: Explore the wonderful rolling hills of Florence with an electric bike that allows you to experience unparalleled views of the Tuscan countryside without effort! This slow tour along bike lanes and safe streets is suitable for anyone who knows how to ride a bike. Follow a local guide on one of the most spectacular and charming hill tours!An easy ride takes you to the famous terrace of Piazzale Michelangelo, where you'll stop to enjoy the unforgettable panorama that encompasses the entire city, and then to the magnificent Romanesque Basilica of San Miniato al Monte. Immerse yourself into the sound, the scents and the colors of the hilly landscape dotted with old cypresses, olive groves and small vineyards.Finally, what better way to end such a fantastic ride, than tasting one of the best “gelato” in the city? After all, ice cream was invented exactly in Florence and Florentines love to enjoy one with their friends, so… cone or cup?

data.name: Photography Bike Tour of Florence
data.description: If you are a lover of classical biking this tour is perfect for you. Our guide will bring you through squares, streets, and alleys that are rich in history and art. The tour will make you relive the centuries of glorious events and will bring you to the discovery of artists such as Brunelleschi, Donatello, Michelangelo, Leonardo, and many others. Thanks to our comfortable bikes you will be able to visit all the four historical neighborhoods of the city: San Giovanni, Santa Maria Novella, Santo Spirito, and Santa Croce. You will stop along the way to take photos, to make sure you don't miss anything from this beautiful city. At the end of the tour, you will have a collection of photos so that your memory of Florence will be as clear as ever!If you like cycling, we guarantee an unforgettable experience that will be at the same time instructive and fun. Everything will be carried out with an eco-friendly approach ... Firenze will thank you!

data.name: Private Full Day Walking Tour of Florence Highlights with Uffizi and Accademia
data.description: Full day tour in Florence with skip the lines entrance to Uffizi and Accademia. Admire the most important sites of Florence in one day. The tour will give you an overview of the city center, starting from Piazza della Repubblica, admire the Cathedral, Brunelleschi's Dome, Giotto's bell tower, the Baptistery, Piazza della Signoria and cross the Ponte Vecchio to explore the Oltrarno area, and the Pitti Palace. Visit the Uffizi and its world famous collection of paintings by Botticelli, Leonardo, Michelangelo, Raphael, Caravaggio, and the Accademia museum, where you will admire the famous original David by Michelangelo. We will take care of reserving skip the line tickets to Uffizi and Accademia. Tickets included I. The price

data.name: Orsammichele Entrance Tickets
data.shortDescription:
Most churches in Florence are characterized by their typical architecture, but this is definitely not the case with Orsanmichele. Probably because of its unique history, the building has a structure that combines civil and religious buildings.

Its 3 floors mix simple gray stone walls, intricate Gothic arches and windows, outdoor niches with various sculptures, and even if you look for it, you won't find a formal, royal entrance door. The entrance to the church is at the back.

To get an idea of the grandeur of the building, visit the museum. From there, you can appreciate its architecture, with its magnificent arches and masonry. Not to mention the breathtaking view, which not only shows the panorama of Florence, but also allows you to appreciate the great variety of statues and artistic styles of the saints that once decorated the exterior niches.
