data.name: Florence Small-Group Guided Bike Tour with Sandwich Lunch
data.description: Take in the top sights in Florence without getting footsore on this small-group bike tour through the old town. Cycle past highlights like the Medici’s Basilica of San Lorenzo, the Arno River, and Santa Croce while learning about Florentine history and architecture. Exploring with a guide means you can get around the city without the hassle of a map and focus on the sights. Your excursion also includes a famous Florentine sandwich without waiting in the long line.

data.name: Walking tour of Florence with a private Florentine Tourist Guide
data.description:
A three hours stroll to discover the most impressive monuments and some less known places of Florence:

Piazza Santissima Annunziata, Piazza del Duomo, the district of Dante, Piazza della Signoria, Ponte Vecchio, and the "Oltrarno" neighborhood. History, anecdotes, urban legends, stories of Florence and its people.

Enthusiasm, passion, experience, a profusion of information about Art, History, Food and Wine, stories mixed with some Florentine sense of humor

data.name: The Medici Dynasty: Private Walking Tour
data.description: Discover the incredible story of Florence’s most powerful family, from their humble beginnings to the twilight of their dynasty. Led by a licensed guide, this fascinating walking tour will take you through the key places that marked their rise to power: churches, palaces, secret passageways, and more.The journey begins in Piazza San Marco, leading us to Palazzo Medici Riccardi, the family’s first grand residence. From there, we continue to San Lorenzo, where you'll learn about the significance of the basilica and view the Medici Chapels from the outside. The tour then moves into the heart of Florence, through Piazza del Duomo and Piazza della Signoria, rich with political and artistic history. Finally, we'll cross the iconic Ponte Vecchio to reach the majestic Pitti Palace, the family's final and most opulent home.This tour is a perfect blend of history, art, and legend, an unforgettable way to experience the legacy of the Medici in the very streets they once ruled.

data.name: Michelangelo's private tour in Florence
data.description: Discover the life and works of Michelangelo on a private tour of the Accademia Gallery and the Church of Santa Croce. With your pre–reserved admission tickets, breeze past notoriously long lines at the Accademia Gallery with your private guide. In addition to navigating for you, your guide provides little–known anecdotes, facts, and background on the artist's most famous sculptures, from the David to the Atlas. After the visit to the Accademia Gallery, you will also visit Santa Croce Church, the resting place of the most famous artist of the Florentine Renaissance.

data.name: Afternoon excursion to Pisa with Leaning Tower and Cathedral tickets from Florence
data.description: This excursion to Pisa from Florence with skip-the-line access to the Leaning Tower will give you the amazing opportunity of climbing the world's most famous tower! Enjoy a splendid excursion through the fertile and picturesque Tuscan countryside to the historic university city of Pisa, famous for its architectural beauty.Upon arrival in Pisa, your guide will take you on a guided walking tour of the Square of Miracles and its monuments. You will be dazzled by this marvelous square which is dominated by the Cathedral – a model of Pisan Romanesque architecture, the celebrated Leaning Tower, and the round-shaped Baptistery surrounded by suggestive columned arcades. The commentary of the guide will be particularly focused on the Leaning Tower, one of the wonders of the world. You will be enthralled by the history and the leaning structure of the tower which stirs the imagination of all visitors.After the guided tour, you will enjoy the interior visit of the magnificent Tower with skip-the-line entrance. Climbing to its top by mounting its 294 steps rising up in a spiral will be one of the most amazing experiences you can ever try. The tower is 55.86 m tall (183.27 ft) from the ground on the low side and 56.70 m tall (186.02 ft) on the high side, around 3.99 degrees leaning. The weak and unstable subsoil caused this unique phenomenon, contributing to creating one of the wonders of the world.

data.name: Full Day in Florence: Accademia, Uffizi, and Walking Tour  from Pisa
data.description: Start your day in Pisa and take the train to Florence (tickets are included and will be sent by email).  Upon arrival in Florence meet our guide and start the Accademia Gallery tour. You will learn why David is the most recognizable symbol of Florence and what it used to represent in his time. How did the genius of Michelangelo meet the challenge of extracting the pathos of a being and fixing it forever in time in the Pietà or the famous Prisoners who still seem to struggle free from their marble blocks? You will have the answers to all your questions. Get the chance to have a close encounter with timeless works of art and get the inside story of the life and times of this consummate artist. After the guided tour you will have some free time to wander around on your own and some free time to have lunch (not included). The second part of the tour starts in the early afternoon from the Hard Rock cafe near Piazza Della Repubblica. You will enjoy an excellent and complete introductory tour dedicated to those who want to know all the facts and secrets of two thousand years of Florentine history, from the city’s Roman origins to a 15th-century palace, from the Ponte Vecchio, through the famous Uffizi courtyard, to the wonders of the architecture of Brunelleschi’s Dome which overlooks the Baptistery golden ‘Gates of Paradise. After the walking tour, you will visit one of the most famous museums in the world: the Uffizi Gallery. Your knowledgeable guide will explain the works of the greatest artists from the Middle Ages. You will recognize original world-famous paintings you have seen in books, magazines, and on TV close-ups. You will learn about the secrets of the artist's craft, techniques and tools. Looking at the most famous artworks of the period, you will be able to understand why Florence was the birthplace of the Renaissance. The tour ends in the Uffizi Gallery where you will have the chance to stay longer in the Gallery and wander around on your own. You visit Italy would be incomplete if you did not visit these world-famous galleries. After the tour makes your way back to Pisa with the train.

data.name: Accademia Gallery Tour with Skip-the-Line Ticket
data.description: Go straight to the highlights of the UNESCO-listed Accademia Gallery in Florence on this skip-the-line guided tour. You’ll not only see the gallery’s famous Renaissance sculptures such as Michelangelo’s "David" and masterpieces by the likes of Giambologna and Ghirlandaio, but you’ll also hear the stories behind them, narrated by a guide.

data.name: Florentine Steak w/ Wines in San Gimignano Winery
data.description: Savor Florentine steak perfectly paired with exquisite vintage-reserve wines during a memorable visit to a San Gimignano winery. Surrounded by the beauty of Tuscany, this intimate experience celebrates the region's rich culinary traditions, making it ideal for sharing with family and friends.

data.name: Accademia and Uffizi Museums Private Combo Tour
data.description:
Are you passionate about art and history? This private tour is perfect for discovering Florence’s Renaissance treasures in just one day! With your expert guide, you’ll start at the Accademia Gallery, home to Michelangelo’s iconic David. Skip-the-line tickets ensure fast access as your guide reveals the secrets behind the masterpieces and the genius of Michelangelo.

After a short break, continue to the Uffizi Gallery for a journey through art history. Admire works by Giotto, Botticelli, Leonardo da Vinci, Michelangelo, and more. Learn about the evolution of Renaissance art as your private guide tailors the experience to your interests.

This tour offers a relaxed, in-depth visit without the crowds of large groups. Enjoy the flexibility to ask questions and remain inside the Uffizi as long as you wish after the tour. A must-do for art lovers visiting Florence!

data.name: Siena private walking tour with personal photographer from Florence
data.description: During this full day tour in Siena, you'll have three photoshoots, with private transfer, as well as a free time for shopping or tasting the local cuisine.You'll meet with the tour leader and your personal photographer at 10.00 AM in front of Santa Maria Novella Rail Station, and you'll leave Florence together by private car. You'll arrive in Siena in two hours, where you'll start the walking tour from Piazza San Domenico, and the first shooting with a beautiful view of the town. The photographer will keep walking with you, in the old city, taking some pics along the historical alleys. Next, you'll reach the majestic Duomo di Siena, where the second shooting takes place.Piazza del Campo is the most famous symbol of the city, because of the horse race Palio. Here you'll spend the rest of our time with the last shooting with the magnificent background of Torre del Mangia and Palazzo Pubblico. In your free time, from about 2.00 PM to 3.00 PM, you can have shopping or enjoy the traditional food, before coming back to Florence. Arrival is scheduled at 5.00 - 6.00 PM. Best shots will be delivered by email within 48h.

data.name: Florence: Accademia Gallery Skip-The-Line Express Private Tour

data.name: Florence Academy Guided Tour With Skip-the-Line Access

data.name: Afternoon in Siena and Chianti Wine Tour with Dinner from Florence

You leave Florence in the early afternoon, reaching SIENA in just 1 hour driving through the Chianti scenery, famous for its delightful hills and vineyards. Enjoy your free time in Siena breathing in the Medieval atmosphere all around you, wandering through its narrow streets and admiring the magnificent artistic heritage of this city, exemplified by the Gothic Cathedral and the impressive Torre del Mangia standing in the stunning, world-famous Piazza del Campo. Take advantage of your free time to go shopping or by visiting the traditional and ancient shops. Admire the sunset from a wonderful panoramic spot: the tour continues by visiting a typical WINE ESTATE in the heart of the Chianti area, between the famous Tuscan hills and vineyards, where you will be served a delicious dinner based on typical Tuscan products like salami, bruschetta and other unique delicacies. data.name: Siena, San Gimignano, Chianti Wine Tasting from Florence

Combine medieval gems, fine wines, and UNESCO-listed monuments on this full-day tour of central Tuscany from Florence. Marvel over the medieval castle of Monteriggioni; explore the architectural wonders of historic Siena; and admire the striking skyline of hilltop San Gimignano.

data.name: Uffizi Gallery, Michelangelo’s David and Accademia guided tour
data.description: Discover Florence's highlights in a single day with an expert guide leading the way. You'll gain a deeper understanding of the city's art, history, and architecture, without the hassle of planning your itinerary.This half-day tour of Florence includes a walking tour of the historical centre, with visits to the Ponte Vecchio bridge, the leather market, and Piazza Signoria. Gaze up at the magnificent Florence Cathedral and cruise through the Accademia Gallery, where you'll see Michelangelo's great sculptural masterpiece, the David.After 1.5 hours of free time to have lunch, you'll get the chance to visit the Uffizi Gallery with a skip-the-line ticket in a small group, making it easy to interact with your guide and explore all the highlights of the collection.

data.name: Florence: Walking Tour at Sunset with Wine Tasting
data.description: Discover Florence at sunset with a glass of wine in your hand! Take advantage of an experienced guide, who will unveil the history of the beautiful squares, gardens, and palaces you'll see on the way and show you places off the beaten track.The experience begins with a pleasant walk among antique and craft shops in the Oltrarno district, where many Florentines still live. The guide will help you understand and feel the atmosphere of the neighborhood, while you enjoy a glass of Chianti with special crostini in a famous local wine shop.Grab a glass of wine to go as you continue on to your next destination: the political and religious center of Florence. As you cross the beautiful Ponte Vecchio at night, you will see how spectacular the city is in the dark. Once again you will feel the atmosphere of the city and find out new facts and stories along the way to the Duomo, your final stop.It's now time for a second drink: bask in the glory of the Cathedral with a final glass of wine paired with crostini. Experiencing the Duomo at night is very special as there are fewer people and less commotion: the perfect way to end this spectacular sunset wine tour.

data.name: Florence Leonardo da Vinci Oil and Wine Discovery Tour
data.description: Uncover the mysteries of Leonardo da Vinci’s life through a six-hour tour of Oil and Wine Discovery. Delve into his past by visiting his birthplace in Vinci along with captivating replicas of pictures created by him. Then, experience an amazing organic extra virgin olive oil tasting at one of the beautiful villas near Vinci, before you explore Medici's Villa wine cellars where you will enjoy a delectable traditional lunch.

data.name: Florence: Small-Group Vespa Scooter Tour of Chianti with Lunch
data.description: Travel like a real Italian on a Vespa scooter tour of the Chianti region. A minivan ride takes you from the city of Florence out into the rolling countryside, ready for an orientation lesson on scooter driving from an English-speaking guide. A quick driving test later and you're off to ride past vineyards and through historic village. Taste Chianti (the region's red wine) at a boutique winery, sample olive oil from local producers, and sit down for a traditional Tuscan lunch, complete with wine pairings.

data.name: Florence: Pitti Palace, The Residence of Medici Dynasty
data.description: Enjoy a guided tour of the Palatine Gallery inside Palazzo Pitti, one of the most important landmarks of Florence and the last lavish residence of the Medici family.Located on the piano nobile of the palace, the Palatine Gallery is divided into 28 rooms and houses an extraordinary collection of paintings that once belonged to the Grand Dukes of Tuscany. Unlike traditional museum displays, this collection follows the historical decorative taste of past centuries, with paintings arranged in multiple rows based on aesthetic criteria rather than chronological order or artistic school.During the guided tour, you will admire the exclusive private collection of the Medici family, featuring masterpieces by Botticelli, Titian, Rubens, Caravaggio, and many other renowned Italian and European artists from the 15th to the 17th century. Your guide will reveal the fascinating history of the palace and its residents, from the Medici to the Lorraine dynasty, and finally to the King of Italy, as Palazzo Pitti became the royal residence when Florence served as Italy’s capital from 1865 to 1870.After the guided tour, you will have free time to explore the other museums within the Palazzo Pitti complex at your own pace. These include the Gallery of Modern Art, Treasure of the Grand Dukes, and the Museum of Fashion and Costume, and the Royal Apartments allowing you to fully immerse yourself in the art, history, and grandeur of Florence’s most prestigious palace.

data.name: Pitti Palace Private Tour Including Tickets To Boboli Gardens
data.description: Enjoy a private guided tour of the Palatine Gallery.The Gallery was opened to the public by the House of Lorraine in 1828, and it still preserves the typical layout of a private collection, with a sumptuous combination of lavish interior decoration and the original rich picture frames.One of the most significant groups of works of the collection is formed by the works of Titian and Raphael, with famous paintings such as the Portrait of a Gentleman and Magdalene by Titian and the Madonna of the Grand Duke, the Madonna of the Chair and the portrait of Maddalena Doni by Raphael.The Gallery also houses some impressive works by European artists, like Van Dyke's Cardinal Bentivoglio, and Ruben's The Four Philosophers and The Allegory of War.All these paintings are not arranged in chronological order but based on the personal esthetic taste of the inhabitants of the palace, which helps give the Gallery its unique charm and lavishness.After the visit to the Palatine Gallery, you will also have a chance to visit Boboli Garden, the most famous Renaissance garden in Florence.

data.name: Palazzo Pitti, Boboli & Bardini Gardens: Skip The Line Ticket
data.description:
As Florence’s only royal palace, Palazzo Pitti is a must-see on the city’s tourist trail. It's also the largest museum complex in the City of Lilies; at some 32,000 square meters this is a residence fit for absolute rulers - from grand dukes to kings and emperors.

After enjoying its architecture you can't miss visiting its surroundings, the exotic plants of Boboli Gardens. Of equal beauty, Bardini Gardens offer what is widely considered to be the most beautiful panoramic view over Florence.

data.name: Florence: Full-Day Private Tour to Siena & San Gimignano
data.description: Visit the biggest hill town in Tuscany, Siena—without the hassle of organizing it yourself—on this full-day private tour from Florence. A medieval town and UNESCO World Heritage Site with plenty to see, Siena perfect for a day of shopping, eating, and exploring. Your driver-guide provides insight and recommendations while on the road, but then leaves you with free time to explore at your own pace. On the way back, pass through another historic town, San Gimignano, known for its walled layout and panoramic views.

data.name: Self-drive a vintage Fiat 500 in Florence with assistance
data.description:
Get behind the wheel of a Classic Fiat 500 and you will be able to relive the emotions of an Italy of the past in the heart of Tuscany.

After welcoming you, one of our experts will explain the Fiat 500 in all its particularities, and then accompany you and assist you during your journey. You will be the protagonist behind the wheel of the legendary Fiat 500. You will have the opportunity to visit extraordinary locations and experience unrepeatable emotions. Please don't forget your camera, you will be able to take home unforgettable images.

Well! All you have to do is open the roof, let the wind flow through your hair and enjoy this magical Tuscan moment.

Prerequisites:

Driver's license

Credit card for deposit

Experience with manual transmission

data.name: Florence Farm and Cellar Visit with Cooking Class and Lunch
data.description: Taste and experience the authentic Tuscan countryside in Fucecchio, just 45 minutes from Florence, on this hands-on tour. You'll visit an organic farm and wine cellar, partaking in barrel tastings, collect aromatic herbs, and meeting the farm animals. You'll also learn the secrets of homemade pasta before enjoying a relaxing meal on the patio or in a traditional Tuscan kitchen.

data.name: Florence sunset food and wine guided tour
data.description: Prepare to delve into Florence's exquisite culinary legacy as you explore the city's storied wine windows, savor the region's most exceptional wines, and relish a traditional zero-waste soup and fresh pasta delicately prepared by a skilled local chef.As you explore the city with your knowledgeable guide, you'll get to taste other local delicacies and learn about the history and culture behind each dish. The highlight of the tour is a visit to a centuries-old wine cellar where you'll have the opportunity to sip on innovative delicious Super Tuscan wines. This comprehensive tour offers an unforgettable experience of Tuscany's authentic flavors and rich culinary culture.Whether you're a seasoned foodie or a curious traveler, this tour is the perfect way to immerse yourself in the city's vibrant nightlife and explore its charming streets while savoring its delicious flavors. Don't miss out on this unique opportunity to discover Florence's hidden culinary gems.

data.name: Florence Private Tour from Rome by Train
data.description: Explore Florence on a private tour from Rome by train. Known as the "City of Arts," its streets are alive with the aroma of Italian cuisine and the beauty of Renaissance masterpieces, from Brunelleschi’s Dome to Michelangelo’s David. With this expert-guided tour, explore not just its significant landmarks like the Cathedral and Uffizi Gallery but also uncover Florence's intimate, hidden gems.

data.name: Full-Day Tuscany Tour by Vespa with Lunch
data.description: Tick off several of Tuscany's most renowned locations during this full-day Vespa tour. Enjoy some photo stops in the vineyards and take a guided stroll through the picture-perfect village of San Gimignano, with free time to explore. The tour includes a typical Tuscan light lunch paired with a tasting of some local wines and olive oils.

data.name: Palazzo Pitti & Boboli Gardens: Private Half-Day Walking Tour
data.description: Explore the beautiful formal grounds of the magnificent Palazzo Pitti and the Boboli Gardens; and discover the grand-ducal residence of three ruling dynasties. Filled with artistic treasures by revered maestros such as Titian and Raphael, you’ll learn about the aristocratic lives of the Medici and other noble families who ruled the glittering, bygone era of the Italian Renaissance. On your private tour, you will:  Visit the magnificent Palazzo Pitti and Boboli Gardens with your private guide; Marvel at the lavish interior of this vast palazzo and learn about the lives of the grand dukes, duchesses, and their entourages, who inhabited the place for centuries; Discover glorious masterpieces by Titian, Raphael, and Rubens; Learn the compelling backstories of the works of art that adorn the walls together with the history of Anna Maria Luisa de Medici (1667-1743), the Palazzo Pitti’s patron of the arts; Learn about the fascinating history of the building from its construction in the 1400s by the wealthy banker LucaPitti, to its historic purchase by the Medici in 1550, and how it was later gifted to the Italian people; Explore the highlights of this palatial complex now divided into four museums: the gleaming Treasury of the Grand Dukes, the astonishing luxury of the Imperial and Royal apartments and the Palatine Gallery, the Gallery of Modern Art, and the Museum of Costume and Fashion where you can browse the stunning collections of ceramics, costumes and exquisite jewellery; End your tour with a courtly stroll around the majestic grounds of the Boboli Gardens, filled with ancient and Renaissance statues, formal landscape architecture, grottos and architectural follies. Set on the southern bank of the River Arno, this vast and magnificent Renaissance palace is a grandiose architectural statement of epic proportions, that tells of a rich and grandiose historic past. Commissioned in 1446 by Florentine banker Luca Pitti who aspired to live in a building so large it would dwarf all his enemies, the Palazzo Pitti has hosted a trio of noble families over the centuries: the House of Medici, the House of Habsburg-Lorraine, and the kings of Italy, the House of Savoy. Now open to the public, at 32,000 square metres, the Palazzo is the largest museum complex in Florence. On your private tour, you will benefit from your expert guide’s compelling commentary and swerve queues and crowds. You’ll learn about how the Pitti’s rivals, the Medici Family, bought the Palazzo in 1550 and how it became a symbol of the power of the Grand Duchy of Tuscany’s ruling families. Located at the foot of Boboli Hill, the building’s forbidding design features a series of repeated arch-headed apertures reminiscent of a Roman aqueduct. In 1919, the palace and its contents were donated by King Victor Emmanuel III to the Italian people - and the gallery’s gilded paintings and priceless artefacts represent one of the most magnificent collections in the world today. Marvel at the 17th-century lavish, gilded interior decor - itself a magnum opus - and enjoy the world-class artistry in the Palatine Gallery, the Silver Museum, the Museum of Modern Art, the Costume Gallery, the Porcelain Museum and the Museum of Carriages. The grand, formal parklands of the historic Boboli Gardens, open to the public since 1766, it's a fine example of an early "Italian Garden" and provides a fitting finale to a resplendent tour rich in courtly grandeur.

data.name: Florence Private Artisan Workshop and Shopping tour
data.description: Dive into Florence’s vibrant artisan culture on this private shopping tour. Visit traditional workshops where skilled craftspeople practice centuries-old techniques in leather, mosaics, and goldsmithing with the option to purchase unique Florentine treasures. Customize your itinerary to match your interests and enjoy a tailored experience with a local guide.

data.name: Pisa, Siena and San Gimignano Tour with Lunch and Wine Tasting
data.description: Experience the wonders of Tuscany in one memorable day. Start in Pisa’s Piazza dei Miracoli, where you can admire the Baptistery, Cathedral and Leaning Tower. Continue to Chianti for a traditional lunch and wine tasting at a rural estate with panoramic views over the countryside. Visit the UNESCO-listed medieval town of San Gimignano before concluding the day with free time to explore Siena.

data.name: Create Your Own Frozen Praline in Florence
data.description: Dive into the world of Venchi with an exclusive experience that will reveal all the secrets of artisan gelato. Get ready to create your own gelato and add an essential touch of chocolate!Uncover fascinating facts about its production and what makes each flavour stand out. Then, under the guidance of experienced staff, you'll have the chance to craft your own gelato using professional equipment. Once it's ready, show it off, decorate it with chocolate and other delectable ingredients of your choosing, and finally savour it!Finally, take advantage of a 10% discount on purchases and take home a tasty gift.This experience is hosted by a network of home cooks known as Cesarine, which is the oldest of its kind in Italy and spans across the country. The term "Cesarine" translates to "home cook". This passionate and hospitable group of local hosts open their homes to inquisitive travellers for immersive culinary experiences. They serve only local specialities from their family cookbooks, narrating the rich story of their traditional regional cuisine.

data.name: Chianti: Guided Winery Tour + Wine Tasting
data.description:
Start with a tour of the cellars to discover the company’s history and the wine-making process. Observe the machinery and barrels used in production.

Taste four different wines in a spacious room, including two IGT Toscana wines, one Chianti Classico, and one Chianti Classico Riserva. Receive explanations about each wine's composition and flavors, paired with Tuscan crackers.

Stroll through the picturesque vineyards for a closer look at the natural surroundings. Add extra food, wines, liquors, and spirits to the visit for an additional cost.

data.name: Siena, San Gimignano & Colle Alta: Day Trip from Florence + Wine Tasting
data.description:
Enjoy a fantastic day trip from Florence and explore the villages of Tuscany and the Chianti wine area! The village of San Gimignano, the Chianti area and the medieval city of Siena are located in the heart of Tuscany. These are not-to-be-missed stops for those who want to learn more about the tradition and history of this incredible region.

You'll be whisked from Florence to the village of San Gimignano, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Here you will spend some free time walking through the streets, admiring the squares, the churches and the towers.

data.name: Ride Fiat 500 Vintage For a day in florence
data.description:
Hire a classic Fiat 500! Drive through the history on board of one of the most appreciated Symbols of Italian design!

FIAT 500 is incredibly small and incredibly comfortable. Its dimensions are perfect to drive in the narrow streets of Florence also off the touristic paths. An Iconic car to discover an iconic City!

You'll feel like in a dream, out of the time, with the blue sky or the stars above your head and the beauty all around you, while you're driving the nicest, beautiful, and charming city car that was ever built. You'll feel like a star and other tourists will look at you with amused admiration. You'll also have the opportunity to discover the Chianti hills just around the City, or Piazzale Michelangelo or even to reach Fiesole.

Hiring and driving FIAT 500 is easy, safe and funny, and is much more than renting a car!

**Take with you your driving license and credit card, liability insurance and assistance are included.

data.name: Florence: Entry Ticket to See Michelangelo’s David & Audio Guide
data.description:
Unlock the Secrets of Michelangelo’s David – Skip the Line and Dive into Renaissance Genius!

step straight into the heart of Florence’s artistic soul with our Accademia Gallery Audio Guided Tour.

With your included audio guide, you’ll journey through the gallery's most iconic works, starting with the awe-inspiring David by Michelangelo — a must-see that leaves visitors speechless. Hear the fascinating history of how this colossal masterpiece was carved from a single block of marble and became a symbol of strength and freedom.

As you explore further, uncover the stories behind Michelangelo’s powerful Prisoners, marvel at golden-panel paintings from the 13th century, and discover hidden gems by Renaissance masters like Botticelli and Ghirlandaio..

Whether you're an art enthusiast or a curious traveler, this audio guided tour gives you the freedom to move at your own pace while still learning from passionate expert commentary.

data.name: Florence: New Year's Eve Opera Performance
data.description: Celebrate New Year's Eve in style at this operatic performance in Florence. Listen to live performances of songs from classic operas, including, "The Marriage of Figaro", "Tosca", "The Barber of Seville", "La Bohème", and "La Traviata". The performance takes place in the beautiful Church of St. Monaca, right in the heart of the city. At midnight, toast to the year ahead with a complimentary glass of sparkling wine.

data.name: San Gimignano, Siena, Monteriggioni, Chianti: Day Trip with Lunch & Wine Tasting
data.description: Your memorable journey starts with the charming San Gimignano, world famous walled town located on a hilltop, which remained intact through the centuries, renowned for its tall towers, wonderful frescoes and many other valuable works of art: here the tour leader will lead you to the historical center, where you will have around 2 hours of free time for a fascinating discovery. A short distance from San Gimignano you will visit the charming historical hamlet of Monteriggioni*, an amazing small medieval village enclosed by its famous walls, which remained standing to this day: free time for inside visit. From Monteriggioni, crossing the gently Chianti rolling hills, a short ride will take you to a cozy Winery, where you can relax and enjoy the fantastic world of Chianti with its wine and typical products: tasting of three fine wines followed by a Chianti style lunch: 3 course with “zero food miles” products which ends with "cantucci e vin santo". Later on, getting to Siena, you will meet your professional local guide who will lead you on a comprehensive guided tour of the historic center, starting from the famous Basilica of San Domenico, a jewel of Renaissance art built in the 13th century and dedicated to St. Catherine of Siena, of which preserves a relic. Then strolling along the narrow medieval streets of the city, flanked by splendid palaces and historic shops, passing through Piazza del Campo, of which the Palazzo Pubblico (Town Hall) is the focal point, you will get to the spectacular Cathedral of the 12th century, of which you can admire the magnificent architecture and the splendor of the polychrome marbles. You will experience an amazing inside Guided Visit of the famous Siena Cathedral (if option selected), together with its Libreria Piccolomini, to discover the beauty of its treasures and works of art. You will visit the not-to-be-missed floor (during the opening period), decorated with the art of mosaics to create storytelling masterpieces, St. John the Baptist by Donatello, the rose window by Duccio di Buoninsegna, the marble pulpit by Nicola Pisano, the Library which kept a rich collection of manuscripts. You will also have some free time to end your perfect day enjoying the unique atmosphere of this amazing city, before the return to Florence in the evening. Please note that the order of the visits may change (*) From November to March, the itinerary does not include the stop at Monteriggion and the return to Florence is approx 30 minutes earlier

data.name: Florence City Sightseeing from Rome by high-speed train
data.description: During this experience, you'll reach Florence from the centre of Rome and explore the city independently while saving time and money.At your arrival in Florence Santa Maria Novella you will be offered assistance. City Sightseeing staff will meet you at the bus stop near the station.At Santa Maria Novella you can climb aboard City Sightseeing Florence, from here it's very easy to reach Piazzale Michelangelo, Fiesole, and much more.The multilingual guide will tell you the history and many interesting facts about this fascinating city. With free WiFi on Board you are able to download the SIGHTSEEING EXPERIENCE app which gives you an additional audio guide in 5 languages. The app will show you the location of your bus in real time, as well as the waiting time at bus stops.

data.name: The Uffizi Gallery: Private Guided tour of Florence Art Museum
data.description: Few troves of art stir the soul like the Uffizi Gallery, one of the world’s oldest art galleries famous for its Renaissance masterpieces and the most visited museum in Italy in 2021, before the Colosseum and the Vatican Museums in Rome and the ruins of Pompeii. On your private tour, you will: Enjoy an overview of the development of Italian painting from the 13th to the 16th century, thanks to the museum's chronological layout; See the Uffizi’s finest masterpieces, artworks by the Italian Great Masters; Marvel at the iconic Birth of Venus by Sandro Botticelli, one of the most esteemed artists of his time; Take in an entire room dedicated to a young Leonardo Da Vinci, including the world-famous "The Annunciation" painting of 1472; Stand in awe of one of Titian's most important works the Venus of Urbino which depicts the naked figure of a young bride about to be dressed as part of a Venetian pre-nuptial ritual; Admire one of Michelangelo's few paintings outside of the Vatican, the Doni Tondo is considered one of the most important masterpieces of 16th-century Italian art; Marvel Caravaggio’s terrifying Head of Medusa oil painting, mounted on a wooden shield; See several other highlights, including Dürer's Adoration of the Magi, Duccio's and Cimabue's Madonna Enthroned; Finish your tour inside the Uffizi Gallery, where you can continue exploring at your leisure. Since 1581, the Uffizi’s resplendent architecture has housed some of the most alluring of paintings, drawings and sculptural works a seductive prospect for art lovers from all over the globe. An immersive exploration of the gallery’s major rooms and halls, that connects you with the masterpieces, your private tour will deliver some of the finest works of the Renaissance from Botticelli and Leonardo da Vinci to Caravaggio. The private lives of the Great Masters are a fascinating backstory; with your guide, learn how jealousies have intertwined with raw eroticism and religion - you can feel it in the Uffizi, read it in Dante, see it in Michelangelo and become engulfed by it in every Florentine church.  Your tour will finish inside the museum, where you can continue to explore the museum at your own pace or return to pieces where you wish to linger.

data.name: OT Florence Santa Croce Church Guided Tour in Florence
data.description: The Basilica di Santa Croce (Basilica of the Holy Cross) is the principal Franciscan church in Florence, Italy, and a minor basilica of the Roman Catholic Church. It is situated on the Piazza di Santa Croce, about 800 meters southeast of the Duomo. It is the burial place of some of the most illustrious Italians, such as Michelangelo, Galileo, Machiavelli, the poet Foscolo, the philosopher Gentile, and the composer Rossini, thus it is known also as the Temple of the Italian Glories (Tempio dell'Itale Glorie). Tour HighlightsTemple of the Italian Glories ( Tempio dell'Itale Glorie)Burial place of several Florentine and Italian masters such as Michelangelo, Machiavelli, Galileo Galilee, Rossini, and moreFind frescos by Giotto and a chapel designed by BrunelleschiAdmire the works by Donatello and the monument dedicated to Dante Alighieri, author of the Divine Comedy

data.name: Private Pizza And Gelato cooking class in Florence
data.description: Experience the true essence of Italian cuisine with our pizza and gelato cooking class. Guided by expert Italian chefs, you'll master the art of crafting authentic pizza and gelato. Enjoy the fruits of your labor with a delectable dinner, complemented by refreshing drinks – your choice of fine Italian wine or a soft beverage. As a delightful souvenir, receive an Attendance Certificate to commemorate your culinary journey. Immerse yourself in the flavors of Italy in this engaging, hands-on experience.

data.name: Chianti Vineyards Tours in Private Luxury Van from Florence
data.description: Treat your senses to a memorable day in the world-famous Chianti wine region on this private tour from Florence. Travel in a luxury minivan through a landscape of historic vineyards, rolling hills and medieval villages, with a private driver at your disposal throughout the day. Taste renowned Chianti wines and authentic Tuscan cuisine at estates of your choosing, or let your local driver make suggestions for the best places to wine, dine and explore.
